KUALA LUMPUR, Sept 25 (Reuters) – Jailed former Malaysian prime minister Najib Razak has asked a court to suspend a 15-year prison sentence imposed on him for his involvement in a multibillion-dollar corruption scandal, his lawyer said on Friday, a week after he received a royal pardon on a separate conviction. 

Najib, 73, has been in jail since 2022 after being found guilty of graft and money laundering linked to the theft of billions of dollars from 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB), a state fund he co-founded while in office. He has consistently denied wrongdoing.  

Malaysia’s King Sultan Ibrahim last week granted a conditional pardon to Najib, allowing him to serve the remainder of his original sentence under house arrest until his expected release date in August 2028, provided he pays a 50 million ringgit ($12.27 million) fine. 

Show Full Article

But Najib also faces an additional 15 years in jail after he was found guilty in December last year in a separate case linked to corruption at 1MDB – a sentence that would begin after his stint in house arrest ends. 

The Kuala Lumpur High Court will decide on October 14 on whether to grant Najib’s request to stay that sentence pending an appeal against the conviction, his lawyer Muhammad Shafee Abdullah told reporters.

If Najib pays the fine and is granted the stay, “there is a good chance he is released on the same day,” Muhammad Shafee said.

However, the terms setting out the house arrest order remained unclear as Najib’s legal team has yet to receive official documents confirming the royal pardon, he added.

Muhammad Shafee reiterated that Najib has so far been unable to pay the fine, with many of his assets still frozen by the government.

Najib’s party, the United Malays National Organisation, has launched a fundraising drive for supporters to secure the ex-premier’s release. 

US and Malaysian investigators have said at least $4.5 billion was stolen from 1MDB, with about $1 billion making its way into accounts linked to Najib. 

Najib has apologised for mishandling the scandal, but maintains his innocence, saying he was misled by others about the source of the funds flowing into his accounts. 

($1 = 4.0760 ringgit)

(Reporting by Rozanna Latiff and Ashley Tang.)

items.title: Eight injured in drone attack in Russia's Ulyanovsk region, one killed in Belgorod region
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Eight people, including a child, were injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Ulyanovsk region on Friday morning, Governor Alexei Russkikh said.
items.body:
Eight people, including a child, were injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Ulyanovsk region on Friday morning, Governor Alexei Russkikh said.
Russkikh said on Telegram that industrial and civilian infrastructure in the region had been damaged in the attack.
In Russia's Belgorod region, one civilian was killed and another wounded when a Ukrainian drone struck a truck overnight, the regional operational headquarters said.
Voronezh region Governor Alexander Gusev said air defence forces had destroyed 88 drones overnight over the regional capital and at least six districts. Four people were injured in Voronezh, while residential buildings, vehicles and industrial facilities were damaged, he said.
Separately, Perm region Governor Dmitry Makhonin said on Telegram that air defence units and mobile fire groups were repelling a "massive" drone attack on the region. He said an industrial facility had been targeted but that there were no preliminary reports of casualties, with emergency services working at the scene.
Reuters could not independently verify the reports.

items.body:
Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr said on Friday he had granted a pardon to Mary Jane [USN:L1N3NI159 TEXT:"Veloso"], who is serving a prison sentence in the Philippines after receiving a [USN:KBN0NJ056 TEXT:"last-minute reprieve"] from execution by firing squad for drug trafficking in Indonesia in 2015.
"I already signed her pardon," Marcos told reporters.
Veloso returned to the Philippines in December 2024 following years of negotiations between Manila and Jakarta after spending nearly 15 years in prison in Indonesia.
Veloso, a mother of two and a former domestic helper, was arrested in Yogyakarta in 2010 after authorities found 2.6 kg (5.7 lb) of heroin concealed in a suitcase.
She said she was an unwitting drug mule, but she was convicted and sentenced to death in Indonesia.
Her case drew widespread attention in the Philippines, and prompted years of diplomatic efforts by Manila to secure [USN:KBN0NL109 TEXT:"clemency"] and eventually her transfer from Indonesia.
In 2024, Manila and Jakarta [USN:L3N3N7021 TEXT:"agreed"] to transfer Veloso back to Manila in a deal that included the Philippines respecting the court's sentencing of Veloso and her status as a prisoner.
Indonesian authorities had said any decision on granting Veloso clemency after her transfer would be up to Marcos.

items.title: Malaysian ex-PM Najib asks court for stay of 15-year jail sentence
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Jailed former Malaysian prime minister Najib Razak has asked a court to suspend a 15-year prison sentence imposed on him for his involvement in a multibillion-dollar corruption scandal, his lawyer said on Friday, a week after he received a royal pardon on a separate conviction.
items.body:
Jailed former Malaysian prime minister Najib Razak has asked a court to suspend a [USN:P8N3W8076 TEXT:"15-year prison sentence"] imposed on him for his involvement in a multibillion-dollar corruption scandal, his lawyer said on Friday, a week after he received a royal pardon on a separate conviction.
Najib, 73, has been in jail since 2022 after being found guilty of graft and money laundering linked to the theft of billions of dollars from [USN:L6N45A0CE TEXT:"1Malaysia Development Berhad"] (1MDB), a state fund he co-founded while in office. He has consistently denied wrongdoing.
Malaysia's King Sultan Ibrahim last week granted a [USN:L6N45A04G TEXT:"conditional pardon"] to Najib, allowing him to serve the remainder of his original sentence under house arrest until his expected release date in August 2028, provided he pays a 50 million ringgit ($12.27 million) fine.
But Najib also faces an additional 15 years in jail after he was found guilty in December last year in a separate case linked to corruption at 1MDB - a sentence that would begin after his stint in house arrest ends.
The Kuala Lumpur High Court will decide on October 14 on whether to grant Najib's request to stay that sentence pending an appeal against the conviction, his lawyer Muhammad Shafee Abdullah told reporters.
If Najib pays the fine and is granted the stay, "there is a good chance he is released on the same day," Muhammad Shafee said.
However, the terms setting out the house arrest order remained unclear as Najib's legal team has yet to receive official documents confirming the royal pardon, he added.
Muhammad Shafee [USN:L6N45C00P TEXT:"reiterated"] that Najib has so far been unable to pay the fine, with many of his assets still frozen by the government.
Najib's party, the United Malays National Organisation, has launched a fundraising drive for supporters to secure the ex-premier's release.
US and Malaysian investigators have said at least $4.5 billion was stolen from 1MDB, with about $1 billion making its way into accounts linked to Najib.
Najib has [USN:L4N3M015Y TEXT:"apologised"] for mishandling the scandal, but maintains his innocence, saying he was misled by others about the source of the funds flowing into his accounts.
($1 = 4.0760 ringgit)

items.title: Curazao remonta tres goles y saca triunfo de visita a Costa Rica en Liga de Naciones Concacaf
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La selección de fútbol de Curazao se sobrepuso tras recibir tres goles y sacó el jueves un valioso triunfo por 4-3 como visitante ante Costa Rica en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf.
items.body:
La selección de fútbol de Curazao se sobrepuso tras recibir tres goles y sacó el jueves un valioso triunfo por 4-3 como visitante ante Costa Rica en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf.
En el partido correspondiente al Grupo A de la Liga A del torneo de la Concacaf, disputado en el estadio Ricardo Saprissa, de San José, la selección "tica" se había puesto en ventaja con tanto de Orlando Sinclair y doblete de Carlos Mora. Pero Curazao reaccionó en la segunda parte y logró el valioso triunfo con doblete de Kenji Gorré y otros tantos de Tahith Chong y Jordi Paulina.
"No es la primera vez que nos pasa, es responsabilidad total de nosotros, hay que seguir trabajando y poner atención en los detalles, Un partido controlado no se nos puede ir de esta manera, hay que seguir trabajando pues todavía quedan puntos por pelear", dijo Mora a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf.
La selección dirigida por el argentino Fernando Batista se adelantó en el minuto cuatro con un potente disparo cruzado de Sinclair dentro del área.
Costa Rica aumentó su ventaja a los 24 minutos con un zurdazo de Mora, quien se quedó con el balón tras un pase retrasado de un zaguero de Curazao.
Mora anotó su doblete en el primer minuto de reposición de la primera parte con un potente disparo desde fuera del área tras controlar el balón después de un débil rechace defensivo.
Para la segunda parte, Costa Rica trató de aumentar su ventaja con el apoyo de sus aficionados, pero Curazao descontó a los 62 minutos cuando Gorré remató en el área un pase de Paulina.
Cuatro minutos después, Chong anotó el segundo gol de Curazao con un colocado disparo desde fuera del área.
Con la reacción, Curazao empezó a controlar el partido y logró el empate a los 78 minutos con el doblete de Gorré, quien definió de zurda en el área chica después de que el balón pegó en el poste izquierdo tras un disparo de Livano Comenencia.
En los minutos restantes del partido, Curazao se vio más dominante y peligroso, y logró el tanto del triunfo a los 82 minutos cuando Paulina remató de volea un centro que Juninho Bacuna mandó desde el sector izquierdo en una jugada que inició Gorré.
Al final del partido, los aficionados costarricenses abuchearon a los jugadores de su selección, mientras que los jugadores de Curazao fueron a festejar con los pocos aficionados que se dieron cita en el estadio de Costa Rica.
En los otros partidos del Grupo A, República Dominicana ganó por 3-2 a Nicaragua con goles de Heinz Mörschel, Mariano Díaz y Pablo Rosario. Para los nicaragüenses anotaron Juan Luis Pérez y Byron Bonilla.
En tanto, Haití venció por 3-2 a Trinidad y Tobago con tantos de F Picault, G Metusala y W Isidor, mientras que para los trinitenses marcaron W. Frederick y L García.
Con estos resultados, Curazao, Haití y República Dominicana se ubicaron en los tres primeros lugares del sector con tres puntos cada uno.
En la segunda jornada del grupo, que se disputará el domingo, Costa Rica visitará a Haití, Curazao será local ante Nicaragua, y Trinidad y Tobago jugará ante República Dominicana.
El Grupo B entrará en actividad el viernes con los partidos entre Honduras-Surinam, El Salvador-Martinica y Jamaica-Guatemala.
Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos avanzarán a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf.
Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027.
La Liga de Naciones es una competencia de selecciones nacionales lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro de Concacaf compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas Mundiales.
Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

items.title: Thai August exports rise 24.3% on year, close to forecast
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Thailand's customs-cleared exports rose 24.3% in August from a year earlier, the commerce ministry said on Friday, just below analysts' expectations.
items.body:
Thailand's customs-cleared exports (THCEX=ECI) rose 24.3% in August from a year earlier, the commerce ministry said on Friday, just below analysts' expectations.
The August reading compared with a forecast rise of 24.9% in a Reuters poll, and followed an increase of 21.6% the previous month.
Imports (THCIM=ECI) rose 25.1% in August from a year earlier.
Thailand recorded a trade deficit (THCTR=ECI) of $2.48 billion in August, compared with a forecast of a $3.9 billion deficit.
August shipments to the United States, Thailand's largest market, jumped 48.7% from a year earlier, while exports to China rose 15.5%, the ministry said.
Thai exports were seen rising until the end of the year, supported by demand for electronics tied to global AI trends, Natiya Suchinda, deputy head of the ministry's Trade Policy and Strategy Office, told a media briefing.
Exports could expand 15% this year, Natiya said.

items.author: CNA

FAST

HANOI, Sept 25 : Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp (SMBC) is in advanced talks to increase its stake in Vietnamese private lender VPBank, four people familiar with the negotiations said.
SMBC, the banking arm of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, is discussing raising its holding to approximately 20 per cent from 15 per cent, the people said, declining to be identified because the information is not public. The Japanese lender acquired the original stake in 2023 in a deal worth $1.5 billion.
The two sides intend to complete the transaction this year but remain at odds over valuation, two of the people said. One said negotiations have been underway for months. 
An expanded stake would deepen SMBC's exposure to one of Asia's fastest-growing banking markets, giving it greater access to Vietnamese consumers and businesses as the country targets rapid economic growth, rising household wealth and increased foreign investment.

Vietnam's stock market was upgraded this week to emerging-market status by index provider FTSE Russell, a development expected to attract overseas capital and support valuations.
VPBank is seeking a substantial premium to its share price, one of the people said, in line with the 2023 transaction, when SMBC paid about 40 per cent above market value. 
SMBC has been reluctant to pay that premium and has internally discussed the possibility of increasing its holding through open-market purchases rather than a private placement, the second person said.
Both SMBC and VPBank declined to comment.
In April, VPBank said it was discussing a private placement of shares with unspecified foreign investors. 
The following month, Switzerland-based advisory firm Turicum Investment Management said in a report that VPBank is expected to raise about $700 million to $900 million from the sale of the newly issued stake.
At current market prices, a 5 per cent stake would be worth about $425 million.
When SMBC announced the 2023 deal, it said the investment would allow the bank to provide additional financial services to Japanese clients and multinational firms operating in Vietnam.
The Southeast Asian nation hosts major export-oriented manufacturing operations run by Japanese, Korean and Western firms, including Honda, Samsung and Intel.
SMBC also said at the time that the investment would help strengthen VPBank's retail banking business, including wealth management and credit cards. 
One objective of the planned increase in ownership is to give SMBC easier access to Vietnamese customers, including in the insurance and credit markets, one of the sources said.
Export-reliant Vietnam targets annual growth of at least 10 per cent through 2030, betting on infrastructure spending and rising consumption from its expanding middle class.
Japan's Mizuho Financial Group and MUFG Bank, along with South Korea's KEB Hana Bank, hold strategic minority stakes in major Vietnamese lenders.
Foreign ownership of Vietnamese banks is generally capped at 30 per cent, while an individual foreign investor, and its affiliates, is typically limited to a 20 per cent stake.
VPBank is an exception, having been allowed a higher foreign ownership ceiling of 49 per cent after it participated in the restructuring of a weaker lender, GPBank.

Source: Reuters

items.title: トランプ氏、献金の見返りに石油業界規制緩和＝民主党報告書
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Richard Cowan　Timothy Gardner

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Richard Cowan　Timothy Gardner

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米民主党の有力上院議員２人は２４日、トランプ大統領が２０２４年大統領選の候補者だった当時、石油・ガス企業に１０億ドルの献金を求め、その後これらの企業が税制優遇措置や補助金、環境規制の緩和という見返りを受けたとする報告書を公表した。

報告書をまとめたのは上院民主党トップのシューマー院内総務と環境委員会の民主党筆頭委員であるシェルドン・ホワイトハウス上院議員。米環境保護局（ＥＰＡ）による規制緩和に関する１９件の調査、他の９機関に関する１３件の調査、「汚染企業」８８社に関する１３件の調査を基に作成した。

それによると、トランプ氏がエネルギー企業に献金を要請した後に追跡された数億ドル規模の選挙資金は、消費者による化石燃料購入を促進する政策を通じて、数千億ドル規模の減税や歳入増につながったという。

報告書は「勤労世帯がエネルギー価格の上昇、公共サービスの弱体化、気候変動と健康被害の長期的コストを通じて負担を強いられる一方、石油大手の経営幹部と株主は見返りを享受している」とし、「これは本質的に、巨大な富の移転だ」と指摘した。

ホワイトハウスのロジャース報道官は「両民主党議員はいわゆる『グリーン』エネルギー産業との結びつきについて自らを省みるべきだ」と反論し、「彼らは『グリーン・ニュー・スキャム（詐欺）』の名の下に、数十億ドルの米国民の税金を無駄にした」と主張した。

items.title: How firms linked to sanctioned Chinese cotton giant sell clothes to U.S.
items.author: Francesco Guarascio, Alessandro Parodi, Phuong Nguyen, Farah Master
items.creator: Francesco Guarascio, Alessandro Parodi, Phuong Nguyen, Farah Master
items.summary: In July, a ton of cotton shirts was unloaded at the port of Los Angeles after a trip from southern Vietnam.
items.body:
In July, a ton of cotton shirts was unloaded at the port of Los Angeles after a trip from southern Vietnam.
The apparel had come from a garment manufacturer closely related to Chinese textile giant Esquel Group, shipment records show. Esquel has effectively been banned from selling to U.S. customers since November 2024, when Washington sanctioned the company over alleged links with forced labor programs in China’s Xinjiang region. Hong Kong-based Esquel denies the allegations.
Since Esquel’s blacklisting, three garment makers in Vietnam have continued to source much of its cotton while also selling products to the U.S., the records show. The three manufacturers all had ties with Esquel that ran beyond a shared supply chain: All three used geographical variations on the name Esquel Garment Manufacturing Vietnam until they were rebranded in October 2022.
Edgar Tung, who served as Esquel’s chief executive between 2021 and 2022, was also listed in corporate filings as an owner’s representative at the three makers. The records show that the garment makers were owned by the same three offshore firms before and after they were renamed.
The connections detailed by Reuters are “likely sufficient” for customs authorities to conclude that the manufacturers operate within Esquel’s ecosystem, said former Assistant U.S. Trade Representative Joshua Kagan, now an attorney with Washington firm Kelley Drye & Warren, who reviewed the news agency’s findings.
Reuters could not establish whether the products sent by the Vietnamese makers to the U.S. contained cotton that was produced by Esquel Group or in Xinjiang, the far western region of China that is [USN:KCN0UQ002 TEXT:"home to some 20% of global cotton production"]. The three manufacturers also source from entities other than Esquel, which shipment data show was for years their biggest supplier. It is, however, industry practice to blend cotton from different sources together, two supply-chain experts and two U.S. trade lawyers told Reuters.
Esquel Group and a representative for the Vietnamese makers — An Loi Apparel, Tessellation Binh Duong and Tessellation Hoa Binh — did not respond to requests for comment about their relationship and exports to the U.S.
Tung also did not respond to questions.
The three garment makers together have exported at least $5 million in cotton goods to the U.S. since Esquel was sanctioned. Details of the firms' U.S. sales haven't been previously reported.
A spokesperson for U.S. Customs and Border Protection, which is responsible for enforcing the forced labor sanctions, did not comment on Reuters findings but said that the agency encourages companies to either remove suppliers that use forced labor or require them to change their practices.
The clothing that the Vietnamese manufacturers shipped to the U.S. was made for brands including Japanese retail giant Muji (7453.T) and New Zealand menswear label Rodd & Gunn. The companies confirmed they sourced from those makers.
Shipment data show that Muji USA has sourced apparel from at least one of the garment makers since it was known as Esquel Garment Manufacturing. The company, however, told Reuters it was not aware of any links between the makers and Esquel Group. It said that it plans to conduct an audit of one of the plants this year and that its suppliers have signed a pledge not to use forced labor. Muji did not say if it planned to take further action based on Reuters findings.
Rodd & Gunn confirmed that it sourced from two of the garment makers. The label also said it was not aware of any connection between its suppliers and Esquel, and shipment data show it was not a customer of the garment makers before they were rebranded. Rodd & Gunn said it required its partners to source exclusively from the U.S., Brazil and Australia and that it collects documentation to verify the chain of custody. It also did not say if it planned to take any further action.
ESQUEL TO TESSELLATION Esquel Group describes itself as a “seed to shirt” enterprise. Its operations in recent years have spanned agriculture research labs, cotton mills and apparel factories.
The company has a long history of operating in Xinjiang, where cotton has been grown for hundreds of years. The region is also home to millions of Uyghurs, a mostly Muslim ethnic minority that United Nations experts and the U.S. [USN:P8N3WC04S TEXT:"say have been persecuted"] by China’s Han-Chinese-dominated government.
The alleged abuses include the detention of Uyghurs in internment camps where the U.S. government says they are forced to produce textiles for minimal pay. China says the allegations are baseless.
Textiles from the region flowed freely to the West until around 2020, when U.S. regulators sanctioned one of Esquel’s Xinjiang mills over its alleged use of Uyghur forced labor. Esquel said that major customers, including Tommy Hilfiger owner PVH, subsequently moved to pause or cancel orders.
PVH did not respond to a request for comment.
Esquel challenged the blacklisting, but a federal court in Washington quashed its application for emergency relief. An appellate court upheld that ruling in July 2022.
Esquel Group a few months later spun off its consumer brands and tech operations into an entity known as Tessellation Group. Senior executives at the spinoff include Dee Poon, the Harvard-educated daughter of Esquel chairperson Marjorie Yang. Neither responded to requests for comment.
At around the same time, the Vietnamese garment manufacturers ditched their Esquel branding and were renamed Tessellation. One of the makers later changed its name again to An Loi Apparel.
Reuters could not determine if Tessellation Group was the ultimate owner of the three garment makers that were also named Tessellation. Tessellation Group did not respond to questions about its relationship with Esquel and the garment makers.
When Reuters visited Tessellation Hoa Binh’s plant, six workers who said they had been employed there before the garment maker was rebranded told reporters there had been no change in their management or working practices.
The three garment makers continued to maintain close commercial ties with Esquel Group. Esquel sent about 70% of the $34 million in cotton it exported from China between November 2024 and June 2026 to the three garment makers, customs data show.
Tung, the former Esquel chief, became Tessellation Group’s CEO in January 2023.
ENFORCEMENT GAPS Washington’s crackdown on textile imports from Xinjiang intensified after the 2020 blacklisting of Esquel’s mill.
The Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, which bars virtually all imports linked to Xinjiang, was signed into law in 2021. Esquel Group was named a listed entity under the law in November 2024, a designation which authorizes customs officers to presume its goods are produced by forced labor unless proven otherwise.
CBP, however, does not inspect all goods entering the country. Between November 2024 and June 2026, it detained for inspection under the Uyghur forced labor law roughly $2.6 million of the $28 billion in apparel shipped from Vietnam to the United States. More than half of the detained goods, in terms of value, were subsequently released.
That level of enforcement has drawn scrutiny from Democratic lawmakers. In a letter to CBP leaders in December 2025, the U.S. lawmakers said that inspections have “dropped drastically in recent months despite no evidence that shipments of goods prohibited by the law have slowed.”
CBP, which is also responsible for collecting tariff duties, has been under immense pressure from the unprecedented tariffs imposed by the Trump administration since 2025, said Jessica Rivkin, a Washington-based attorney at law firm OFW and a specialist in the Uyghur forced labor law.
These include the tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump in July on goods from dozens of countries, which Washington said had adopted lax safeguards against forced labor.
A CBP spokesperson said it prioritizes both enforcement of forced labor laws and the implementation of tariffs. The Trump administration continues to make efforts to keep forced labor goods out of U.S. supply chains, the spokesperson said, including [USN:S0N42W01N TEXT:"this year’s designation"] of 43 companies under the Uyghur forced labor law.

items.title: Trump's Casual Threat of Annihilating Iran Ramps Up a Genuine Danger
items.author: Marc Champion
items.creator: Marc Champion
items.summary: Visiting mixed villages in former Yugoslavia before it careened toward its violent breakup in 1992, I spoke to neighbors who dismissed the idea of a coming war as simply unimaginable. But as each tuned in to the increasingly nationalistic TV stations of their respective Serbian or Croatian capitals, they were bombarded by commentary posing as news that recalled historical wrongs and alleged plots for coming atrocities. Steeped in these bilious alternative realties, the neighbors stopped talking.

items.title: Anthropic seeks 50.1% voting control for co-founders ahead of IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: The company is also planning to give employees a special class of stock that would serve as tie-breaker votes on some corporate issues ...
items.body: Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the planning. The new arrangement, which emulates a founder-control structure at Palantir, would award the co-founders a special class of shares giving them collective voting control in most corporate matters, and would apply as long as three of the seven co-founders retain a minimum number of shares in the company, according to the report. Anthropic did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. One significant exception to the founders' control is the election of the members on Anthropic's board, which has seven seats, one of which is currently vacant, according to the report. The company is also planning to give employees a special class of stock that would serve as tie-breaker votes on some corporate issues, the report said. Anthropic, which has been viewed for months as the leader in enterprise AI, is preparing for what could be one of the biggest IPOs on record. The company could push its IPO to after the US midterm elections in November, with the poll not expected to have a major impact on the offering, Reuters reported earlier this month. The Claude maker had raised $65 billion at a post-money valuation of $965 billion in May.

items.title: Pakistan thwarts border attack, several Taliban dead, security sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pakistan has thwarted an attempted Afghan attack in its border area of Gulistan, killing several members of the Afghan Taliban, Pakistani security sources said on Friday, without detailing the planned attack.
items.body:
Pakistan has thwarted an attempted Afghan attack in its border area of Gulistan, killing several members of the Afghan Taliban, Pakistani security sources said on Friday, without detailing the planned attack.
The incident comes as tensions have resurfaced between the allies-turned-foes after[USN:L6N4330AE TEXT:" three months of relative calm"], following an [USN:L1N45A0CA TEXT:"attack on a police facility "]in northwestern Pakistan last week that killed at least 24 people.
The latest "retaliatory action" was taken against an attempt to enter Pakistani territory and commit aggression, the security sources said.
Intermittent firing was still underway between the Afghan Taliban and security forces, who remained fully alert in the border area, they said.
The Afghan Taliban did not immediately comment on the Pakistan allegations.
Pakistan's air force [USN:L6N45G07E TEXT:"struck 10 locations "]in Afghanistan on Thursday that Islamabad said were being used to launch and store drones, .
Pakistan also carried out airstrikes in the Afghanistan-Pakistan border region on Monday,[USN:L1N45D02P TEXT:" killing 28 militants"], while Afghan Taliban officials accused it of killing three civilians in overnight strikes.
Afghanistan and Pakistan have increasingly been at odds over expanding insurgencies in their western and northwestern border region.
Islamabad accuses Kabul of harboring Islamist militants who stage cross-border attacks. Afghanistan's Taliban government denies this, saying militancy is Pakistan's internal problem.
The Muslim neighbors engaged in their worst fighting in years in February, and more than 400 people were killed in a [USN:L1N40103T TEXT:"Pakistani airstrike on Kabul"] in March as tensions persisted.
The Afghan Taliban has said the airstrike targeted a drug rehabilitation centre, but Islamabad denied the charge, saying it "precisely targeted military installations and terrorist support infrastructure".

items.title: マクロスコープ：米中会談は「成果に乏しかった」　日本政府内の楽観と警戒感
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara　Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara　Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 米中首脳会談が２４日（日本時間２５日）開かれたことを受け、日本政府は情報収集を急ぐ構えだ。現時点で米中両国からの発信が限られる中、政府内には台湾問題などで具体的な成果に乏しかったとして「楽観」する声が広がっている。一方、米中首脳会談は年内にあと２回開かれるとも言われる。経済、安全保障両面での過度な米中接近への警戒感は、日本政府内で依然として消えていない。

＜「成果はミニマムだったのでは」＞

会談から数時間後の２５日朝、複数の日本政府関係者はロイターの取材に、「情報収集中だ」と口をそろえた。外務省幹部は、今回の首脳会談で大きな焦点だった台湾問題について中国側が「米国が台湾問題を慎重に扱うことを望む」（国営新華社通信）と発信する一方、トランプ米大統領のコメントについて触れていないことを挙げ、「トランプ氏から何か言質が取れれば中国は大々的に報じたはずだ。それがないということは、成果はミニマムだったのではないか」と推察した。

また、米中の貿易休戦に当たる「釜山合意」の延長も２カ月という短期間にとどまった。別の政府関係者は、トランプ氏が習氏を空港まで出迎えるなど異例の対応をしつつも、具体的な成果が見えないと指摘。「トランプ氏にとって目下の課題は米国内の物価上昇とイラン情勢だ。中国とは良好な関係をアピールできればそれでよかったのだろう」と話し、あくまで表面的な会談にとどまったとの見方を示した。

トランプ氏が第２次世界大戦時の米中関係に触れ、両国が「同盟国だった」と発言したことについても、日本政府は静観の構えだ。前出の外務省幹部は「そもそも米中は同盟関係ではなかった」と強調。日本政府として「気分がよいものではない」と述べながらも、「事実誤認を含む発言にいちいち反応しても仕方がない」と語った。

＜「引き続き米国と歩調を合わせればいい」＞

日本政府内にはもともと、「米中首脳が大きな合意を結ばないことが、日本にとって最も良いストーリーだ」（外務省筋）との見方があった。両首脳が良好な関係のアピールに終始しているうちは慌てる必要がないとの姿勢だ。前出とは別の外務省幹部は「今回も何とか想定内の結果に収まったと思っている」と述べた。

米中首脳会談は国際会議に合わせて年内にあと２回あると言われる。１１月には米中間選挙が予定され、結果次第でトランプ氏の対中戦略がどう変化するのか見通せない部分も大きい。ただ、政府関係者は米が重要鉱物のサプライチェーンや人工知能（ＡＩ）などで「脱中国」の動きを強めている点を挙げ、「その方針をトランプ氏が変えるとは思えない。日本は引き続き米国と歩調を合わせていればいい」と話した。

とはいえ、現時点で今回の会談について米から詳細な情報がもたらされているわけではない。５月に北京で開かれた前回の首脳会談では、習氏が高市早苗首相を名指しで批判したことが後日、明らかになっている。米の台湾への武器輸出についても、トランプ氏と習氏の間で実際にどこまで「合意」が進んでいるのかはいまも判然としていない。木原稔官房長官は２５日午前の記者会見で、「引き続き高い関心をもって注視していくとともに、米国と緊密に連携していく」と語った。

＜「日本外交は成り立たない」＞

今回の首脳会談の成果や日本が取るべき対応について、専門家はどう見ているのか。

上智大学の前嶋和弘教授（米国政治）は、今回の米中首脳会談で最も印象的だったのが、トランプ氏による習氏の厚遇ぶりだったと話す。空港までの出迎えやタラップ下の赤じゅうたんの演出、ホワイトハウスでの歓迎式典などだ。米国内では、中国を最大のライバル、競争相手と見る向きや、場合によっては「敵」と捉える意見がある中、「これからの世界は米中という『Ｇ２』が決めていくんだというトランプ氏の意識が表れた対応だった」と述べた。

現在の米中のパワーバランスは、レアアース（希土類）の対米輸出や米国産大豆の対中輸出、イランや北朝鮮との仲介など、特に経済・外交両面でトランプ氏が習氏側に「頭を下げなければならない課題が多い段階にある」と指摘。「現状では米から中国にお願いすることばかりだ。トランプ氏はとにかく習氏を刺激するのは避けなければならないと考えて対応したのではないか」と分析した。

一方、「トランプ氏が持つ最大のカード」である台湾への武器輸出の扱いを巡っては、中国と事前協議しないというレーガン政権以降の原則を曲げても「譲歩」する可能性が残ると指摘。国内外に影響の大きい取引であればあるほど、「情報は表に出てこない」とし、状況がどう動くのかを注視する必要があるとの認識を示した。

日本が取るべき対応はどうか。前嶋氏はＡＩからイラン情勢の行方までを米中が支配する時代になれば、「日本は両国の真ん中に入り込む外交を展開しなければならない」と訴える。日中関係改善の糸口が見当たらない中、高市政権が「中国と話ができる関係」を再構築し、米中の間で存在感を発揮できるかが問われていると語った。「世界は変わっている。中国との接近を隠さないトランプ政権下では、これまでのような米国一辺倒では日本外交は成り立たない」

（鬼原民幸、竹本能文　編集：橋本浩）

items.title: Trump's no ‘guardrails’ to Xi ‘human control’: Why AI is at the heart of US-China rivalry
items.author: Akriti Anand
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has increasingly framed China as a “competitor” in the AI race. He said on social media that he wants to keep AI “exactly where it is.”
items.body: While US President Trump said he had no intention of negotiating limits on AI development, Chinese President Xi Jinping emphasised in his opening address at the White House during US state visit on Thursday that the two superpowers — US and China — have a responsibility to ensure that humans always operate AI.“We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good and ensure that a development of AI is always under human control and serves the well being of the people,” the Chinese leader said.Xi's comments came days after Trump dismissed claims that AI will “destroy the world” as “hoax.”During his speech at the UN General Assembly, President Trump reiterated that his administration "will only encourage super intelligence... the United States leads the world in super intelligence and will continue to do so safely and responsibly.”In a social media post on Thursday, Trump said he wants to keep AI “exactly where it is,” suggesting he would stand by his longstanding opposition to guardrails."A big day with President Xi of China. Super Intelligence (SI) will be a big topic of discussion, but I want to leave it exactly where it is. That is China’s position also. Our guardrail is the DOJ! President DJT," he wrote on TRUTH Social. Why AI is at the heart of US-China rivalryAI, its capabilities and safety came into focus as tech giants continue to develop advance artificial intelligence, while flagging risks posed by AI to humanity.AI industry leaders have been split over how fast companies should develop the increasingly powerful technology, as Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk call for a coordinated slowdown.Meta's Mark Zuckerberg appeared to break away from other AI leaders, favouring market-led safeguards, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismissed the need for new regulations.At the United Nations Security Council on Wednesday, Amodei said, according to Reuters, that if managed poorly, he believed "AI could be a risk to humanity as a whole.""For all the differences of the people in this room, we must put aside those differences in order to confront this global opportunity and global threat that is being presented to us at the same time. No leader, no company and no nation can manage this alone," Amodei said.Meanwhile, Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue highlighted the role of AI tools in defending against cyberattacks, citing an incident in which US OpenAI's AI agents breached Hugging Face's infrastructure after escaping their testing environment2. US vs China: Who'll win?Trump has increasingly framed China as a "competitor" in the AI race. Back in 2025, Trump had said, “...we're here today because we believe that America's destiny is to dominate every industry and be the first in every technology, and that includes being the world's number-one superpower in artificial intelligence. And we are way ahead of China, I have to say...”"...We're leading China in AI by a lot," Trump had said in July this year. '"Whoever wins AI...WINS...that group wins!," he said recently.Meanwhile, Chinese President Xi Jinping cast Beijing as the champion of a new global AI order. According to a report in July, Chinese state media increasingly portrayed Beijing's AI strategy as a response to what it calls a US-led attempt to erect an "AI Iron Curtain."According to Aljazeera's analysis, the US dominates AI spending and computing power, but China is ahead in research and closing the gap on advanced models.Analysts told CBS News earlier that mutual distrust between the US and China, as much as the technology itself, could lead humanity "off a cliff."3. Pax SilicaLast year, Washington launched the Pax Silica initiative aimed at securing supply chains for AI models, semiconductors and critical minerals, amid a fierce technology rivalry with Beijing. India joined the group in February.In July, Chinese President Xi Jinping launched a rival "World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization", promoting his country's open-weight technology as a challenge to US influence over the fast-moving sector.Kazakhstan is the only country so far known to have joined both initiatives, setting off alarm bells in Washington, Reuters reported in August.4. AI explicitly linked to national securityThe US government has described AI as a technology with implications not just for the economy but also for national security and military capabilities.In January 2025, the US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) said advanced AI capabilities depend on supercomputing and advanced semiconductors and can improve military decision-making, planning and logistics. This was cited as a reason for restricting China's access to advanced chips.5. US restricted China’s ability to access advanced semiconductorsEarlier, the US has restricted China’s ability to access advanced semiconductors for training AI models, and criticized Chinese companies for allegedly taking part in illicit distillation of American AI capabilities.Semiconductors are strategic and uniquely important electronic devices. They are fundamental to most industrial and national security activities and serve as essential building blocks of other technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI).According to the US Congress, since 2018, the US government has sought to strengthen US export controls of advanced semiconductors with the stated intent of both restricting PRC (China) access to the technologies and ability to produce advanced chips, and curtailing PRC access to related computing and AI applications.

items.title: Hormuz commodity ship transits fall to nine, shiptracking data shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Vessel transits at the Strait of Hormuz fell on Thursday to 9, compared with the previous day's 14, preliminary shiptracking data showed on Friday.
items.body:
Vessel transits at the Strait of Hormuz fell on Thursday to 9, compared with the previous day's 14, preliminary shiptracking data showed on Friday.
Of those, eight ships exited, according to the data.
The 10-day average of transits is 18.
Some vessels may be sailing through the waterway with their transponders turned off and are not considered in the counts.
Of the eight exits, one was a ballast very large gas carrier and one was a laden very large crude carrier (VLCC).
The rest of the exits were made by Panamax, Supramax, short-range and medium-range tankers.
The vessel that entered the strait was a dry bulk handymax carrier.
Before the Iran war started on February 28, the strait typically handled about 125 large, commercial vessels per day, including tankers, gas carriers, bulkers and container vessels, accounting for some 20% of the world’s daily crude oil and liquefied natural gas supply.
At the Bab el-Mandeb strait, ship transits on Thursday were little changed from Wednesday at 26, with 12 ships entering and 14 ships exiting, Kpler data showed.
Of the ships that entered, one was a laden VLCC carrying Iraqi Basrah crude bound for Egypt with its transponder switched on.

items.title: India's Welspun US unit wins $412.5 million pipe supply order
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indian steel pipe maker Welspun Corp said on Friday that its US unit won a $412.5 million pipe supply order, as investments in energy infrastructure and industrial activity boost demand.
items.body:
Indian steel pipe maker Welspun Corp (WGSR.NS) said on Friday that its US unit won a $412.5 million pipe supply order, as investments in energy infrastructure and industrial activity boost demand.
The order, for pipes commonly used in oil and gas and water pipelines, will be executed between fiscal years 2028 and 2029.
This contract lifts Welspun's global order book to a record $4.7 billion, underscoring strong demand from energy companies and utilities investing in LNG, oil and gas, and power infrastructure projects globally.
Welspun will manufacture the pipes at its upgraded mill in Arkansas, the company said.
The latest contract follows a record [USN:L4N44I061 TEXT:"$1.8 billion"] pipe supply order the company secured in August this year to supply pipes from its US manufacturing facility.
Welspun's manufacturing facility in Arkansas has been central to its North America expansion plans and is positioned to meet demand from oil and gas, LNG export, and hydrogen pipeline projects.

items.title: Bijan Robinson, Drake London lead Falcons to dominant win over Packers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Bijan Robinson ran for 194 yards and two scores and quarterback Michael Penix Jr. returned from injury to ignite Atlanta's stagnant offense, leading the visiting Falcons to a 35-14 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Thursday night.
items.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Bijan Robinson ran for 194 yards and two scores and quarterback Michael Penix Jr. returned from injury to ignite Atlanta's stagnant offense, leading the visiting Falcons to a 35-14 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Thursday night.
Penix did not play in Atlanta's first two games this season as he was still recovering from a torn ACL sustained last November. The third-year QB completed 18 of 25 passes for 256 yards with one touchdown and one interception.
Half of those completions were to Drake London, who had nine catches for a career-high 194 yards.
Robinson, who carried 29 times and had runs of 55 and 31 yards, finished a yard short of his career high of 195 yards, set in 2025 against the Rams.
The loss prevented Green Bay (1-2) from setting a new NFL record for consecutive home-opener victories. The Packers had won 13 home openers in a row, matching the Miami Dolphins' streak from 1976 to 1988.
Atlanta (1-2), which had scored just 16 points total in its first two games, erased an early 7-0 deficit with 27 consecutive points.
Zach Harrison blocked Trey Smack's 47-yard field goal attempt that would have brought Green Bay even at 10-all. Penix then directed a 63-yard touchdown drive, hitting Austin Hooper with a 5-yard scoring toss to put the Falcons up by 17-7 with 59 seconds left in the half.
Green Bay's first drive of the second half ended in the red zone on Jordan Love's incompletion on fourth-and-1 at the Atlanta 8. The Falcons responded with a 92-yard drive, going in front 24-7 on Brian Robinson Jr.'s 7-yard run off the left side.
Penix hit London with a 68-yard pass to set up Nick Folk's 31-yard field goal that put Atlanta in front 27-7 with just under 11 minutes left.
Love answered with a 15-yard touchdown pass to Matthew Golden to pull Green Bay within 27-14. Bijan Robinson's 2-yard touchdown run followed by a two-point conversion put Atlanta up 35-14.
Love completed 28 of 53 passes for 312 yards with two touchdowns and one interception, but the Packers managed just 17 yards on the ground on nine carries.
Green Bay took a 7-0 lead midway through the first quarter with a nine-play, 87-yard drive that was capped by Love's 4-yard touchdown pass to Christian Watson.
Bijan Robinson set up the tying touchdown with a 55-yard run to the Green Bay 5. Two plays later, he scored from 3 yards out to make it 7-7 with 1:32 left in the first period.
Folk's 44-yard field goal put the Falcons in front 10-7 with 4:48 left in the half.
--Jim Hoehn, Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - ラスベガスでカジノホテルなどを運営するＭＧＭリゾーツ・インターナショナルは米メディアのピープルに対する買収提案を検討している。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２４日報じた。

米富豪のバリー・ディラー氏が率いるピープルは前日、ＭＧＭリゾーツへの買収提案を撤回していた。

ピープルの株価は時間外取引で９％上昇した。

ＷＳＪが関係者の話として伝えたところによると、ＭＧＭは買収手続きを進める決定を下した場合、数日中にも提案を行う可能性がある。 

ピープルはＭＧＭの株式約２７％を保有する筆頭株主で、その保有株の評価額はピープル地震の時価総額にほぼ匹敵する。買収が実現すれば、ＭＧＭが長年の筆頭株主の買収を目指す異例の動きとなる。

ピープルはデジタルメディア事業を手掛ける持ち株会社で、「ピープル」「フード＆ワイン」「サザン・リビング」「デーリー・ビースト」などのブランドを保有する。第２・四半期決算では、出版事業の収益性が改善していることが示された。

items.title: 米モルガン・スタンレー、アジアの案件リスト漏洩　メール誤送信
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kane Wu　Julie Zhu

[香港 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kane Wu　Julie Zhu

[香港 ２４日 ロイター] - アジアのフィナンシャルスポンサー部門を担当する米モルガン・スタンレーのバンカーが、顧客に送った電子メールで、進行中の案件一覧（案件パイプライン）を誤って流出させたことが、事情に詳しい関係者６人の話で分かった。週次で顧客に送っているメールに、フィナンシャルスポンサー部門の案件パイプラインを誤って添付した。

同社の広報担当は２４日、ロイターへの電子メールでの回答で「当社は顧客情報の機密保持を極めて重視している。今回の不注意による情報流出に対処するため速やかに措置を講じ、引き続き関係者と協議している」と述べた。

ロイターが確認したメールのスクリーンショットによると、バンカーはメールを撤回して謝罪。受信者に対して添付ファイルを削除するとともに、回覧しないよう求めた。

リストは２１日付で、大中華圏、韓国、東南アジア、インド、欧州・中東・アフリカ（ＥＭＥＡ）地域における進行中の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）、合併・買収（Ｍ＆Ａ）、ブロックトレード（大口相対取引）の案件が約６０件含まれていた。このほか、提案段階（ピッチング）の案件が５０件超、保留中の案件が３０件近く含まれていた。

items.title: India central bank likely steps in before market open to support rupee, traders say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's central bank likely sold dollars before the local spot market opened on Friday, four traders told Reuters, helping the rupee hold stronger than the key psychological 96-per-dollar level.
items.body:
India's central bank likely sold dollars before the local spot market opened on Friday, four traders told Reuters, helping the rupee hold stronger than the key psychological 96-per-dollar level.
The rupee rose to 95.88 per dollar on the interbank order-matching system, paring its decline from 95.97 in early deals.
Traders said the central bank likely intervened to shore up the rupee at a time when trading liquidity is low, helping the intervention have a magnified impact.

items.title: テスラ、電動トラック「セミ」の納車開始　発表から9年
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Abhirup Roy

[サンフランシスコ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Abhirup Roy

[サンフランシスコ ２４日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは今週、大型トラック「セミ」の納車を開始する。同社幹部がネバダ州スパークスの工場で明らかにした。イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が最初に発表してから約９年後の納車開始となる。

長距離貨物輸送向けに設計されたセミは、電動セダンや多目的スポーツ車（ＳＵＶ）で知られるテスラの市場を商用貨物輸送分野に広げることになる。米国ではディーゼル燃料（軽油）価格が記録的水準に高騰している。

テスラは２４日に同工場で開催したウェブ配信イベントで、生産計画や価格については明らかにせず、ネバダ工場で年間５万台のセミを生産する計画を改めて示した。

マスク氏はイベントに出席しなかった。録画されたビデオメッセージで顧客に発注を促し、「待機リストは既にかなりの長さになっている」と述べた。

顧客であるペプシコ、ＤＨＬ、ＵＳフーズなどが壇上に招かれ、各社のロゴが入ったトラックが屋外に並べられて披露された。

長距離仕様車は貨物を積載した状態で、１回の充電で５００マイル走行できる。テスラでセミのエンジニアリング責任者を務めるダン・プリーストリー氏は「実走行で５００マイルだ。顧客が検証済みだ」と述べた。標準仕様車の航続距離は３２５マイル。

セミは２０１７年に初めて公開され、生産開始は１９年に予定されていた。

最終的に、量産ラインから初号車が出荷されたのは今年４月で、量産開始は年内とされていた。しかし、テスラの７月の株主向け書簡では、セミの生産開始時期を２６年とし、年内の量産開始という従来予想を撤回した。

テスラは２２年終盤、米国内でペプシコなどの顧客への限定的な納車を開始した。その後、遅延や競争の激化、米国のＥＶ政策の転換により、需要への懸念が高まっていた。

items.title: Japan's bond 'falling knife' stalls repatriation rush
items.author: Ankur Banerjee, Kevin Buckland, Saqib Ahmed
items.creator: Ankur Banerjee, Kevin Buckland, Saqib Ahmed
items.summary: The tide of Japanese money returning home has begun, but a much larger repatriation of overseas assets is being held back by uncertainty over where Japanese bond yields will peak and how much further the central bank will have to raise interest rates.
items.body:
The tide of Japanese money returning home has [USN:L6N44U1FN TEXT:"begun"], but a much larger repatriation of overseas assets is being held back by uncertainty over where Japanese bond yields will peak and how much further the [USN:L4N44Z01M TEXT:"central bank"] will have to raise interest rates.
The [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] has likely done enough for now to [USN:L6N45F0DN TEXT:"ward off"] another wave of speculative [USN:L4N451055 TEXT:"bets"] against the [USN:L1N44W09D TEXT:"currency"], with a rate hike last week, pledges to tackle inflation and, reportedly, a [USN:L1N45A0NK TEXT:"rate check"] in the foreign exchange market.
Yet major investors remain reluctant to commit heavily to domestic bonds while yields are still climbing and policymakers offer few clues about how much further rates must rise. Two dovish dissenting votes at last week's meeting and a further selloff in bonds this week only reinforced the uncertainty.
That caution is slowing capital repatriation, leaving one of the world's biggest pools of overseas capital largely parked abroad for now and capping the scope for a sustained yen rally with potentially far-reaching effects across global markets.
"The fast-money carry trade has already been unwound; the slow-money one has not started," said Shoki Omori, fixed income strategist at Deutsche Bank in Tokyo.
"What is left is structural: Japanese pensions... and households holding overseas assets unhedged," which for the yen means the era of relentless declines may be over, but a durable strengthening trend has yet to begin.
The yen has given up most of its sharp gains from early September and traded near 159 per dollar on Friday, not far from the 157 level, which is the median six-month projection of analysts polled by Reuters earlier this month.
The move leaves the yen down only about 1% for the year, though after years of losses it touched a near four-decade low in July just short of 164 per dollar.
Data shows short sellers have retreated in tandem with the price, with speculative positioning in the yen flipping from a deep net short to the largest net long since July 2025 at $9.7 billion in just the first two weeks of September.
Another challenge for the yen, analysts say, is that major central banks have almost all begun raising rates to tackle inflationary pressure from the Middle East war, suggesting interest-rate differentials with Japan are unlikely to narrow soon.
'NOBODY WANTS TO CATCH THE FALLING KNIFE' The bond maths keeping more Japanese money at home is simple: benchmark 10-year JGB yields have surged two percentage points in under two years to a 30-year high above 3%, eroding the appeal of overseas debt.
A hedged Treasury position pays a Japanese investor less than domestic bonds, according to Deutsche's Omori.
Investors bought 4.8 trillion yen of sovereign debt last month, the largest net purchase in three months, according to Barclays' analysis of Japan Securities Dealers Association data, with banks and insurers among the buyers.
HSBC estimates Japanese banks have sold about $70 billion of foreign bonds this year, versus purchases of $35 billion last year, a retreat felt across markets from Europe to Australia.
Yet life insurers, which hold 438.6 trillion yen ($2.78 trillion) in assets, move slowly and the scale of any allocation shift there is not clear from broad portfolio figures published by the Life Insurance Association of Japan.
"It's early stage in terms of Japanese repatriating," said Aaron Hurd, senior portfolio manager in the currency group at State Street Global Advisors.
"I think the repatriation story can start to pick up steam in 2027," he said. "It is very important for investors to get some sense that Japanese yields have put in their high. Nobody wants to catch the falling knife."
That calculus could change quickly. Japan's finance minister has encouraged the $1.8 trillion Government Pension Investment Fund to increase allocations to local markets, and analysts say a pivot by the fund could spur others to do the same.
"If the GPIF makes it official, or we see the hard data, that domestic JGB allocation actually went up ... it's going to force the other domestic investors to also make changes to their domestic allocations, if they haven't already," said Paresh Upadhyaya, director of market strategy at Pioneer Investments.
Still, as US yields rise alongside expectations of further tightening by the Federal Reserve, the BOJ may struggle to keep pace or drive a sustained yen rally.
"Until that stabilises it's probably not a good time for the BOJ to make another move on the hawkish side, or for the currency market to unwind dollar/yen positions," said Naka Matsuzawa, chief macro strategist at Nomura Securities.
"What we need is someone like lifers, starting to see the end of (interest rate) neutralisation by BOJ and start to repatriate their money - that could cause the yen to go higher than 150, I think. But it's not time for that."
($1 = 157.8700 yen)

items.title: 米俳優サランドン氏ら逮捕、国連本部前でイスラエル首相に抗議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Tsvetkova

[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maria Tsvetkova

[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨークの国連本部前で２４日、イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相の国連総会演説を前に抗議活動を行っていた俳優や政治家ら少なくとも３０人が警察に逮捕された。

逮捕されたのはオスカー俳優のスーザン・サランドン氏、エミー賞を受賞したハンナ・アインビンダー氏、民主党の連邦下院議員候補ダリアリザ・アビラ・シュバリエ氏、ニューヨーク市議のチー・オセイ氏ら。

ネタニヤフ氏はこの日行った国連総会の一般討論演説で、中東地域における自国の行動を擁護した。総選挙を控えて深まる国際的孤立に対抗する狙いだったが、演説が始まると多数の外交官や各国代表が抗議の意思を示して退席した。

抗議集会を主催したのは、パレスチナ人を支援するユダヤ系活動団体「平和を求めるユダヤ人の声」。約２００人が「爆弾ではなく人々に資金を」「戦争反対」「パレスチナを解放せよ」といったスローガンがプリントされたＴシャツを着て、国連本部前に集まった。

参加者らが交通を妨げたため、警察は拡声器で退去を指示。一部は歩道に移動したが、中心グループは車道に座り込んだままスローガンを唱え続けたため、警察バスに連行された。

items.title: 英消費者信頼感、9月は24年8月以来の高水準＝ＧｆＫ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[２５日 ロイター] - 市場調査会社ＧｆＫが２５日発表した９月の英消費者信頼感指数はマイナス１３となり、８月から１ポイント上昇して２０２４年８月以来約２年ぶりの高水準を記録した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想のマイナス１６を上回った。家計に対する楽観的な見方が強まったことが背景にある。

• 経済見通しに対する消費者の信頼感も２０２４年８月以来の高水準を記録し、家計状況に対する評価は８カ月ぶりの高水準となった。

• ＧｆＫの消費者インサイト担当ディレクター、ニール・ベラミー氏は、インフレ見通しの悪化が家計の重しになり始める可能性があると指摘した。

• 同氏は「総合指数は改善を続けているものの、信頼感は依然としてマイナス圏にとどまっている。インフレやエネルギー・燃料価格の上昇が続く中、近いうちに消費者心理が揺らぐことになるのだろうか」と述べた。

items.title: Scaloni says he did his best to convince Messi to return for Argentina farewell
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football in August.
items.body:
Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni said he "pushed hard" to ensure Lionel Messi would return to the national team for a farewell match soon after announcing his retirement because he was not sure he would be in charge to orchestrate it later.
Messi announced his [USN:L6N44S0US TEXT:"retirement from international football"] in August, just over a month after Argentina were [USN:L6N43L077 TEXT:"beaten 1-0 by Spain"] in the World Cup final.
However, the former Barcelona and Paris St Germain forward was [USN:L6N457191 TEXT:"called up"] weeks later by Scaloni to make a final appearance in a home friendly against Benin at Buenos Aires' Monumental Stadium on October 6.
"I believe that a player like him deserves this. Personally, I did my part because I wanted to be at his farewell," Scaloni told reporters on Thursday.
"Since I don't know if I would be here later, we pushed hard so that he could be in this match. We knew everything he was going through and even so, he put in the desire and effort to want to come and be able to say goodbye with his people, with the people who love him so much.
"If we have to pay tribute, we have to do it at this moment. With him, it will never stop, but later, the magic might not be the same."
Scaloni, who guided Argentina to the 2022 World Cup title and two Copa America triumphs, will be out of his contract in December.
Asked if he had received an update on his future, Scaloni said he would meet with Argentine Football Association president Claudio Tapia in the coming days.
"It is a dream come true, but that doesn't mean I have to cling to the job forever," the 48-year-old said.
"There are certain conditions we need to discuss with the president and we'll see if we can reach an agreement."

items.title: UFC’s return to Madison Square Garden features Ciryl Gane title defense
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ciryl Gane will make his first heavyweight title defense against fourth-ranked contender Josh Hokit as part of the co-main event at UFC 334 on Nov. 14 at Madison Square Garden in New York.
items.body:
Ciryl Gane will make his first heavyweight title defense against fourth-ranked contender Josh Hokit as part of the co-main event at UFC 334 on Nov. 14 at Madison Square Garden in New York.
Almost exactly one year later, UFC will make its first return to Madison Square Garden since Nov. 15, 2025 (UFC 322), when Islam Makhachev defeated Jack Della Maddalena via unanimous decision in that event's headliner.
Gane (14-2, 1 no-contest) took down Alex Pereira via TKO in a title fight his last time out on June 14 at the White House in Washington. He will take on an undefeated upstart in Hokit (10-0), who will be fighting in his first main event.
Gane and Hokit will share top billing with co-main event: Kayla Harrison versus Amanda Nunes.
Harrison (19-1) is the bantamweight champion but faces a steep challenge from Nunes (23-5), considered by many to be the best female fighter in MMA history.
Other announced bouts include fifth-ranked Caio Borralho against Yousri Belgaroui in the middleweight division, No. 12 Uros Medic versus Kevin Holland in a welterweight contest, Bilal Hason facing Luis Gurule in a flyweight bout, and lightweights Drew Dober and Chris Duncan doing battle.
Completing the card are Stephen Thompson-Charles Radtke, Donte Johnson-Baisangur Susurkaev, Jim Miller-Terrance McKinney, Macy Chiasson-Bia Mesquita and Adrian Yanez-Juan Diaz.
This will be the 10th UFC event held at the Garden and the 13th in New York City overall.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ボクシング＝フューリーとジョシュアのヘビー級対決、12月に開催決定
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２４日　ロイター］ - ボクシングのヘビー級、タイソン・フューリー（３８）とアンソニー・ジョシュア（３６）による待望の英国勢対決が、１２月１１日に英国ウェールズのカーディフで開催されることが決まった。プロモーターのトゥルキ・アルシェイク氏が２４日、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）で発表した。

この１０年間の大半において同階級に君臨してきたフューリーとジョシュアだが、これまでは未対戦。両者に勝利したオレクサンドル・ウシクがヘビー級の絶対王者となった。

アルシェイク氏はＸで、「１５年間、誰もこの試合を実現させることができなかった。しかし今、英国のボクシングファンに約束した通り、フューリーとジョシュアの一戦が英国で開催されることを発表できる」と述べた。会場はプリンシパリティ・スタジアムとなる。

アルシェイク氏が所有するリングマガジンの報道によると、フューリーとジョシュアは空位となっているＷＢＡヘビー級スーパー王座をかけて対戦。同ベルトは２０２１年にジョシュアから奪取したウシクが今年６月に返上した。

フューリーは７月にマリウシュ・ヴァフと対戦し、ＴＫＯ勝ち。一方のジョシュアは同月にクリスティアン・プレンガをＫＯで下している。

items.title: ＮＡＴＯ、ロシアの脅威巡り情報共有を強化＝最高司令官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sabine Siebold

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sabine Siebold

[２４日 ロイター] - 北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のグリンケウィッチ欧州連合軍最高司令官（米空軍大将）は２４日、ロイターの電話インタビューで、ロシアとの関連が疑われる一連の破壊工作やその他の事案を受けて、ＮＡＴＯは情報共有を強化していると明らかにした。

グリンケウィッチ氏は、ドイツのライプチヒ・ハレ空港へのドローン攻撃未遂や、ロシアのフリゲート艦がデンマーク軍ヘリコプターに向けてフレア（火炎弾）を発射した事案など、ここ数週間に発生した一連の問題について「懸念すべきことだ」と語った。

ただ同氏は「しかしわれわれは、歴史上最も強力な同盟として、このリスクに対処するために必要な手段と仕組みを備えているという点で、冷静になるとともに自信を持つべきだ」と語った。

ロシアによるＮＡＴＯ加盟国への限定的な攻撃のリスクについて、同氏はＮＡＴＯがそうした事態に十分備えていることを強調した上で、「起こる可能性は低いが、排除することはできない」と述べた。

ロシア政府は、ハイブリッド戦争やＮＡＴＯ加盟国での破壊工作などへの関与を繰り返し否定している。

グリンケウィッチ氏は、米バージニア州ノーフォークのＮＡＴＯ統合軍司令部で行われる司令官交代式典に向かう途中、電話でロイターの取材に応じた。同式典では、米海軍の高官に代わり英国陸軍の高官が司令官に就任する。

ノーフォーク司令部の指揮権を欧州出身の司令官に引き継ぐ措置は、トランプ米大統領が欧州各国に対し、自らの安全保障により大きな責任を負うよう求めていることに沿った、より広範な組織再編の一環だ。

この再編では、ＮＡＴＯナポリ統合軍司令部の指揮も欧州出身の司令官が担うことになる。

グリンケウィッチ氏は、欧州がより大きな役割を担う中でも、米国はＮＡＴＯに対して「重要ではあるが、より限定的な能力」を引き続き提供していくと強調した。

また、欧州にどれだけの米軍兵力が残るのか、あるいはどのような能力が移転される可能性があるのかについて、「あらかじめ決まった結論はない」と語った。欧州には現在、約８万人の米軍兵士が駐留している。

items.title: ブラジル中銀、インフレ率は28年に目標付近へ　追加利下げ観測強まる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Marcela Ayres

[ブラジリア ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Marcela Ayres

[ブラジリア ２４日 ロイター] - ブラジル中央銀行は２４日、次回の金利決定の判断材料となる政策効果の波及時点で、インフレ率が目標の３％付近になるとの見通しを示した。先週の５会合連続の利下げに続き、年内の追加緩和観測が改めて強まった。

四半期ごとの金融政策報告で、１１月の次回会合で焦点となる２０２８年第２・四半期の年間インフレ率を３．１％と予想。２９年第１・四半期まで同水準が続くとした。

中銀は先週、政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き下げて１３．７５％とする一方、今後の措置には含みを残した。

また、２６年の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）伸び率予想を２．０％から１．８％に引き下げ、２７年については初めて１．４％との予想を示した。

政府は２２日、２６年のＧＤＰを２．０％増、２７年を２．３％増と予想していた。

２７年の中銀見通しは、金融政策は引き続き景気抑制的で、供給余力が限られ、外部環境が引き続き極めて不透明なことを前提としている。

また、財政・信用面の刺激策の効果減退と、経済成長に対する農業・採取産業の貢献度がより限定的になることも想定している。

items.title: 焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[ワシントン／サンフランシスコ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[ワシントン／サンフランシスコ ２４日 ロイター] - 高インフレを抑えるために政策金利の引き上げに乗り出した米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、企業が値上げを控える理由としてインフレ期待低下を想定するようになれば、雇用市場に悪影響を与えることなく利上げを進められると考えている。

成功の鍵は物価上昇の要因にあるが、これについては政策立案者の間で議論が分かれている。しかし、ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長の先週の発言や、他の当局者がそれ以降に話した内容を踏まえると、ＦＲＢ当局者は失業率の上昇をほとんど、あるいは全く伴わずに、インフレ率を緩やかに鈍化できると考えていることがうかがえる。

リッチモンド地区連銀のトーマス・バーキン総裁は２３日、「ＦＲＢがインフレ対策に真剣に取り組んでいると人々が考えれば、それは価格設定行動での人々の期待に反映される傾向がある。逆に、ＦＲＢが適切に対処していないと人々が考えれば、それも価格設定行動に反映されるだろう」と言及。自身のマッキンゼー・アンド・カンパニーでのコンサルティング経験を踏まえ、企業内での価格引き上げと市場シェア維持のせめぎ合いについて「インフレを物理的に抑制することも可能だ。需要が減り、供給が増えれば、価格は下がる。また、期待に基づいてインフレを抑制することも可能だ」と語った。

これには反論もある。インフレを現在あおっているエネルギーや関税、他の供給ショックが突然終わらない限り、インフレを鈍化させるためには、利上げによって何らかの犠牲が必要となる。それが消費者の支出抑制であっても、企業の投資鈍化であっても同じだ。

インフレが供給ショックに起因するものであっても、典型的な経済成長の過熱に起因するものであっても「中銀がこのギャップを埋める唯一の方法は、需要を抑制し、それとともに生産と雇用を縮小させることだ」とシカゴ地区連銀のオースタン・グールズビー総裁は今週語った。

しかし、ウォーシュ氏を含めたＦＲＢの当局者らは需要の抑制ではなく、インフレ期待そのものが効果を発揮することに期待を寄せているようだ。労働市場は完全雇用に近い均衡状態にあると見られており、４．１％の失業率と緩やかな賃金上昇は、２％のインフレ率目標と整合すると見なされている。

７月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数の前年同月比上昇率は３．７％と、ＦＲＢ当局者が懸念を抱くには十分な高さではある。ただ、１９８０年代以来の大きさとなる利上げを招いた新型コロナウイルス感染症のパンデミック（世界的大流行）後の水準には程遠い。

＜フィリップス曲線と異なる動き＞

インフレ期待はインフレ率目標の２％付近に定着しているとみられており、これはＦＲＢが強い信頼感を持っている要素だ。また、関税やエネルギー価格のショックが予想通りに緩和されれば、物価上昇圧力の緩和が既に進行している可能性もある。

セントルイス地区連銀のアルベルト・ムサレム総裁は２１日のロイターのインタビューで「現時点では、労働市場はインフレの要因ではない。インフレ率目標を達成するために、必ずしも労働市場の勢いを減速させたり、鎮めたりする必要はない（中略）それは物価を３―４％引き上げる必要があると考えている人々の期待を変えることで実現する」とし、「（失業率と物価の逆相関を想定する）フィリップス曲線のトレードオフが必ずしも生じるわけではない」と指摘した。

ＦＲＢ政策担当者による最新の予測（中央値）によると、ＰＣＥ価格指数のインフレ率は低下し、経済成長率は長期的な潜在成長率を上回って推移すると見込まれている。だが、現在の失業率は２０２９年まで変化はないと予想している。これはある意味では、重力に逆らうような見通しと言えるかもしれない。

新型コロナのパンデミック後にインフレ率が４０年ぶりの高水準を付けた際、著名なエコノミストらはフィリップス曲線の理論に基づき、インフレ率が緩和されるためには失業率が二桁に達する必要があるかもしれないと推定していた。当時ＦＲＢ議長だったジェローム・パウエル氏は、過酷な利上げによって家計や企業が直面する「苦痛」を警告していた。

企業はその代わりに、パンデミック中に確保することが難しかった従業員を解雇するのではなく、過剰な求人を大幅に減らすことで対応した。世界的なサプライチェーン（供給網）はパンデミックによる混乱から回復し、消費者はモノやサービスへの支出が均等化したことで、局所的に急騰していた物価の上昇圧力が緩和された。

結果として、十分な雇用と抑制されたインフレ率というトレードオフに基づく（フィリップス曲線の）古典的なモデルに反し、インフレ率と失業率の両方が急落した。

これは特異な状況であったが、ＦＲＢの政策担当者にとっては期待インフレの安定化の重要性を訴えかける結果となった。すなわち、市場に基づいた指標は、投資家や企業はＦＲＢがインフレ率を押さえ込むと信じ続けていたことを示していた。さらに、失業率の悪化こそがインフレ率を目標の２％に戻す唯一の道であると決めつけないことの重要性も浮き彫りにした。

＜ウォーシュ氏の見解＞

現在のアプローチでは、インフレ率を抑えるペースが鈍化し、インフレとの戦いが長期化する可能性がある。ＦＲＢが約３年ぶりの利上げを発表した今年９月１６日の前回連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）後の声明で、今回の利上げがインフレ率目標への「より早期の回復」を後押しすると言及した。ただし、それは必ずしも適時の回復を意味するわけではない。

同時に発表された政策当局者の見通しによると、年内に０．２５％ポイントの利上げがあと１回あると予測している。だが、それ以上の追加利上げについては意見が分かれている。

一方、投資家はより積極的な利上げを予想している。中間選挙の１週間前となる１０月２７―２８日の次回会合を手始めに、来年４月までの今後５回の会合のうち３回の会合でそれぞれ０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めるとみている。

今後のデータ、とりわけ来週発表される８月のＰＣＥ価格指数などがこの先の政策対応を左右することになるだろう。ＦＲＢの政策担当者らは、インフレがもはや関税やエネルギー価格の急騰だけにあおられているのではなく、経済の需要と成長の強化、さらには銅の価格から電気工事士の時給に至るまでを押し上げている人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの波及効果に起因している兆候に一段と注目している。

需要の過熱、特にそれが労働市場を逼迫（ひっぱく）させ、賃上げのペースを加速させ始めた場合、ＦＲＢはより迅速に対応する公算が大きい。

ＳＧＨマクロ・アドバイザーズの米国チーフエコノミスト、ティム・デュイ氏は「『金利を引き上げれば、ＡＩだけに打撃を与える』といった特効薬はない」とし、「経済や労働市場を巻き添えにすることなくインフレを抑制するのは非常に難しい」との見方を示した。

とはいえ現時点では、それが期待されている。

ウォーシュ氏は先週のＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見で「目標を達成するために労働市場に悪影響を与える必要はないと考えている」とし、「物価の安定化と雇用最大化というＦＲＢの二つの使命が、中期的には相反する方向に行くとは思わない」と発言した。

焦点：ＦＲＢが狙う「雇用損なわない」インフレ抑制、コロナ禍後の再現なるか
12:04 配信

Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

成功の鍵は物価上昇の要因にあるが、これについては政策立案者の間で議論が分かれている。しかし、ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長の先週の発言や、他の当局者がそれ以降に話した内容を踏まえると、ＦＲＢ当局者は失業率の上昇をほとんど、あるいは全く伴わずに、インフレ率を緩やかに鈍化できると考えていることがうかがえる。

リッチモンド地区連銀のトーマス・バーキン総裁は２３日、「ＦＲＢがインフレ対策に真剣に取り組んでいると人々が考えれば、それは価格設定行動での人々の期待に反映される傾向がある。逆に、ＦＲＢが適切に対処していないと人々が考えれば、それも価格設定行動に反映されるだろう」と言及。自身のマッキンゼー・アンド・カンパニーでのコンサルティング経験を踏まえ、企業内での価格引き上げと市場シェア維持のせめぎ合いについて「インフレを物理的に抑制することも可能だ。需要が減り、供給が増えれば、価格は下がる。また、期待に基づいてインフレを抑制することも可能だ」と語った。

これには反論もある。インフレを現在あおっているエネルギーや関税、他の供給ショックが突然終わらない限り、インフレを鈍化させるためには、利上げによって何らかの犠牲が必要となる。それが消費者の支出抑制であっても、企業の投資鈍化であっても同じだ。

インフレが供給ショックに起因するものであっても、典型的な経済成長の過熱に起因するものであっても「中銀がこのギャップを埋める唯一の方法は、需要を抑制し、それとともに生産と雇用を縮小させることだ」とシカゴ地区連銀のオースタン・グールズビー総裁は今週語った。

items.title: ドイツ製造業界団体、対中リスクの低減訴え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２５日 ロイター] - ドイツの大手製造業者を代表する業界団体ＢＤＩは２５日、中国に関連する経済的リスクを低減するため、より断固とした取り組みを行うよう求めた。欧州は広範な保護主義を避けつつ、サプライチェーン（供給網）の多様化を図り、新たなパートナーシップを構築しなければならないと訴えている。

政策提言書で「デリスキング（リスク低減）」をより一貫して推進すべきだと述べたが、具体的な措置については言及しなかった。

ＢＤＩは「中国経済との構造的な競争は、開放的な社会的市場経済にとってますます大きな課題となっており、適切な産業・通商政策による対応が求められている」と指摘。欧州連合（ＥＵ）は反ダンピング（不当廉売）措置や反補助金措置など、不公正な競争に迅速に対応するための手段を持つべきだと述べた一方で、新たな貿易保護措置は慎重に調整されなければならないと警告した。

また、ドイツとＥＵに対し、経済的・安全保障上の利益に基づき、他の地域との連携を拡大するよう求めた。

さらに、欧州は米国に対しても、より断固とした姿勢を示すべきだと表明。「米国の保護主義的措置が欧州企業の競争力を損なう場合には、長期的な戦略的関係を損なうことなく、適切な欧州側の対抗措置を検討すべきだ」と述べた。

items.title: What is 'Taiwan independence' and is Taiwan already independent?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's Xi Jinping told President Donald Trump on Thursday that he hoped the US will adhere to the "correct position" of opposing Taiwan independence, and that the Chinese stance on "reunification" is clear-cut.
items.body:
China's [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"Xi Jinping"] told President Donald Trump on Thursday that he hoped the US will adhere to the "correct position" of opposing Taiwan independence, and that the Chinese stance on "reunification" is clear-cut.
Below are some questions and answers about what is meant by the term "Taiwan independence" and the positions of the Chinese, US and Taiwanese governments.
WHAT IS TAIWAN'S HISTORY AND FORMAL NAME TODAY? The Qing dynasty incorporated Taiwan as part of Fujian province in 1684 and only declared it a separate Chinese province in 1885.
Following the Qing's defeat in a war with Japan, it became a Japanese colony in 1895. In 1945, it was handed over to the Republic of China government at the end of World War Two.
In 1949 after being defeated by Mao Zedong's Communist forces, the Republic of China government fled and moved its capital to Taiwan, and Republic of China remains the island's formal name.
Mao set up the People's Republic of China, and claimed it was the only legitimate Chinese government for the whole of China, including Taiwan, as the Republic of China's successor state.
WHAT IS TAIWAN'S INTERNATIONAL STATUS AND CHINA'S POSITION? For decades, the Republic of China in Taipei also claimed to be the legitimate Chinese government, but in 1971 Beijing took over the China seat at the United Nations from Taipei.
Most major Western countries and US allies maintain close unofficial ties with Taiwan by recognising the Republic of China passport and having de facto embassies in each other's capitals.
China says it will not renounce the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control. Beijing has [USN:L1N41C0F3 TEXT:"offered Taiwan"] a "one country, two systems" model similar to Hong Kong, which promised the city a high degree of autonomy, although no major political party in Taiwan supports that.
WHAT IS THE US POSITION? Any change in official US wording on Taiwan would upend decades of policy set by both Republican and Democratic presidents.
The US severed official ties with Taipei in favour of Beijing in 1979 but is bound by the Taiwan Relations Act to provide the island with the means to defend itself. The US officially takes no position on Taiwan's sovereignty under Washington's "One China" policy.
In 2022, the State Department also added wording on the Six Assurances, referring to six Reagan-era security assurances given to Taiwan, which the United States declassified in 2020.
Among the assurances made in 1982, but never previously formally made public, are statements that the US has not set a date for ending arms sales to Taiwan, nor agreed to prior consultation with Beijing on such sales, or to revise the Taiwan Relations Act that underpins US policy towards the island.
China has repeatedly demanded that the US [USN:L1N45E095 TEXT:"end arms sales"] to Taiwan.
In May after meeting Xi in Beijing, Trump said he was still considering whether to go ahead with new weapons sales and that the US was "not looking to have somebody say, 'Let's go [USN:L1N41V09K TEXT:"independent"] because the United States is backing us'."
The US ended its formal defence alliance with Taiwan in 1979 and has since then had a policy of "strategic ambiguity" on whether it would come to Taipei's defence should Beijing attack.
IS TAIWAN ALREADY AN INDEPENDENT COUNTRY? Taiwan, whose people elect their own leaders and whose government controls a defined area of territory with its own military, passport and currency, enjoys de facto independence even if that is not formally recognised by most countries.
Taiwan's government says the Republic of China is a sovereign state and that Beijing has no right to speak for or represent it given the People's Republic of China has no say in how it chooses its leaders and has never ruled Taiwan.
COULD TAIPEI DECLARE A "REPUBLIC OF TAIWAN"? It would be very difficult and require parliamentary approval of a constitutional amendment and then a referendum, rather than a simple declaration by President Lai Ching-te.
At least 75% of lawmakers would need to pass that amendment, and the ruling Democratic Progressive Party and main opposition party the Kuomintang (KMT) currently have an equal number of seats.
The DPP, which has been in power since 2016, has not made an attempt to change the constitution. The KMT strongly opposes any attempts to change the name Republic of China.
WHAT DOES TAIWAN'S PRESIDENT SAY ABOUT INDEPENDENCE? China detests Lai and calls him a "separatist". Before Lai was elected president he made comments about being a "practical worker for Taiwan independence". Lai maintains he simply meant Taiwan is already [USN:L4N41S0W4 TEXT:"an independent country"].

items.title: オープンAIのエージェントがオーストラリア政府サイトに侵入、その深刻度は
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
オーストラリア政府は23日、オープンAIのAIエージェントが6月に政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたと発表した。AIエージェントが政府サイトをハッキングした初の事例となる可能性がある。
今回の事案は、米国外でAIエージェントが外部システムにアクセスしたケースとして特に注目される事例の一つ。世界的にも制御を外れたAIエージェントによる侵入事例が相次いでおり、各国政府や企業の警戒感が高まっている。
ロイターのサイバー・テクノロジー政策担当記者、ラファエル・サターが解説する。

　◇

ロイター　サイバー・テクノロジー政策担当　ラファエル・サター

オーストラリア政府は、オープンAIのエージェントが今年6月に政府のウェブサイトに侵入していたと明らかにした。

オーストラリア　アルバニージー首相
「AIエージェントが政府のウェブサイトに侵入した」

現時点で分かっていること、そしてなぜこれが重要なのかを説明
items.body:
オーストラリア政府は23日、オープンAIのAIエージェントが6月に政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたと発表した。AIエージェントが政府サイトをハッキングした初の事例となる可能性がある。
今回の事案は、米国外でAIエージェントが外部システムにアクセスしたケースとして特に注目される事例の一つ。世界的にも制御を外れたAIエージェントによる侵入事例が相次いでおり、各国政府や企業の警戒感が高まっている。
ロイターのサイバー・テクノロジー政策担当記者、ラファエル・サターが解説する。

　◇

ロイター　サイバー・テクノロジー政策担当　ラファエル・サター

オーストラリア政府は、オープンAIのエージェントが今年6月に政府のウェブサイトに侵入していたと明らかにした。

オーストラリア　アルバニージー首相
「AIエージェントが政府のウェブサイトに侵入した」

現時点で分かっていること、そしてなぜこれが重要なのかを説明する。

これらのエージェントがなぜこうした判断経路をたどったのか、正確なところは分かっていない。過去の事例でオープンAIのエージェントは、比較的複雑で難しい調査タスクが与えられ、求められている情報を容易に見つけられないことがしばしばあった。

その結果、エージェントは近道を取ろうとし始める。今回もそれが起きた可能性がある。オーストラリア政府によれば、これらのエージェントは統計を探しており、オープンAIから与えられた調査タスクに答えようとする過程で、統計関連のウェブサイトを標的にしたようだ。

＜今回の事案はどれほど深刻か＞

今回の事案には二つの側面がある。一方では事態の深刻化を示すものだが、他方では、これまで見てきた他の事例ほど深刻ではない。最もよく知られているハギング・フェイス社への侵入事案では、AIエージェントの集団が大挙して、数日間にわたり企業のネットワークに侵入した。

今回は、少なくとも現時点で明らかになったことから判断すれば、政府ウェブサイトを散発的につつくような試みだったことがうかがえる。銀行に押し入る強盗と、車のドアが施錠されていないか確かめようとしてガチャガチャ動かす人物との違いを想像してほしい。

つまり、ある一面においては、それほど深刻ではないと言うこともできる。しかし他方で、これは政府のウェブサイトであり、しかも医療関連のウェブサイトだった。これは相当深刻なことで、多くの国が重要インフラと見なす対象でもある。重要インフラへの侵入には実際に法的な罰則が科される。

これが意味することは、AI開発企業自体のセキュリティー態勢のお粗末さだ。現在、こうした事案が相次いでいるのはAIエージェントの強力さを示していると主張する人々と、「いや、これはむしろ世に送り出した側の怠慢を示している」と主張する人々の間で議論がある。おそらく答えはその中間のどこかにあるのだろう。

多くの人が抱く懸念はここにある。毎週のように新たな事案が明らかになっているが、これらは氷山の一角にすぎないのではないかという懸念だ。

items.title: 城内経財相、リフレ政策の局面は終わっている－今は金融緩和ではない
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 城内実経済財政担当相は25日の記者会見で、日本経済の現状について金融緩和と機動的な財政出動を行うリフレーション政策の局面ではないとの認識を示した。

城内氏は「金融をどんどん緩和して、財政も機動的に取り組んでいくという、アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレーション政策、そういう局面は終わっている」と指摘。今は金融を緩和をするという時代ではなく、物価が緩やかに上昇し、金利が上がっていく局面にあるとも述べた。

円安と金利上昇が進行する中、閣僚からは市場の沈静化に向けた発言が相次いだ。同日の記者会見で片山さつき財務相は、先日の日米首脳会談で「トランプ米大統領から円安への懸念が示された」と明らかにした。片山氏の発言を受け、円は対ドルで上げ幅を拡大。午後1時10分現在で158円30銭前後を推移している。

今月中旬の内閣改造で再任された城内氏は、「責任ある積極財政を推進する議員連盟」の顧問を務め、金融緩和と積極財政を進める「リフレ派」と位置付けられていた。高市首相とも経済政策への考えが近く、再任は政権が従来の方針を堅持する姿勢と受け止められた。

日本の経済財政政策を巡っては、ベッセント米財務長官は今月初めの記者会見で、「アベノミクス」は終わったと指摘。日本は物価の上昇を促すリフレに成功し、今は政策をシフトする必要があるとの認識を示していた。

城内氏は会見で、高市早苗政権の経済財政政策と「アベノミクス」の違いにも触れた。「アベノミクスとサナエノミクスが同じようなものだという認識であれば」、サナエノミクスは「リフレ政策ではない」とした。

また、物価については「持続的に下降する状況に戻らない」という状況ではなく、「まだデフレ脱却はしていない」との政府見解は維持した。

日本銀行は18日の金融政策決定会合で、3カ月ぶりの利上げを決め、引き続き金融環境は緩和的とし、利上げを継続していく姿勢を示した。一方、高市政権が任命した審議委員2人が反対票を投じた。

items.title: サッカー＝イスラエル代表ＦＷ、得点後に銃撃まね退場　欧州ＮＬ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイスラエル代表ＦＷサイード・アブ・ファルヒが、２４日に行われた欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）１次リーグのオーストリア戦で得点後にコーナーフラッグを銃に見立てるパフォーマンスを行い、退場処分を受けた。

リンツで行われたこの試合は、オーストリアが前半にロマーノ・シュミットのＰＫで先制した。

イスラエルは後半１０分、アブ・ファルヒのヘディングシュートで同点に。この際、アブ・ファルヒはコーナーフラッグに駆け寄って抜くと、銃を撃つようなしぐさをした。

同選手はその４分前にも警告を受けており、主審はこのパフォーマンスに対して２枚目のイエローカードを提示し、累積退場処分とした。

試合はその後、オーストリアが２点を加え、３─１で勝利した。

items.title: George Lombard Jr. rescues Yankees against Rays with homer
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Rookie George Lombard Jr. hit an impressive tiebreaking two-run homer with two outs in the eighth inning as the New York Yankees overcame a four-run deficit and earned a 6-4 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Thursday night.
items.body:
Rookie George Lombard Jr. hit an impressive tiebreaking two-run homer with two outs in the eighth inning as the New York Yankees overcame a four-run deficit and earned a 6-4 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Thursday night.
The Yankees (92-67) won for the 11th time in 16 games thanks to their late comeback that was sparked by Lombard.
Following a two-out single by Amed Rosario off Steven Matz (5-6), Lombard snapped a 4-4 tie by lifting a 2-2 sinker into the second deck of the left field seats. It was Lombard's seventh homer in 41 games since joining the Yankees last month and his fourth in the past seven games.
Lombard also hit an RBI double during New York's three-run seventh and scored on a wild pitch to the backstop by Tampa Bay rookie Brody Hopkins.
Paul Goldschmidt had a tying RBI single in the seventh for the Yankees.
Austin Wells also homered for the Yankees, who had one hit through the first five innings and lost seven of 13 meetings with the top-seeded Rays (96-63).
New York ace Cam Schlittler allowed two runs (one earned) on three hits and two walks in three innings as he was limited to 70 pitches in his final start before the postseason. The right-hander struck out five and finished with 239 strikeouts to go along with a 1.95 ERA in his first full season.
Bradley Hanner (1-0) threw two scoreless innings for his first career victory. He retired Junior Caminero to end the eighth and stranded a runner in the ninth.
Caminero had a pair of RBI singles as the Rays held a 4-0 lead into the sixth. Caminero needs one RBI to become the fifth player in team history with multiple 100-RBI seasons.
Yandy Diaz added a pair of hits, including a hit that scored a run on a throwing error by New York right fielder Heliot Ramos in the third.
Caminero gave the Rays a 2-0 lead with a single to center field later in the third. In the fifth, he delivered an RBI single to left. Tampa Bay took a 4-0 lead in the sixth on an error by reliever Luis Gil.
Tampa Bay's Ian Seymour allowed one hit in five scoreless innings. He struck out three and walked none in a 58-pitch outing.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サウジ・トルコ・パキスタンが緊急会合開催へ、共同防衛協定受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Hatem Maher

[リヤド／カイロ ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Hatem Maher

[リヤド／カイロ ２５日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア、トルコ、パキスタンは共同防衛協定に基づき緊急のハイレベル会合を開催し、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が続く中、サウジを支援する方策について協議する。

フーシ派は２４日、サウジの標的に対して数十発のミサイルとドローン（無人機）を発射したと発表した一方、サウジ当局は、フーシ派が発射した弾道ミサイル６発を迎撃したと述べた。

戦闘が続く中、サウジ外務省によると、同国、パキスタン、トルコの各外相が「メッカ共同防衛協定」の枠組み内で会談を行った。声明によると、各国はメッカやその他の民間施設を標的とした攻撃を非難するとともに、サウジの自衛権を再確認した。

声明は「外相らはまた、メッカ共同防衛協定に基づきサウジを支援する方策を協議するため、３カ国の参謀総長による緊急会合を開催する手配についても協議した。同協定では、いずれかの当事国に対する攻撃は、全ての当事国に対する攻撃と見なされると規定されている」と述べた。

一方、これに先立ち、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２４日に放送された米ＦＯＸニュースのインタビューで「フーシ派は自らの行動に責任を負う」と述べ、フーシ派と距離を置こうとした。

また、イランのアラグチ外相は同日、記者団に対し、仲介国を通じて米国に提案を伝達したと述べた。その提案によれば、イラン側の条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡が再開され、レバノンを含む全ての戦線での戦闘行為は７日以内に終結する。

同相は、米国はイランの港湾に対する封鎖を解除し、凍結されたイランの資金を解放し、石油制裁を撤廃することになると説明。その後、イランの核問題を含むその他の問題について米国との協議が開始されると付け加えた。

items.title: HSBC、香港で最大400万円の会員制クラブ補助廃止へ－福利厚生見直し
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 英銀HSBCホールディングスは、香港の一部行員を対象に会員制クラブ加入費を最大20万香港ドル（約400万円）補助する制度を廃止する。香港で進める福利厚生制度見直しの一環だ。

内部文書によると、中堅行員を対象に香港の会員制クラブ加入費の50%を負担する制度を12月31日で終了する。一方、HSBCの香港部門と恒生銀行では2027年から、新規採用者に現在の行員と同じ生命保険の保障内容を適用しない。

恒生銀行とHSBCの香港部門では、住宅ローンの優遇措置や医療保障、生命保険などの福利厚生も統一する。

HSBCの広報担当者は電子メールで「従業員への投資を他社並みの水準で進めることに注力している」と説明。「香港のHSBCと恒生銀行の従業員には幅広い学習・能力開発の機会と、他社並みの福利厚生を提供している」とした。

ジョルジュ・エレデリー最高経営責任者（CEO）の下、HSBCは事業再編とコスト削減を進めている。欧州と米国の株式資本市場業務とアドバイザリー業務から撤退し、ほかの部門も縮小している。1月に買収を完了した恒生銀行との統合も進めている。

HSBCは今月、香港の新規採用者と香港に赴任する幹部を対象に、長年続けてきた学費補助を廃止した。学費の95%を補助し、年間の上限は小学生1人当たり22万香港ドル、中等学校の生徒1人当たり30万香港ドルだった。

香港の会員制クラブの多くは入会金や年会費が高額で、入会待ちが長期に及ぶ。社交やビジネス、余暇の拠点として利用され、大規模なスポーツ施設を備えるクラブもある。

原題：HSBC Scraps $25,000 Members Club Perk for Hong Kong Bankers（抜粋）

items.title: Rupee to navigate US-Iran truce possibility, surging global bond yields
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Indian rupee is expected to remain on the defensive on Friday as markets weigh the possibility of a truce between the US and Iran and gauge the impact of soaring global bond yields that have intensified headwinds facing risk assets.
items.body:
The Indian rupee is expected to remain on the defensive on Friday as markets weigh the possibility of a truce between the US and Iran and gauge the impact of soaring global bond yields that have intensified headwinds facing risk assets.
The rupee is expected around the 96 per dollar mark, traders said, marginally weaker from its close at 95.9550 in the previous session and vulnerable to deeper losses in the absence of central bank intervention.
US and Iranian negotiators in New York are exploring a [USN:L8N45G0OP TEXT:"phased path out of war"] that would involve Tehran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lifting its economic blockade of Iran, Reuters reported on Thursday.
Brent oil prices were down 0.5% on Friday at $106 per barrel.
Meanwhile, global yields continued to march higher, with the 30-year US Treasury yield rising to its highest level since 2004 after more Federal Reserve officials said additional interest rate hikes may be needed to curb high inflation.
Markets are currently pricing in a near 70% chance of an October rate hike by the Fed, per CME's FedWatch tool. The hike wagers have also been a tailwind for the dollar index by lifting it nearly 2% over the month so far.
Expectations of global rate hikes, volatile oil prices and weakness in portfolio inflows have all weighed on the rupee this month while persistent interventions by the Reserve Bank of India have helped keep a lid on volatility.
Traders expect the pattern to persist in the near term with the 96-per-dollar mark seen as a key psychological support level for the South Asian currency.
"It would be prudent not to defend the exchange rate too aggressively at any level at the expense of reserves. Instead, we expect the RBI to allow orderly depreciation in line with global financial and commodity-market conditions," ANZ said in a note, forecasting the INR at 96.50 by December and 98.30 by the end of next year.
