WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday (Sep 24), with talks on trade and artificial intelligence and the growing strategic rivalry between the countries all in the spotlight during an elaborate state visit.
Here are some major takeaways from the talks:
TRADE DEAL EXTENDED, FOR NOW T he US secured an extension of its trade truce this week - but only a short one.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two sides agreed to extend by two months a trade agreement that ended last year's trade war and was due to expire in November. The extension would give Washington and Beijing "more time to see what we can do on the economic front," he said.

But rather than locking in a durable agreement, the extension appears to push the central questions — tariffs, Chinese purchases, rare-earth supplies and technology restrictions — into the next round of negotiations.
Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing was meeting its requirement in the earlier agreement to buy 25 million tons of soybeans but was lagging on its pledge to buy US$17 billion in other agricultural goods. US officials have said rare-earth deliveries were also falling short, another sign that significant gaps remain.
For companies, the result is a familiar form of instability: tariff rates remain lower for now, but decisions must still be made against a shifting policy backdrop.

Related:

Trump praises US-China friendship, talks up White House ballroom during state dinner for China's Xi

Trump-Xi summit in Washington begins with great fanfare but low expectations

DRESS TO IMPRESS For Trump , Xi 's White House visit was an opportunity to show off a Washington being remade in his image.
After Xi treated Trump in Beijing to a tour around a Ming dynasty temple and a walled-off garden retreat rarely opened to foreigners, the US president returned the favor with a different kind of spectacle: Troops wearing wigs and tri-corner hats marched in formation and played music in a Rose Garden redesigned to look like a Trump golf club.
Fighter jets and bombers roared overhead during ceremonies staged on Wednesday and Thursday, one so loud it caused Trump to flinch.
When the White House press corps was called to cover the two leaders, it wasn’t to hear them talk about the weighty affairs of state. Instead, it was to watch them tour the Marine One helicopter and the recently redesigned South Lawn of the White House, replete with a large helipad emblazoned with the presidential seal.
Speaking to reporters, Trump brushed away questions about their policy discussions.
“He loves good granite,” Trump said of Xi . “Great meeting.”
XI WANTS US "PRUDENCE" OVER TAIWAN As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue, saying, according to China's official news agency, that China hoped the United States would "handle the Taiwan question with prudence. "
The agency's English-language service also wrote that Xi hoped the US would oppose Taiwan independence.
That would be a tougher version of Washington's long-standing formulation that it does not "support" independence. There are no signs that the Trump administration plans to change its wording.
There was no immediate White House readout of the exchange, but US officials have long avoided explicitly stating opposition to Taiwanese independence. Any shift in language would raise questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoke opposition in Congress.

Related:

Trump-Xi summit: Xi Jinping calls for US and China to be partners rather than rivals

Trump’s high-level welcome for Xi puts personal diplomacy in focus, analysts say

STRATEGIC RISK Xi , not for the first time while meeting Trump , invoked the "Thucydides Trap", an academic theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends toward war.
While the Chinese leader said the risk "can be overcome," his reference underscored how concerns about a potential US-China military conflict continue to shadow relations between the world's two largest powers.
Xi argued that both nations stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation, and he called for regular military dialogue and stronger crisis-prevention mechanisms.
Trump , for his part, drew on the two nations' shared history to emphasize the potential for cooperation. They could accomplish much by pursuing common interests, he said, invoking their wartime alliance against Japan.
DIFFERENCES ON AI The two leaders expressed diverging views about artificial intelligence.
Trump, who has declared that AI should be called super intelligence, or SI, said in a social media post that he wants “to leave it exactly where it is" and rely on the US Department of Justice rather than impose any new guardrails. He insisted that China held the same position.
But Xi said on Thursday that, as leading nations on AI, China and the US must manage its growth.
“We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good, and ensure that the development of AI is always under human control and serves the well-being of the people,” Xi said.
Some of the biggest names in AI were expected to attend Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Xi, including Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Sundar Pichai, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's (NVDA.O) Jensen Huang.

Source: Reuters/bg

items.title: What Is The Thucydides Trap and Why Did Xi Raise It With Trump?
items.author: Rebecca Choong Wilkins
items.creator: Rebecca Choong Wilkins
items.summary: When China’s President Xi Jinping met US leader Donald Trump in Washington on Thursday he called for greater cooperation between the two countries to avoid the “Thucydides Trap”. It’s a phrase that sounds academic, but it goes to the heart of Beijing’s ambitions for their relationship. And it’s not the first time Xi has invoked it: he raised the same idea when Trump visited China in May.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁（金融安定担当）は２４日、インフレ...
items.body:
英中銀副総裁、利上げ「ますます適切に」　インフレ加速で
8:56 配信

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁。ロンドンで7月7日に代表撮影。REUTERS

[ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁（金融安定担当）は２４日、インフレリスクの増大に利上げで対応することが「ますます適切になる」と述べた。

ブリーデン氏は英国立経済社会研究所が主催した「ＵＫマクロ政策フォーラム」で、エネルギー価格の高騰による二次的影響の兆候を確認するために政策対応を長く待ち過ぎると、後悔することになりかねないと指摘した。

この発言は、金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）で最近見られる論調の変化と一致する内容で、１１月の利上げに道を開く可能性がある。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は既に利上げに踏み切っている。

ブリーデン氏は「ショックが大きく、長引くほど、政策対応が必要となる重大な二次的影響が生じる可能性は高まる」とした上で、「（利上げに票を投じる用意という意味で）９月時点ではその段階になかったが、リスクバランスが変化したことは意識しており、リスクが顕在化するにつれ、政策金利による対応がますます適切になる」と語った。

金融市場が今後１年間で約１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを織り込んでいることについて問われると、１１月に予定される次回の政策決定に注目していると答えた。

「私にとって今の問題は『最初の一手が必要か』ということだ。それ以上の利上げが必要かどうかは、経済とそこに加わったショックがここからどう展開するかに左右されると思う」と述べた。また、市場の利上げ織り込みの変化を英中銀は無視できないとの考えも示した。

ロンバルデリ副総裁も２４日、エネルギー価格が高止まりすれば、景気悪化の明確な証拠がない限り、利上げが必要になる公算が大きいと述べた。

items.body:
ＮＳＳＫとＣＶＣから非公開化の初期提案を受領＝一部報道で小林製薬
8:54 配信

［東京　２５日　ロイター］ - 小林製薬は２５日、日本産業推進機構（ＮＳＳＫ）とＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズから非公開化の提案を受けたとの一部報道を受け、両社の関連法人から「株式の非公開化にかかる法的拘束力のない初期的な共同提案を受領していることは事実」とのコメントを発表した。

現時点で決定した事実はなく、今後、開示すべき事実を決定した場合は速やかに公表するという。

日本経済新聞など国内メディアは２４日、小林製薬が株式の非公開化を検討していると報じた。日経は、ＮＳＳＫと欧州系投資ファンドのＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズが買収を提案したとし、小林製薬の創業家も一部出資する方向で検討しているもようと伝えた。

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領と共...
items.body:
トランプ氏、ＡＩ巡りテック大手ＣＥＯと29日会合＝関係筋
8:48 配信

AIのイメージ写真。9月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Courtney Rozen　Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領と共和党のジョンソン下院議長、テクノロジー大手の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）らが２９日に人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る会合を開く。計画に詳しい関係者が２４日、明らかにした。

• 詳細は現時点で明らかになっていない。

• 世界の主要ＡＩ企業は、ＡＩが人類にもたらすリスクについて警告し、ますます強力になるこの技術を管理するために各国政府が協力するよう求めている。

• ＡＩ開発における二大強国である米国と中国は、規制に関して異なるアプローチをとっている。

• トランプ氏は、米国にはＡＩ特有の新たな規制は必要ないと主張。一方、中国はＡＩ生成コンテンツに明確な表示を義務付けるなど、ＡＩアルゴリズムや学習データを規制するルールを導入している。

• トランプ氏は２２日、国連総会での演説で、ＡＩを管理するための「グローバリスト的な仕組みを構築しようとするいかなる試みも拒絶する」と述べた 。

Sept 24 (Reuters) – British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in a meeting that Britain will “not tolerate intimidation, threats or hostile activity on UK soil” from groups linked to his country, Sky News reported on Thursday.  

Miliband and Araqchi met on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, the report said, citing Britain’s foreign office. 

Miliband and Araqchi discussed the war in the Middle East, the importance of reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Britain’s “unwavering resolve to combat threats from Iranian-linked groups in UK soil”, the report added.

Show Full Article

Britain’s National Cyber Security Centre said last week Iranian state-linked cyber actors had used a spyware family known as “CHOSEN BRICK” to steal emails, messages and other sensitive information through “spear-phishing” campaigns on messaging platforms including WhatsApp and Telegram.

The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

(Reporting by Gnaneshwar Rajan in Bengaluru; Editing by Stephen Coates)

items.body:
アカマイ、アンソロピックと116億ドルのクラウド契約　株価22％高
8:26 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。9月17日、米サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Harshita Mary Varghese

[２４日 ロイター] - 米アカマイ・テクノロジーズは２４日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックと総額１１６億ドルのクラウドサービス契約を締結した。アンソロピックにアカマイ株の最大５％を取得できるワラント（新株予約権）を付与する内容も含まれ、アカマイの株価は時間外取引で２２％急騰した。

今回の契約により、急成長するＡＩ企業の１社から長期的な確約を得た。アカマイが今年発表した複数年のクラウドインフラ契約は顧客全体で２８億ドルを超えており、今回の契約によってさらに増加する。

契約期間は７年間。アンソロピックはワラントにより、シリーズＢ株を１株当たり１１１．３３ドルで購入する権利を得る。これはアカマイの普通株式約７７０万株に転換される。

新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を計画するアンソロピックは、計算能力の拡大と、より高性能なモデルの訓練・運用に必要なインフラの確保を積極的に進めており、クラウド事業者やデータセンター事業者との間で数十億ドル規模の契約を相次いで結んでいる。

イーマーケターのアナリスト、ジェイコブ・ボーン氏は「自律型ＡＩの潜在的な悪影響を巡る懸念が高まっているものの、計算負荷の高まる自律型ＡＩの処理を支えるため、インフラ投資は今後も拡大し続けるだろう」と指摘。株式取得の可能性については「ＡＩ主導のクラウド需要の持続性に対する信任投票と見なせる」と述べた。

ワラントのうち、アカマイの発行済み普通株式の約２％に相当する部分は、アンソロピックによる１１６億ドルのコミットメントに連動する。残る３％は、両社が契約規模をさらに最大９０億ドル拡大した場合に権利が確定する。

アカマイによると、当初のコミットメントに関連する設備投資総額は約５５億ドルと見込まれる。

items.title: 日本市場、米債売り加速で金利一段高へ－円は軟調公算・AI株上値重い
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 　　25日の日本市場では、原油高や財政懸念を背景に米国債売りが加速したことを受け、国債利回りが一段と上昇しそう。金利のボラティリティーの高さから投資家のリスクセンチメントが悪化し、株式はAI関連を中心に上値の重い展開が予想される。為替は米金利高を手がかりとしたドル買いが優勢で、円は160円の節目に向けて軟調に推移しそうだ。

米国とイランの交渉担当者はホルムズ海峡の再開に向けて段階的な合意を模索しているものの、通航再開に対する懐疑的な見方は根強く、24日の原油先物相場は急伸した。原油価格の高止まりによるインフレ懸念が利上げ観測を高め、世界的な債券売りが広がっている。

米30年債利回りは一時2004年以来の高水準となり、日本でも債券売りが強まりそうだ。金融引き締めへの観測に加え、日本の財政懸念も引き続き重しとなる。きょうは残存期間5年超11年以下を対象とした流動性供給入札が実施される。

金利の大幅変動が投資家のリスク選好に逆風となり、株式市場で積極的な取引は控えられやすい。米フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）が下落しており、国内でも前日に買われたAI・半導体関連株を中心に売りが先行しそうだ。

為替はドルが強含む中、円は24日に一時159円04銭と2日以来の安値に下げた。160円の節目が意識される半面、160円に接近すれば当局による介入への警戒が一段と高まるとみられ、一方的な円売りには歯止めがかかる可能性が高い。

（注：表中の終値は米国時間終値。円相場は対米ドル、前営業日比は円の対ドル変化率。米10年金利の前営業日比は変化幅（単位：%ポイント）。日経平均の前営業日比はシカゴ・マーカンタイル取引所清算値と大阪取引所清算値との比較。シカゴ取引所が休場の場合は大阪取引所の夜間終値と通常取引清算値の比較。金は1トロイオンス当たりのドル建て価格）

items.title: Tesla is beginning Semi electric truck deliveries
items.author: Abhirup Roy
items.creator: Abhirup Roy
items.summary: Tesla is beginning deliveries of its Semi trucks to a first set of customers this week, executives said at its plant in Sparks, Nevada, almost nine years after CEO Elon Musk unveiled the electric big rigs.
items.body:
Tesla (TSLA.O) is beginning deliveries of its Semi trucks to a first set of customers this week, executives said at its plant in Sparks, Nevada, almost nine years after CEO Elon Musk unveiled the electric big rigs.
The Semi, designed for long-haul freight, expands the market for Tesla, known for its electric sedans and SUVs, into commercial freight haulers at a time when diesel prices in the US have soared to record highs.
Tesla did not disclose production volume plans or pricing of the trucks at a webcast event late on Thursday at the plant. It reiterated plans to build 50,000 Semis a year at the Nevada plant.
Musk did not attend the event. In a recorded video message he said: "I'd recommend placing more orders if you haven't already, but the waiting list is already pretty significant."
Customers, including PepsiCo, DHL and US Foods, were invited on stage, and trucks with their logos were shown parked outside.
The long-range variant, loaded, can drive 500 miles with one charge. "That's 500 real-world miles. Our customers have validated it," said Dan Priestley, Tesla's director of Semi truck engineering. A standard variant has 325 miles of range.
The Semi was first unveiled in 2017 and production was expected to start in 2019.
The first truck eventually rolled off the high-volume production line in April and volume production was set to start this year. However, Tesla's July shareholder letter said that production of Semi would begin in 2026, removing an earlier forecast for volume production this year.
Tesla began limited deliveries to customers including PepsiCo in the US in late 2022. Delays, rising competition and a reversal in EV policies in the US have since raised concerns about demand.
Still, Tesla this week received an order for 2,500 Semis from a coalition of the world's largest cargo-owning shippers, including Microsoft and PepsiCo, according to clean transportation nonprofit Catalyst Mobility. That is nearly double the existing US fleet of electric Class 8 trucks, the nonprofit said.
Last month, Swedish freight technology company Einride AB announced a deal to add 500 Semi trucks to its fleet.

items.summary:
Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -  米ＩＴ大手オラクル は西部ニューメキ...
items.body:
オラクル、データセンター開発で不可抗力通知　電力確保遅延も＝関係者
8:01 配信

米ＩＴ大手オラクルのロゴ。2025年9月9日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -  米ＩＴ大手オラクル は西部ニューメキシコ州で進めている大型データセンター開発を巡り、電力確保が遅れる可能性があるとして、米資産運用会社ブルー・アウル の傘下企業に「不可抗力（フォース・マジュール）」を通知した。事情に詳しい関係者が２４日、ロイターに明らかにした。これを受けてオラクル株は３％超下落した。

関係者の話では、契約上はデータセンター用地の電力確保はオラクルの責任となっており、オラクルはいかなる場合も賃貸契約を解除できない。ブルー・アウルは同プロジェクトに約３０億ドルを出資し、オラクルは債務コストを負担する。

企業は通常、自らの制御が及ばない問題が発生した場合、契約上の義務を免れるため不可抗力条項を発動するが、こうした措置は金融機関や投資家の懸念を招きかねない。

ブルームバーグが先に報じたところによると、オラクルは主要テナントとして撤退するのではなく、「プロジェクト・ジュピター」と呼ばれるデータセンターが計画通り２０２８年に稼働できない場合に備え、支払い開始を遅らせようとしている。

オラクルはロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。これに先立ち同社は「プロジェクト・ジュピターは計画通りのスケジュールで進んでいる」と説明した。

データセンター開発会社スタック・インフラストラクチャーを傘下に持つブルー・アウルは、今回の通知によっても複数年にわたる同プロジェクトへの財務上のコミットメントに変更はないと述べた。

関係者は、ブルー・アウルが開発期間中に出資額に対して９％の利回りを得るとともに、完成後のレバレッジ後利回りは約１１％になる見通しだと言及した。

オラクルが不可抗力条項を発動したことで、ブルー・アウルに開発段階の低い賃料を支払う期間が延長される。ブルー・アウルは当初計画された期間分について、より高い完成後の賃料を引き続き受け取るが、その開始時期が後ずれするという。

プロジェクト・ジュピターは約１４００エーカー（５７０万平方メートル）の敷地にデータセンター群を整備する計画で、報道によると銀行団から１８０億ドルの融資を確保した。オラクルが米オープンＡＩに人工知能（ＡＩ）向けのコンピューティング能力を提供する大型契約の一部。同プロジェクトではこれまでにも、計画中の天然ガス・パイプラインの遅延や、水利用、空気質を巡る許認可に対する法的な異議申し立てなど、複数のインフラ面の問題が報じられてきた。

またプロジェクト・ジュピターは、米国内にＡＩインフラを構築する「スターゲート」計画に組み入れられており、同計画はオープンＡＩ、ソフトバンクグループ 、オラクルなどが参加し、５０００億ドル規模の投資を掲げている。

ＡＩインフラの大規模な整備を巡っては、開発各社がオープンＡＩなどにコンピューティング能力を提供するため巨額の投資を進める一方、必要な電力などの資源確保が課題だ。データセンター建設に対する住民の反発も強まり、地域の電力や水などの供給に与える影響への懸念から、政治的な争点にもなりつつある。

ウィリアム・ブレアは、今回のニュースによりＡＩ関連設備の展開を巡る規制や電力供給の遅れへの懸念が強まると指摘しつつ、オラクルへの短期的な影響は限定的との見方を示した。「実務上、２０２７会計年度への影響はないとみられる。ジュピターは同年度の収益に寄与しないためだ」という。

Analysis:Oracle, Blue Owl project delay sends ripples through AI financing, sources say

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 24 : Oracle's move to protect itself against potential delays at a massive data center project developed by Blue Owl in New Mexico sent a chill through the trillion-dollar market for AI infrastructure financing, according to interviews with bankers and investors.
Oracle issued a force majeure notice in connection with Jupiter, a data center campus Blue Owl unit STACK Infrastructure is building to support OpenAI, the latest setback for a sector where lenders and investors are growing more cautious about financing the industry's breakneck expansion.
Blue Owl said the notice did not alter the parties' commitment to the project. Even so, the event is reverberating through discussions around other proposed data center financings, including SB Energy, which is developing a campus to serve OpenAI in Ohio, a person close to its financing said. SB Energy decided this week to delay its IPO. 
Companies can use force majeure provisions when events beyond their control make it difficult to meet their contractual obligations. Lawyers say such provisions are becoming more common in data center development agreements, raising concerns among lenders and investors.

"The financing side of the AI buildout is starting to ask much harder questions than the demand side," said Sean McDevitt, a partner at management consulting firm Arthur D. Little. "The underlying demand still appears very strong, but investors and lenders are increasingly focused on how risk is allocated."
With interest rates in the US rising to levels last seen two decades ago, Wall Street is intensifying its scrutiny of the economics and the politics of deals that just months ago appeared settled — meaning that the participation in a deal of highly rated firms such as Oracle isn't necessarily enough to soothe anxious investors.
The pullback comes as AI-related capital spending by the six biggest US technology companies is projected to reach around $1 trillion in 2027, according to Moody's — raising concerns among lenders about whether markets can absorb the volume of issuance without wider pricing pressure or tighter terms. 
CASE STUDY
Investors and lenders are studying the Oracle situation as a real-world example of how contractual protections may be tested and who pays the bill when projects run into delays outside the parties' control, they said.
The program is being delayed by a year, said the person familiar with Oracle's notice and the deal. Blue Owl has about $3 billion of equity invested in the project and earns a lower return during construction, with returns increasing once the data center is completed, the person familiar with the terms said.
Oracle invoked force majeure due to delays securing power to the site, the person familiar with the matter said. Delaying completion pushes back the start of those higher returns for Blue Owl.  
As developers race to build AI infrastructure at unprecedented scale, the contracts underpinning those projects are changing quickly, said Rajat Rana, a New York-based partner at law firm Quinn Emanuel.
“These contracts are so rapidly evolving. If you look at a data center contract from January this year and a contract today, it's massively different,” he said.
At least 45 projects worth $68 billion faced opposition from community groups in the second quarter of 2026, according to research firm Data Center Watch, after 75 projects worth about $130 billion were disrupted in the first quarter. Banks are involved in several projects that face community action.
Earlier this year, Blue Owl struggled to syndicate financing for a $4 billion data center project in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, anchored by CoreWeave. 
"Blue Owl, STACK Infrastructure and Oracle remain fully aligned on Project Jupiter. This notice does not change the financial commitments to this multiyear project," the company said.
Oracle stock fell 3.5 per cent on Thursday, after media reports of the notice. Blue Owl closed 3.6 per cent lower.
Data center developments including Meta's project in El Paso, Texas, and Related Digital's planned $16 billion Oracle-focused campus in Saline Township, Michigan, have faced opposition from residents of those areas.
Blackstone's QTS in July said it had terminated its planned Digital Gateway data center project in Virginia and withdrawn the associated filings after years of planning and regulatory review.

Source: Reuters

Sept 24 : OpenAI is set to preview a cybersecurity-focused AI model, GPT-6 Cyber, within days and launch a new product designed to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically, Fortune reported on Thursday, citing multiple sources familiar with the plans.
OpenAI did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. 
• OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman and rival Anthropic's CEO earlier this month joined industry leaders in calling for a slower pace of AI development and stronger safety measures.
• Cybersecurity is emerging as one of AI's fastest-growing markets, as tech firms develop tools to combat threats and contain rogue AI agents.

• Fortune said GPT-6 Cyber, OpenAI's fourth cybersecurity-focused model released this year, could be unveiled at the company's DevDay event in San Francisco on Tuesday, along with plans to ship a dozen or more other products.
• A limited group of customers in OpenAI's application-only Daybreak Red cybersecurity program already has access to GPT-6 Cyber for alpha testing, the report said.

items.title: Diamondbacks outslug Rockies, gain ground in playoff race
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Gabriel Moreno and Nolan Arenado homered in a six-run first inning and the surging Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Colorado Rockies 12-8 on Thursday in Denver to continue their drive for a National League wild-card berth.
items.body:
Gabriel Moreno and Nolan Arenado homered in a six-run first inning and the surging Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Colorado Rockies 12-8 on Thursday in Denver to continue their drive for a National League wild-card berth.
James McCann also went deep for Arizona (85-74), which had a season-high 18 hits in its fifth straight win. The Diamondbacks moved within two games of Philadelphia for the third and final NL playoff berth. The Phillies lost to Milwaukee 5-1 on Thursday.
Arizona, which holds the tiebreaker over Philadelphia, is assured that at least the first game of its three-game series at San Diego beginning on Friday night will have postseason implications. The Phillies host Tampa Bay to end the regular season.
Geraldo Perdomo, Lars Nootbaar and Arenado had three hits each while McCann and Pavin Smith finished with two hits apiece for the D-backs.
Cole Carrigg homered among his four hits, Kyle Karros and Zac Veen also homered and had two hits, and Connor Norby and TJ Rumfield also contributed two hits for Colorado (57-102), which had 17 hits.
Arizona sent nine batters to the plate in the first inning against right-hander Tanner Gordon. Moreno's three-run homer started the scoring, Perdomo tripled, Smith singled and Arenado homered to cap the inning.
It was Arenado's 29th home run of the season.
Arizona scored twice in the second on an RBI double from Ketel Marte and a run-scoring single by Perdomo. Smith had an RBI double in the fourth and scored on McCann's single for a 10-0 advantage.
Gordon (1-6) allowed 10 runs on 12 hits in 4 1/3 innings.
D-backs starter Eduardo Rodriguez (16-7) allowed two runs on nine hits in six innings. The Rockies broke through against the left-hander when they loaded the bases with no outs in the fourth but managed just one run.
McCann hit his sixth home run leading off the sixth inning and Karros homered in the bottom of the frame, his 13th. Hunter Goodman added an RBI single in the seventh and Carrigg hit a three-run shot later in the inning, his 11th of the year, for a 12-6 deficit.
Veen hit a solo shot and Rumfield added an RBI double in the eighth.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 原油下落、イランがホルムズ再開巡る新提案を米国に提出とFT報道
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 原油相場はアジア時間25日の取引で下落。米国とイランの交渉担当者が、イランによるホルムズ海峡の再開につながる段階的な合意を模索していると伝わった。

北海ブレント先物は1バレル＝106ドルを下回った。過去2営業日で7%余り上昇していた。米ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）は93ドル近辺。協議に詳しい関係者によると、ここ数カ月は同様の合意に至っていない米・イラン双方が、国連総会に合わせて打開を目指しているという。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）によると、イランのアラグチ外相はニューヨークで記者団に対し、一定の条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡の通航を7日以内に再開する新たな提案を米国側に提出したと明らかにした。

両国の衝突が7カ月近く続く中、原油相場は今週も不安定な値動きとなった。戦争の先行きを巡るまちまちなシグナルや、中東からの原油輸送が持ち直す兆し、米国がディーゼル輸出を禁止するとの観測に振り回されている。北海ブレントは年初来でなお70%以上上昇しており、インフレ圧力を強めている。

カロバール・キャピタルのハリス・クルシド最高投資責任者（CIO）は「状況に大きな変化がなければ、ブレントは100－110ドル近辺で推移するだろう」と指摘。「信頼できる段階的な合意が成立すれば、比較的早く100ドルを下回る可能性がある。一方、輸出や物流網で再び障害が起きれば120ドルも視野に入る」と述べた。

ペルシャ湾と世界市場を結ぶ狭い航路であるホルムズ海峡は、戦争の焦点となってきた。イランは同海峡に対する主権的な管理権を持つと主張。平時には世界の原油と天然ガス供給の約5分の1が同海峡を通過していた。一方、米国は同海峡の現状を変更してはならないと主張しつつ、イランの港湾を封鎖している。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ米大統領が引き続きイランとの協議に前向きだと説明。ただ、制裁措置と海上封鎖によって米国は強い立場にあり、交渉する必要はないとも強調した。トランプ氏は2月末、イランの核開発計画を終わらせるとの目的を掲げ、イスラエルと共同で攻撃に踏み切った。

items.title: ホワイトハウス、取材禁止の3社に立ち入り再び認める－地裁命令受け
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホワイトハウスは裁判所への提出書類で、トランプ米大統領が先週出入りを禁止した報道機関3社について、当面の立ち入りを再び認めたと明らかにした。

CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの3社は、連邦裁判所が出入り禁止措置の差し止めを命じた後、記者が再び立ち入りを認められたと明らかにした。これに先立ち3社は、判事の命令にもかかわらず、記者がホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否されたとしていた。

CNNとMS
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホワイトハウスは裁判所への提出書類で、トランプ米大統領が先週出入りを禁止した報道機関3社について、当面の立ち入りを再び認めたと明らかにした。

CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの3社は、連邦裁判所が出入り禁止措置の差し止めを命じた後、記者が再び立ち入りを認められたと明らかにした。これに先立ち3社は、判事の命令にもかかわらず、記者がホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否されたとしていた。

CNNとMS NOWは24日の放送で、立ち入りが認められたことを明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスのストッペリッチ報道運営局長は、政権が24日早朝、対象となった記者の立ち入りを再び認める手続きに着手したと説明した。立ち入りを再び認めるよう命じる裁判所命令は夜間に出され、ストッペリッチ氏によると、米東部時間午前9時55分までに記者証を受け取れる状態になった。

これに先立ち、ティモシー・J・ケリー米連邦地裁判事は、立ち入りを認めるよう命じたにもかかわらず入れないとの報道各社からの申し立てについて、ホワイトハウスに回答を求めていた。

ケリー判事は夜間に出した命令で、報道各社が起こした訴訟の審理が続く間、ホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを一時的に再び許可するよう命じた。命令は2週間有効となる。判事は、10月5日までに追加の裁判書類を受け取った後、記者の立ち入りを延長するかどうかを検討するため、改めて審理の日程を設定するとした。

トランプ氏は9月18日、政権に不利な報道を行っているとして、3社のホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止すると発表した。その4日後に3社へ送付した正式な書簡で、政権は、政権に関する報道に伴う国家安全保障上の懸念に基づく決定だと説明した。

裁判所に提出された同書簡では、匿名の情報源に依拠したとみられる報道や、イランや国際的な制裁、共和党大会などの問題について、政権内部の協議や当局者が取った行動に関する情報を明らかにした報道が複数取り上げられていた。

FAST

Sept 24 : Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders a combined 50.1 per cent of voting power, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the planning.
The new arrangement, which emulates a founder-control structure at Palantir, would award the co-founders a special class of shares giving them collective voting control in most corporate matters, and would apply as long as three of the seven co-founders retain a minimum number of shares in the company, according to the report.
Anthropic did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
One significant exception to the founders' control is the election of the members on Anthropic's board, which has seven seats, one of which is currently vacant, according to the report.

The company is also planning to give employees a special class of stock that would serve as tie-breaker votes on some corporate issues, the report said.
Anthropic, which has been viewed for months as the leader in enterprise AI, is preparing for what could be one of the biggest IPOs on record.
The company could push its IPO to after the US midterm elections in November, with the poll not expected to have a major impact on the offering, Reuters reported earlier this month.
The Claude maker had raised $65 billion at a post-money valuation of $965 billion in May.

items.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: US-China AI Arms Race (Podcast)
items.summary:
Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping addressed their intense competition over artificial intelligence on Thursday during a summit aimed at keeping ties between the world’s largest economies on track. How the leaders are handling AI is one of the key questions looming over the state visit, with the US president arguing for unfettered development to keep his nation’s edge. China, meanwhile, has criticized American export controls on semiconductors and other inputs that it argues constrains its companies. By contrast, China’s top leader indicated some openness to setting boundaries.

NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付...
items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（24日）＝ドル上昇、利回り上昇　Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい
7:20 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まったことに加え、堅調な米経済成長への期待を背景に米国債利回りの上昇が続いていることでドル買いが進んでいる。    終盤の取引でドル／円は０．３２％高の１５８．８２円。 片山さつき財務相はこの日、７月の日米協調為替介入を支えた基本原則はなお維持されているとの認識を示したものの、先週の日銀利上げを受けても金融引き締めペースの加速につながるとの見方は広がらず、市場心理は引き続き不安定な状態にある。    日銀は１７─１８日の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を１．２５％に引き上げたものの直後に円安が進み、関係筋によると日銀は１８日、為替介入の準備段階とされる「レートチェック」に踏み切っていた。    米国では企業活動の拡大と物価圧力の高まりを示す経済指標を受け、この日も国債利回りが上昇。３０年債利回りは２００４年６月以来、１０年債利回りは約２０年ぶりの高水準を付けた。この日は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアに対するミサイル攻撃を受け原油価格が再び上昇。インフレ懸念の高まりにつながっている。    ＦＲＢは１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げ実施が示唆された。    ＦＯＭＣ後、複数のＦＲＢ当局者がインフレ鈍化が進まなければ追加利上げの可能性があるとの認識を表明。この日はフィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁がインフレ率をＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すには追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示したほか、クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁はインフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引けばインフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。    ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定する確率は６８．６％。１週間前の５５．４％から上昇した。    ＦＸストリート（ニューヨーク）のシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサーニ氏は「２年債利回りは２００８年の金融危機以降のレンジ上限にあり、３０年債利回りは２２年ぶりの高水準、１０年債利回りも１９年ぶりの高水準にある。外為市場参加者にとっては、これ以上の説明は必要ないだろう」とし、「ＦＲＢは今回の原油高は供給ショックによるものと理解しており、その影響をある程度見極めようとしている。ＦＲＢは第３・四半期の経済成長見通しに注目している」と述べた。    終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０１．２８。上昇は４営業日連続で、一時は１０１．３９と、７月２９日以来の高水準を付けた。    ユーロ／ドルは０．０７％安の１．１３７２ドル。一時は１．１３５８ドルに下落し、７月２８日以来の安値を更新した。    ドルはスイスフランに対し０．３４％高の０．８２８スイスフラン。一時は０．８２９６スイスフランに上昇し、２０２５年５月以来の高水準を付けた。スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）はこの日、予想通り政策金利を０％に据え置いた。足元でスイスフランが軟化する中、為替市場への介入は「必要に応じて」行うとし、従来より姿勢を軟化させた。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時２００４年以来の高水準を付けた。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者らが高インフレ抑制に向けた追加利上げの必要性に言及したことが背景にある。    この日は、米フィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁やニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が、さらなる利上げが必要となる可能性が高いとの見解を示した。nL6N45G0X6 nL6N45G0MH    ＣＭＥグループのフェドウォッチによると、トレーダーは現在、１０月の次回連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での追加利上げ確率を約７０％と見ている。２３日終盤時点では６６％だった。    ２３日の５年債入札が低調だったことも、利回り上昇に拍車を掛けた。２４日は、７年債入札後も利回りが総じて高い水準を維持した。    コネティカット州ウェストポートに拠点を置くウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシェ氏は「ＦＲＢが０．２５％、あるいは０．５％の追加利上げを行うことは疑わないが、それでも市場が織り込む水準には追い付いていない」と述べた。    米財務省が、市場の流動性を支えるための継続的な国債買い戻しの一環で、２０・３０年債を４０億７８００万ドル分買い戻したと発表した後、３０年債利回りの上昇幅はわずかに拡大した。このオペでは、１０４億６８００万ドル相当の国債が売り出された。同省は最大６０億ドル相当の国債を買い戻す方針を明らかにしていた。    ３０年債利回りは終盤７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．４７２％。一時５．５０１６％と、２００４年６月以来の高水準を付けた。    指標となる１０年債利回りは７．１ｂｐ上昇の５．１８５％。一時５．２２５１％と、１９年ぶりの高水準を更新した。    ７年債利回りは終盤５．１３３％に上昇した。    ＦＲＢの金利見通しに連動しやすい２年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ上昇の４．９１４％。    景気見通しの指標とされる２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２６．９ｂｐだった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と米国債利回りが上昇する中、マイクロソフト が軟調な一方、 メタ・プラットフォームズが値上がりした。    Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は取引時間中の安値から持ち直した。米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとロイターが報じたことが背景にある。    原油市場では北海ブレント先物が３％超上昇。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受け、供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。    ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのシニア投資ディレクター、ビル・ノーシー氏は「現在われわれが一つの大きな材料に直面しているという見方を強めるものだ」とし、「原油とインフレ、それが金利に与える影響、さらに金利が資本市場全体に与える影響だ 」と述べた。    ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２４日、インフレリスクを抑制するために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が年末までに再び利上げを行う必要があるかもしれないと考えるのは「妥当」だと述べた。    Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち８業種が下落し、素材や主要消費財の下げが目立った。    人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の主要銘柄はまちまちで、マイクロソフトが０．５％安、ブロードコムが１．３％安となる一方、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は２．４％上昇した。    メタは４．５％高。同社は前日、新たなＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」 を利用するための小型端末「メタ・チャーム」を発表した。    オラクルは３．５％下落。ニューメキシコ州のデータセンター開発を手がけるブルー・アウル傘下企業に「不可抗力」を通知したと報じられたことが響いた。ブルー・アウルも下落した。    ＭＧＭリゾーツは１１％急落。富豪のバリー・ディラー氏率いる米メディアのピープルが買収計画を撤回したことが響いた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ ＦＲＢの利上げ観測が強まる中、原油価格の上昇やドル高を背景に下落した。１２月限の清算値は０．５％安の１オンス＝４２９８ドル。現物は１８００ＧＭＴ（米東部時間午後２時）時点で０．５％安の４２６５．５０ドル。一時９月１６日以来の安値を記録した。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

items.title: Imran Khan’s son warns of “counterassault” as Pakistan cracks down ahead of Sept 27 Tehreek-e-Insaf protest seeking Khan's release
items.summary: Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan’s son Kasim Khan on Friday warned supporters against marching towards Adiala jail during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf's (PTI) planned September 27 protest, ...
items.body:
Imran Khan’s son warns of “counterassault” as Pakistan cracks down ahead of Sept 27 Tehreek-e-Insaf protest seeking Khan's release Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan’s son Kasim Khan on Friday warned supporters against marching towards Adiala jail during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf's (PTI) planned September 27 protest, alleging that the mobilisation could be used as a pretext for a “counter” assault by the Pakistani authorities on the prison, which could endanger his father's life.
ANI | Updated: 25-09-2026 10:48 IST | Created: 25-09-2026 10:48 IST

Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan’s son Kasim Khan on Friday warned supporters against marching towards Adiala jail during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf's (PTI) planned September 27 protest, alleging that the mobilisation could be used as a pretext for a “counter” assault by the Pakistani authorities on the prison, which could endanger his father's life. The warning comes ahead of the PTI's planned September 27 protest and march, which the party has called to demand Imran Khan's release. The former premier has remained in prison since August 2023 following convictions in multiple cases.
In a post on X, Kasim Khan said he had been instructed to appeal to the public to avoid attempting to march or protest near Adiala jail. "I’ve been instructed to call on the public not to attempt to march or protest nearby Adiala jail on 27. I’ve heard from sources that this may be used as an excuse for the establishment to launch a “counter” assault on the jail (Which my father is being held in), which could endanger his life. Please do not give them any reasons for “accidents” to happen to my father during the protest," Kasim's post read.
His warning comes amid heightened security measures across Punjab ahead of the PTI demonstration. The provincial government in Pakistan's Punjab region has imposed Section 144 across the province from September 23 to October 5, prohibiting gatherings of five or more people in public places and roads. Authorities have also sought the deployment of Pakistan Rangers in Rawalpindi, Attock, Jhelum and Mianwali.
The restrictions were cited as being linked to security concerns, with a provincial notification referring to what it described as a “serious and imminent threat” to public peace and safety from militant and terrorist organisations and hostile intelligence agencies. The planned protest has also coincided with the detention of three of Imran Khan's sisters. Aleema Khan was detained last week, followed by the detention of Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi for 30 days under the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance.
On Thursday, the Lahore High Court declined to immediately suspend the detention orders against Uzma and Noreen while issuing notices to the respondents and seeking their responses before proceeding with the plea. The detentions have become another flashpoint ahead of the September 27 mobilisation. According to Dawn, lawyers representing Uzma and Noreen argued before the Lahore High Court that the two women were “non-political” and had been detained without sufficient legal justification. The court, however, decided to await the authorities' response before ruling on the request for suspension.
Kasim Khan had earlier criticised the detention of his aunts and other relatives, calling for international attention to the developments. “This is a disgrace. Now my Aunts Dr. Uzma and Noreen, along with my cousins Shershah and Shahrez, have now been abducted as well. They have broken into my aunties' and cousins' houses and forced them into vehicles with no explanation. No reasons for arrest have been stated," he said in a post on X.
The Pakistani authorities have maintained that the preventive detention measures and restrictions are connected to public-order and security concerns. The Punjab government's notification specifically cited threats from militant organisations and other security risks in imposing the province-wide restrictions. The September 27 PTI protest is expected to add to the political and security pressures surrounding Imran Khan's continued incarceration, with authorities tightening restrictions and deploying additional security personnel in areas linked to the planned mobilisation. (ANI)

items.title: US, India should intensify efforts to conclude “historic” trade deal, lower tariffs: USIBC President
items.summary: The US and India should intensify efforts to conclude a “historic” trade agreement that lowers trade barriers and minimises tariffs, providing greater certainty to the bilateral economic and strategic ...
items.body:
US, India should intensify efforts to conclude “historic” trade deal, lower tariffs: USIBC President  The US and India should intensify efforts to conclude a “historic” trade agreement that lowers trade barriers and minimises tariffs, providing greater certainty to the bilateral economic and strategic partnership, US-India Business Council (USIBC) President, Ambassador (ret.) Atul Keshap said, according to a statement by USIBC. 

ANI | Updated: 25-09-2026 10:46 IST | Created: 25-09-2026 10:46 IST

US-India Business Council (USIBC) President, Atul Keshap (Photo/ANI). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The US and India should intensify efforts to conclude a “historic” trade agreement that lowers trade barriers and minimises tariffs, providing greater certainty to the bilateral economic and strategic partnership, US-India Business Council (USIBC) President, Ambassador (ret.) Atul Keshap said, according to a statement by USIBC. Calling on both governments to intensify efforts to conclude a trade agreement, Keshap said unlocking reciprocal trade would build on the record investments made in 2026 and benefit businesses in both India and the US.
“Unlocking reciprocal trade will build on 2026’s record investments and secure a win for American and Indian business that delivers immediate benefits to working families by boosting manufacturing, opening vast new consumer markets, and cementing both nations as global leaders in AI,” he said. According to Keshap, the agreement would build on the progress made this year and provide greater certainty to the important economic and strategic partnership between the two countries.
“We call on both governments to use this opportunity to conclude an agreement that lowers trade barriers, and minimizes tariffs. A historic agreement would encapsulate this year’s hard-won progress providing greater certainty to an incredibly consequential economic and strategic bilateral partnnership,” the statement read. He also highlighted, the USIBC members strongly support the US-India partnership and are keen to work with both governments to deepen cooperation between the two economies.
“U.S.-India Business Council members are steadfast champions of this partnership. We look forward to working with both governments to accelerate collaboration between the world’s largest economy and its fastest-growing major economy.” the statement added further. In a seperate development, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal on Thursday said India and the US have “done and dusted” the trade pact and will execute it once Washington gives India the right competitive advantage over its rivals in the American market.
Speaking at the 13th Annual Forum 2026 India 3.0, the Minister said, “The nine agreements and I include the US which is almost done and dusted. We have to find the right comparable competitive advantage over our competitors so that we can quickly execute the agreement.” The US remained the top destination for Indian exports, with goods shipments rising to USD 42.79 billion in April-August from USD 40.39 billion a year earlier as per Reuters. (ANI)

items.title: Police arrest actors, politicians protesting against Netanyahu outside UN
items.author: Maria Tsvetkova
items.creator: Maria Tsvetkova
items.summary: Oscar-winning actor Susan Sarandon and Emmy winner Hannah Einbinder among those arrested.
items.body:
Police arrested at least 30 people including actors and politicians as they protested outside United Nations headquarters on Thursday against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of his speech at the General Assembly.
Oscar-winning actor Susan Sarandon, Emmy winner Hannah Einbinder, Democratic congressional candidate Darializa Avila Chevalier and New York City council member Chi Osse were among those arrested.
“What’s being done to Gaza, the obliteration of an entire society, in our name, with our tax dollars, this is our responsibility to speak out against, and Netanyahu has no right to use the platform of the United Nations to justify these atrocities,” said Manijeh Moradian, a 50-year-old university professor of Iranian and Jewish heritage, who took part in the protest.
At the General Assembly, Netanyahu [USN:L1N45G05J TEXT:"defended Israel's actions"] in the region, seeking to counter growing international isolation ahead of elections he could lose, as dozens of delegates streamed out of the General Assembly Hall.
The rally was organized by Jewish Voice for Peace, a Jewish activist group that supports Palestinians. Around 200 people gathered outside the United Nations in identical white T-shirts with printed slogans "Fund people not bombs," "No war" and "Free Palestine."
The group blocked traffic, and police ordered them to leave through loudspeakers. Some people moved to the sidewalks, but the core group of protesters remained seated on the pavement and continued chanting anti-Netanyahu slogans as police officers, who arrived on bicycles, surrounded them.
One by one officers pulled protesters from the group, tied their hands behind their backs with zip ties and escorted them to police buses. The activists kept chanting "Netanyahu go to hell" outside the buses.

items.title: Rangers take finale vs. Mets, stay level with Astros atop division
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kumar Rocker pitched five solid innings on Thursday afternoon for the Texas Rangers, who salvaged the finale of a three-game series and boosted their playoff hopes with a 3-1 victory over the New York Mets in Arlington, Texas.
items.body:
Kumar Rocker pitched five solid innings on Thursday afternoon for the Texas Rangers, who salvaged the finale of a three-game series and boosted their playoff hopes with a 3-1 victory over the New York Mets in Arlington, Texas.
Josh Jung hit the go-ahead, two-run homer in the first and Corey Seager went deep in the sixth for the Rangers (79-80), who remain tied with Houston (79-80) for first place in the American League West. The Astros opened a season-ending, four-game series against the Athletics with a 7-5 win later Thursday night in West Sacramento, Calif.
Houston won the season series over the Rangers 9-4, meaning Texas must take the division outright to reach the postseason.
Jung finished 3-for-3 and raised his season average to .299.
Carson Benge had an RBI single in the first inning for the Mets (73-86), who fell two games behind the Washington Nationals in the race to get out of last place in the National League East. The teams are scheduled to play in the final series of the season this weekend in Washington.
New York hasn't finished in last place since 2003.
Rocker (6-11) allowed one run on three hits and two walks while striking out four in his first start against the Mets, who drafted but did not sign him in 2021 due to concerns over his arm.
Robert Garcia, Tyler Alexander and Chase Silseth combined for three innings of one-hit ball before Jordan Montgomery recorded his first save of the season and the second of his nine-year career with a perfect ninth.
Montgomery recorded his first save on Sept, 11, 2024, when he tossed the final three innings for the Arizona Diamondbacks in their 14-4 win over the Rangers.
Zac Thornton (5-6) took the hard-luck loss for the Mets after allowing two runs on four hits and one walk while striking out four over five innings. The left-hander finished his rookie season with a 3.42 ERA in 15 starts.
Four players had a hit apiece for the Mets -- including Brett Baty, whose single in the seventh inning extended his on-base streak to 17 straight games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: White Sox rout Royals, clinch first playoff berth since 2021
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Miguel Vargas had two hits and two RBIs, Kyle Teel homered and David Sandlin delivered six strong innings as the visiting Chicago White Sox routed the Kansas City Royals 9-1 on Thursday to clinch an American League playoff berth.
items.body:
Miguel Vargas had two hits and two RBIs, Kyle Teel homered and David Sandlin delivered six strong innings as the visiting Chicago White Sox routed the Kansas City Royals 9-1 on Thursday to clinch an American League playoff berth.
Chicago (82-77) is back in the postseason for the first time since 2021 after enduring three straight 100-loss seasons.
Fueled by an early barrage against Royals right-hander Randy Dobnak, the White Sox remained a game behind the AL Central-leading Guardians (83-76). Cleveland won 1-0 at Boston later Thursday. Chicago holds the head-to-head tiebreaker over Cleveland. Whichever one of those two teams fails to win the division will wind up as the third AL wild-card team.
The White Sox scored three runs in each of the first two innings against Kansas City (68-91). Vargas and Tristan Peters contributed RBI singles in the first inning while Vargas added another run-scoring single in the second.
Sandlin, a rookie righty, pitched comfortably with the lead. He worked around Bobby Witt Jr.'s one-out double to escape the first inning in 17 pitches and needed 85 pitches to complete his outing.
Sandlin (3-2) yielded one run and five hits with zero walks against seven strikeouts.
Dobnak (3-5) allowed six runs (four earned) and six hits in 1 1/3 innings. He had one walk and one strikeout while throwing a wild pitch and committing an error on a pickoff attempt.
Teel reached reliever Alex Lange for a solo shot to start the fourth and Peters had an RBI forceout later in the inning.
Salvador Perez homered leading off the bottom of the fourth to bring the Royals to within 8-1. It marked Perez's 20th round-tripper this season, his sixth consecutive campaign reaching that plateau.
John Rave and Jason Isbel had two hits apiece for Kansas City. Witt Jr. has reached base in 21 consecutive games.
Sam Antonacci, Chase Meidroth, Braden Montgomery and Teel joined Vargas with two-hit efforts for Chicago. Andrew Benintendi and Peters also had two RBIs.
Chicago won the season series from Kansas City 9-4.
The White Sox have won four of five while the Royals have lost six of seven.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Inside Reuters' calculation of Australia's housing market ripple effects
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: To estimate the economic impact, Reuters calculated the commercial spending typically generated when an Australian sells a home, buys another and moves.
items.body:
For most Australian homeowners, the cost of the country's sharpest housing downturn in years has been the modest fall in property values since interest rates began rising in February.
But while prices have dipped only slightly, home sales have fallen sharply. Reuters set out to [USN:L4N45008Y TEXT:"measure the impact"] on the businesses that depend on housing turnover.
Those businesses span a vast ecosystem built during Australia's quarter-century property boom. Real estate agents, conveyancers, auctioneers, property listing sites, furniture stagers and building inspectors largely earn revenue when homes change hands. Removalists, painters, landscapers, renovators and furniture retailers are also exposed to sales activity, though they make money elsewhere too.
To estimate the economic impact, Reuters calculated the commercial spending typically generated when an Australian sells a home, buys another and moves.
The analysis covered costs from agent commissions and listing preparations through settlement, moving expenses and purchases of furniture and appliances. Low and high estimates of individual goods were used to derive an impact range.
State governments were excluded, despite collecting large stamp-duty revenues and seeing their [USN:L4N4570GO TEXT:"revenue hit"] by the slowdown, because they are not commercial entities. Banks were also excluded because most housing-related earnings come from mortgage repayments rather than transaction volumes.
The analysis was based on Australia's median home price of A$1.11 million ($790,000) and the most common dwelling type, a three-bedroom detached house. For each good or service, Reuters used a mainstream advertised price range rather than extreme outliers. Agent commissions, for example, were assumed at the common 2% to 3% range.
A new couch might cost anywhere from A$20 on Marketplace to A$60,000 from an exclusive boutique. Instead, we used the cheapest widely available option (A$219 from Kogan.com.au) and the priciest mainstream offering (A$8,796 from King Furniture), applying the same methodology across all items.
Each item was then weighted by the likelihood of the expense occurring. Costs nearly universal to a transaction, such as agent commissions and conveyancing settled on software platform PEXA, received a 100% weighting.
Less common expenses received lower weightings. For example, painting a three-bedroom home before sale typically costs A$4,500 to A$10,000, but a 2023 Houzz survey found only a quarter of sellers do so. Pre-sale painting was therefore weighted at 25%.
Based on feedback from economists, Reuters also adjusted for the roughly 60-40 split between owner-occupiers and investors. A survey by removalist website Muval found 39% of Australians bought entertainment appliances when moving home, but only about 60% of property purchases are made by owner-occupiers. Television purchases were therefore weighted at 23%.
Economists also pointed to the "wealth effect" whereby people spend less when they believe their home's value is falling. We excluded that from our analysis because the project focused solely on spending directly linked to property transactions.
Some effects, after all, are much harder to measure.
($1 = 1.4088 Australian dollars)

items.title: Billions in collateral damage: The hidden cost of Australia's housing slowdown
items.author: Byron Kaye, Stella Qiu
items.creator: Byron Kaye, Stella Qiu
items.summary: As higher interest rates and the government's rollback of key property tax concessions sap demand, a sharp drop in home sales is hitting a vast ecosystem of businesses that rely on properties changing hands.
items.body:
This time last year, Sydney property stylist Joanne Cauchi was turning away work, buying new furniture and overseeing home installations almost every day.
Now, her team of three stylists and two removalists handles as few as three jobs a week and has stopped buying inventory altogether.
"Usually springtime, and this time of year in particular, is ridiculously busy," said Cauchi. "It is very quiet."
The abrupt slowdown illustrates how Australia's housing slump is rippling far beyond real estate agents and mortgage lenders. As higher interest rates and the government's rollback of key property tax concessions sap demand, a sharp drop in home sales is hitting a vast ecosystem of businesses that rely on properties changing hands, from furniture stylists and landscapers to conveyancers, removalists and painters.
The damage stems less from falling prices than from a sharp drop in turnover. Home prices are down less than 4% from their March peak and remain above year-ago levels, but far fewer homes are changing hands.
A 15% drop in housing turnover since June from a year earlier is stripping an estimated A$355 million to A$710 million ($253 million to $505 million) a month from the property-adjacent economy, according to [USN:L4N45E08X TEXT:"a Reuters analysis"] of the spending triggered when Australians buy, sell and move into a home.
Even allowing for annual market swings, housing turnover remains 10.5% below its five-year average, data from property consultant Cotality showed. Reuters calculations suggest that translates into A$2.8 billion to A$5.6 billion less annual spending flowing through businesses that depend on homes changing hands, from furniture retailers and tradespeople to small conveyancing firms.
The figure pales beside Australia's A$600 billion-plus annual home sales, but for numerous businesses that depend on housing turnover, it is substantial.
The analysis estimated the cost of the goods and services typically purchased when an average three-bedroom detached home changes hands, based on market price ranges and weighted spending patterns from industry or government data.
"You get this big dollar number of 'this is how much loss to the economy there is as a result of those lost home purchases'," said James Graham, a University of Sydney senior lecturer who studies housing economics.
Graham said the Reuters methodology was reasonable but noted it excluded the "wealth effect", where falling home values weigh on spending by denting confidence.
A typical Australian home move triggers spending across a wide range of services, from agents to conveyancers to painters and utility providers, with buyers often also purchasing new furniture and appliances after relocating.
"All of the real estate sectors are going to have less income coming in," Graham said.
QUICK HIT Property's outsized role in Australia's economy was entrenched by tax incentives introduced over the past quarter century, helping drive Sydney and Melbourne into the ranks of the world's least affordable housing markets.
After three interest rate increases since February, the centre-left government took further heat out of the housing market by trimming capital gains tax breaks for existing-home sellers and tightening negative-gearing rules for landlords.
A spokesperson for Treasurer Jim Chalmers did not respond to a request for comment.
Home sales volumes, which had risen in March, were down 11% in May and 20% in July, according to Cotality.
"It's the most severe drop we've seen since the very start of COVID," said Russell Cohen, CEO of conveyancing technology platform PEXA (PXA.AX) , which gets paid when an Australian property sale settles. After growing Australian sales 8% in the year to June, volumes dived 15% in July and stayed there through August, Cohen said in an interview.
The slowdown is also hurting corporate earnings. Homewares chain Harvey Norman (HVN.AX) said franchise profit in its June half fell 15%, reversing growth of 14% in the previous six months, citing "reduced appetite for home-related purchases and renovation activity".
EXODUS For many businesses, the downturn is already forcing painful choices.
At The Moving Box Company, which supplies new and used freight cartons, four factory-floor workers have left since April after having their hours reduced. Headcount has fallen to 9 from 13, leaving managers to take on packing and delivery work themselves.
"That's practically how we've had to manage the situation: by reducing the hours of staff," said general manager James Wotherspoon, noting sales were down 19% since June year-on-year.
"If we can't give them the hours, I totally respect the fact that they've got to find work elsewhere to survive."
For conveyancers and selling agents, the downturn has coincided with the introduction of anti-money laundering rules in July that require greater customer due diligence, adding compliance costs just as revenue is falling.
"We're definitely seeing more conversations being had from smaller operators about merging or selling, some retiring out of the industry entirely," said David Winning, founder of Your Move Conveyancing and director of the Australian Institute of Conveyancers NSW Division.
The Real Estate Institute of Victoria said 350 of 6,600 agent members planned to cancel their membership, with more than half leaving the profession altogether.
"We could expect to see a very significant exodus of sales agents," said Jacob Caine, president of the Real Estate Institute of Australia, by phone.
Buyers' agent Zoran Solano said he was ending his office lease and would work remotely after revenue halved since May.
"Everyone is being affected," he said. "It's much more widespread than I think people realise."
($1 = 1.4057 Australian dollars)

items.title: Cubs lock up playoff berth with win over Marlins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Nico Hoerner ripped a go-ahead RBI single in the sixth and Matthew Boyd tossed seven strong innings, helping the host Chicago Cubs clinch a playoff berth with a 2-1 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday afternoon.
items.body:
Nico Hoerner ripped a go-ahead RBI single in the sixth and Matthew Boyd tossed seven strong innings, helping the host Chicago Cubs clinch a playoff berth with a 2-1 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday afternoon.
Chicago's Pete Crow-Armstrong walked to lead off the first inning and promptly stole second base to become the seventh player in major league history to record at least 40 homers and 40 stolen bases in a single season.
Armstrong, who has 45 homers, joined Jose Canseco (1988), Barry Bonds (1996), Alex Rodriguez (1998), Alfonso Soriano (2006), Ronald Acuna Jr. (2023) and Shohei Ohtani (2024) as the only players to reach the 40-40 milestone.
Seiya Suzuki belted a solo homer in the fifth inning to highlight his two-hit performance for the Cubs, who salvaged the finale of their three-game series with Miami.
Boyd (10-5) allowed one run on five hits to record his second straight victory following a 0-4 stretch over his previous six starts.
Daniel Palencia bridged the gap to Ryan Zeferjahn, who retired the side in order in the ninth inning to secure his seventh save of the season.
The Cubs (88-71) currently hold the National League's second wild-card spot. They sit one game back of the San Diego Padres (89-70), who beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-2 Thursday night. Chicago is one game ahead of the Philadelphia Phillies (87-72), who lost 5-1 to the Milwaukee Brewers on Thursday.
Jakob Marsee had an RBI single in the third inning for the Marlins (78-81), who have lost four of their last six games.
With the game tied 1-1, Ian Happ tripled off Jack Ralston (0-2) to lead off the sixth inning and came home on Hoerner's RBI single to left field.
Ralston permitted two runs on three hits in 1 1/3 innings.
Brian Navarreto doubled to lead off the third inning against Matthew Boyd before coming home on Marsee's RBI single to center to open the scoring.
Suzuki forged a tie in the fifth inning, depositing a 1-0 pitch from Ralston over the wall in center field. The homer was Suzuki's 26th of the season and second in his last four games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: UBS株上昇、外銀との統合など検討報道－モルガン・スタンレーは下落
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： スイスの金融大手UBSグループの株価が24日に上昇する一方、米モルガン・スタンレーは下落した。スイス国内で資本規制が厳格化される可能性に直面する中、チューリヒに本拠を置くUBSが、他国・地域の銀行との取引を含む選択肢を検討しているとの報道を受けた。

セマフォーの報道によると、UBSはスイスの規制当局の監督下から抜ける方法を巡る協議を再開した。選択肢の1つとして、モルガン・スタンレーやドイツ銀行、スタンダードチャータードなどの外国銀行との統合が考えられると、同メディアは報じた。

今週これまでに、スイス議会上院の過半数が、同国最大の銀行であるUBSに自己資本の積み増しを義務付ける案を支持した。UBSは、この措置により普通株式等Tier1（CET1）資本を160億ドル（約2兆5400億円）追加で保有する必要があると試算している。

24日のニューヨーク市場で午後3時10分（日本時間25日午前4時10分）時点、モルガン・スタンレー株は1%下落し、ドイツ銀行株も0.6%安。スタンダードチャータード株は1%下落した。一方、UBS株は0.9%上昇。

UBS、ドイツ銀行、スタンダードチャータードの各行担当者からは、コメント要請に対する回答がすぐには得られなかった。モルガン・スタンレーの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

items.title: Five takeaways from Trump's summit with Xi in Washington
items.author: Simon Lewis, Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
items.creator: Simon Lewis, Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
items.summary: The US secured an extension of its trade truce this week - but only a short one.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday, with talks on trade and artificial intelligence and the growing strategic rivalry between the countries all in the spotlight during an elaborate state visit.
Here are some major takeaways from the talks:
TRADE DEAL EXTENDED, FOR NOW The US secured an extension of its trade truce this week - but only a short one.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two sides agreed to extend by two months a trade agreement that ended last year's trade war and was due to expire in November. The extension would give Washington and Beijing "more time to see what we can do on the economic front," he said.
But rather than locking in a durable agreement, the extension appears to push the central questions — tariffs, Chinese purchases, rare-earth supplies and technology restrictions — into the next round of negotiations.
Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing was meeting its requirement in the earlier agreement to buy 25 million tons of soybeans but was lagging on its pledge to buy $17 billion in other agricultural goods. US officials have said rare-earth deliveries were also falling short, another sign that significant gaps remain.
For companies, the result is a familiar form of instability: tariff rates remain lower for now, but decisions must still be made against a shifting policy backdrop.
DRESS TO IMPRESS For Trump, Xi's White House visit was an opportunity to show off a Washington being remade in his image.
After Xi treated Trump in Beijing to a tour around a Ming dynasty temple and a walled-off garden retreat rarely opened to foreigners, the US president returned the favor with a different kind of spectacle: Troops wearing wigs and tri-corner hats marched in formation and played music in a Rose Garden redesigned to look like a Trump golf club.
Fighter jets and bombers roared overhead during ceremonies staged on Wednesday and Thursday, one so loud it caused Trump to flinch.
When the White House press corps was called to cover the two leaders, it wasn’t to hear them talk about the weighty affairs of state. Instead, it was to watch them tour the Marine One helicopter and the recently redesigned South Lawn of the White House, replete with a large helipad emblazoned with the presidential seal.
Speaking to reporters, Trump brushed away questions about their policy discussions.
“He loves good granite,” Trump said of Xi. “Great meeting.”
XI WANTS US 'PRUDENCE' OVER TAIWAN As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue, saying, according to China's official news agency, that China hoped the United States would "handle the Taiwan question with prudence."
The agency's English-language service also wrote that Xi hoped the US would oppose Taiwan independence.
That would be a tougher version of Washington's long-standing formulation that it does not "support" independence. There are no signs that the Trump administration plans to change its wording.
There was no immediate White House readout of the exchange, but US officials have long avoided explicitly stating opposition to Taiwanese independence. Any shift in language would raise questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoke opposition in Congress.
STRATEGIC RISK Xi, not for the first time while meeting Trump, invoked the "Thucydides Trap", an academic theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends toward war.
While the Chinese leader said the risk "can be overcome," his reference underscored how concerns about a potential US-China military conflict continue to shadow relations between the world's two largest powers.
Xi argued that both nations stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation, and he called for regular military dialogue and stronger crisis-prevention mechanisms.
Trump, for his part, drew on the two nations' shared history to emphasize the potential for cooperation. They could accomplish much by pursuing common interests, he said, invoking their wartime alliance against Japan.
DIFFERENCES ON AI The two leaders expressed diverging views about artificial intelligence.
Trump, who has declared that AI should be called super intelligence, or SI, said in a social media post that he wants to “to leave it exactly where it is" and rely on the US Department of Justice rather than impose any new guardrails. He insisted that China held the same position.
But Xi said on Thursday that, as leading nations on AI, China and the US must manage its growth.
“We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good, and ensure that the development of AI is always under human control and serves the well-being of the people,” Xi said.
Some of the biggest names in AI were expected to attend Trump's [USN:L1N45E0H3 TEXT:"state dinner"] at the White House on Thursday for Xi, including Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Sundar Pichai, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's (NVDA.O) Jensen Huang.

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米ホワイトハウスが人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックに対し、米当局による審査が完了するまで、英国の試験担当者らに新ＡＩモデルを共有しないよう求めていたことが分かった。米メディアのポリティコが２４日、米政府高官や関係筋の話として報じた。

ＡＩが外部システムに侵入するなどの「暴走」事例が相次いで報告されているほか、アンソロピックの研究者２人が、ＡＩの急速な進歩によって近い将来に「人類滅亡」につながる可能性があると警告したことを受け、ＡＩの安全性を巡る議論が活発化している。

また、オーストラリア政府は２４日、オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントが今年６月、豪政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルに不正アクセスしていたと明らかにした。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と...
items.body:
米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ５００横ばい、中東協議進展観測で持ち直す
5:25 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で15日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［２４日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種がほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。中東情勢の不透明感から原油価格と米国債利回りが上昇する中、マイクロソフト が軟調な一方、 メタ・プラットフォームズが値上がりした。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は取引時間中の安値から持ち直した。米国とイランがニューヨークで続けている協議で、イランがホルムズ海峡を開放し米国が対イラン経済封鎖を解除するという、段階的な戦闘終結への道筋が模索されているとロイターが報じたことが背景にある。

原油市場では北海ブレント先物が３％超上昇。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を受け、供給混乱への懸念が再燃した。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのシニア投資ディレクター、ビル・ノーシー氏は「現在われわれが一つの大きな材料に直面しているという見方を強めるものだ」とし、「原油とインフレ、それが金利に与える影響、さらに金利が資本市場全体に与える影響だ 」と述べた。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２４日、インフレリスクを抑制するために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が年末までに再び利上げを行う必要があるかもしれないと考えるのは「妥当」だと述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち８業種が下落し、素材や主要消費財の下げが目立った。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の主要銘柄はまちまちで、マイクロソフトが０．５％安、ブロードコムが１．３％安となる一方、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）は２．４％上昇した。

メタは４．５％高。同社は前日、新たなＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」 を利用するための小型端末「メタ・チャーム」を発表した。

オラクルは３．５％下落。ニューメキシコ州のデータセンター開発を手がけるブルー・アウル傘下企業に「不可抗力」を通知したと報じられたことが響いた。ブルー・アウルも下落した。

ＭＧＭリゾーツは１１％急落。富豪のバリー・ディラー氏率いる米メディアのピープルが買収計画を撤回したことが響いた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．９対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１６８億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１６７億株。

WASHINGTON, Sept 24 : The US government said on Thursday it had formally sought to join a legal challenge filed by billionaire Elon Musk to dismiss a fine of €120 million ($136.51 million) by the European Union against his social media platform X.
EU tech regulators fined X late last year for breaching online content rules, the first sanction under a landmark legislation that has drawn criticism from Washington.
The US Department of Justice said it had filed an application with the EU's General Court in support of X's effort to annul the case.
The EU sanction against X followed a two-year-long investigation under the bloc's Digital Services Act (DSA), which requires online platforms to do more to tackle illegal and harmful content.

"The European Commission inappropriately attempted to expand its regulatory authority to reach American companies not present or operating within its jurisdiction," Assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate of the US Justice Department's civil division said.
Europe's crackdown on Big Tech to ensure smaller rivals can compete and consumers have more choice has been criticised by the administration of US President Donald Trump, which alleges it singles out American companies.
The European Commission, the EU's executive, has said its laws do not target any nationality and that it is merely defending its digital and democratic standards, which it says serve as the benchmark for the rest of the world.
Musk, who has financially backed candidates from Trump's Republican Party in elections and supported Trump himself in the last election, has said the EU's tech regulations stall technological progress.
Since Musk's purchase of X, then known as Twitter, in 2022, rights advocates and experts have been widely critical of the platform over what they say is increased hate speech, misinformation and nonconsensual sexually explicit content.

FAST

Sept 24 : Akamai Technologies signed an $11.6 billion cloud services deal with Anthropic on Thursday, and issued a warrant that could give the AI lab up to 5 per cent stake in the cloud company, sending its shares surging 22 per cent in extended trading.
The agreement secures a long-term commitment from one of the fastest-growing AI companies, and adds to more than $2.8 billion in multi-year cloud infrastructure deals Akamai announced across its customer base this year.
Under the seven-year contract, the warrant would give Anthropic the right to purchase Series B shares at $111.33 each that converts into about 7.7 million shares of Akamai's common stock.
IPO-bound Anthropic has been aggressively expanding its computing power and securing the infrastructure needed to train and run increasingly powerful models, driving multibillion-dollar deals with cloud and data-center providers.

It agreed to spend $45 billion to rent AI cloud computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus, Reuters reported last month.
"Despite growing concerns about potential adverse consequences of agentic AI, infrastructure investment will continue to expand to support increasingly compute-intensive agentic workloads," said Emarketer analyst Jacob Bourne.
The potential stake "can be seen as a vote of confidence in the durability of AI-driven cloud demand."
A portion of the warrant representing about 2 per cent of Akamai's common stock outstanding is tied to Anthropic's $11.6 billion commitment, while the remaining 3 per cent would vest if the companies expand the agreement by up to another $9 billion.
Akamai said the total capital expenditure related to the initial commitment is estimated to be about $5.5 billion.
The company expects no impact to its annual revenue forecast, and an increase of about $1.7 billion in its 2026 capital spending to secure and pre-purchase components needed to support the agreement, including memory.
Separately, Akamai authorized electronics firm Jabil to purchase about $1.7 billion worth of memory components under an existing services agreement.

items.title: 米とイラン、段階的な合意模索－ホルムズ再開と海上封鎖解除巡り
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国とイランの交渉担当者は、イランがホルムズ海峡の通航を再開し、米国がイランの港湾に対する海上封鎖を解除する方向で段階的な合意を模索している。協議に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

両国はここ数カ月、同様の合意をいずれも拒んできたが、ニューヨークで開かれている国連総会に合わせて開かれた24日の協議で事態打開を目指している。関係者が匿名を条件に明らかにした。カタール当局者が交渉を仲介しているという。

段階的な合意は、米国とイランが6月半ばに締結した覚書と似た形になる見通しだ。ただ、この覚書を受けて不安定ながら成立した停戦は、わずか数週間後に崩壊した経緯がある。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ大統領はイランとの対話に引き続き前向きだとしつつ、米国は交渉する必要はないと強調した。制裁強化と海上封鎖がイラン経済に圧力をかけており、米国が有利な立場にあるためだと説明した。

米国とイランの断続的な交渉は、戦争開始以降、何度も決裂している。主な対立点はホルムズ海峡を巡る問題と、米国が凍結している数十億ドルの資金をイランがいつ利用できるようになるかだった。

国連総会出席のためニューヨークを訪れていたイランのペゼシュキアン大統領は演説で、制裁と米国による海上封鎖が続く限り、イランはホルムズ海峡での航行の自由を認めないと強調した。

イラン国営メディアによると、アラグチ外相がイラン側を代表して協議に臨み、ホルムズ海峡の通航再開を巡るイランの「確固たる立場」を説明。イラン側の報道によれば、条件には米国による海上封鎖の即時解除、イラン資産の凍結解除、「あらゆる戦線」での戦争終結が含まれる。「あらゆる戦線」での戦争終結とは、レバノンの親イラン・イスラム教シーア派組織ヒズボラに対してイスラエルが展開する軍事作戦を指しているとみられる。

ペゼシュキアン氏は24日夜に放送されたFOXニュースとのインタビューで、「われわれはホルムズ海峡を封鎖していない。法的な正当性も枠組みもないまま開かれていた。彼らがわれわれを攻撃した」と強調した。

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で158円後半　ＦＲＢ当局者タカ派発言で追加利上げ観測
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一...
items.body:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で158円後半　ＦＲＢ当局者タカ派発言で追加利上げ観測
4:53 配信

２００９年１１月撮影　REUTERS/Yuriko Nakao

［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇し、対円では一時９月２日以来のドル高／円安水準となる１５８．９８円を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を受けて追加利上げ観測が強まったことに加え、堅調な米経済成長への期待を背景に米国債利回りの上昇が続いていることでドル買いが進んでいる。

終盤の取引でドル／円は０．３２％高の１５８．８２円。 片山さつき財務相はこの日、７月の日米協調為替介入を支えた基本原則はなお維持されているとの認識を示したものの、先週の日銀利上げを受けても金融引き締めペースの加速につながるとの見方は広がらず、市場心理は引き続き不安定な状態にある。

日銀は１７─１８日の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を１．２５％に引き上げたものの直後に円安が進み、関係筋によると日銀は１８日、為替介入の準備段階とされる「レートチェック」に踏み切っていた。

米国では企業活動の拡大と物価圧力の高まりを示す経済指標を受け、この日も国債利回りが上昇。３０年債利回りは２００４年６月以来、１０年債利回りは約２０年ぶりの高水準を付けた。この日は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアに対するミサイル攻撃を受け原油価格が再び上昇。インフレ懸念の高まりにつながっている。

ＦＲＢは１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げ実施が示唆された。

ＦＯＭＣ後、複数のＦＲＢ当局者がインフレ鈍化が進まなければ追加利上げの可能性があるとの認識を表明。この日はフィラデルフィア地区連銀のポールソン総裁がインフレ率をＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すには追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示したほか、クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁はインフレ圧力はなお高く、この状況が長引けばインフレ率を目標水準に押し下げることが難しくなると述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定する確率は６８．６％。１週間前の５５．４％から上昇した。

ＦＸストリート（ニューヨーク）のシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサーニ氏は「２年債利回りは２００８年の金融危機以降のレンジ上限にあり、３０年債利回りは２２年ぶりの高水準、１０年債利回りも１９年ぶりの高水準にある。外為市場参加者にとっては、これ以上の説明は必要ないだろう」とし、「ＦＲＢは今回の原油高は供給ショックによるものと理解しており、その影響をある程度見極めようとしている。ＦＲＢは第３・四半期の経済成長見通しに注目している」と述べた。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１５％高の１０１．２８。上昇は４営業日連続で、一時は１０１．３９と、７月２９日以来の高水準を付けた。

ユーロ／ドルは０．０７％安の１．１３７２ドル。一時は１．１３５８ドルに下落し、７月２８日以来の安値を更新した。

ドルはスイスフランに対し０．３４％高の０．８２８スイスフラン。一時は０．８２９６スイスフランに上昇し、２０２５年５月以来の高水準を付けた。スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）はこの日、予想通り政策金利を０％に据え置いた。足元でスイスフランが軟化する中、為替市場への介入は「必要に応じて」行うとし、従来より姿勢を軟化させた。

items.title: Spencer Horwitz's sacrifice fly lifts Pirates over Cardinals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Spencer Horwitz's sacrifice fly in the eighth drove in the go-ahead run, and Paul Skenes concluded his season with a quality start as the Pittsburgh Pirates wrapped up their home schedule with a 2-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Thursday afternoon.
items.body:
Spencer Horwitz's sacrifice fly in the eighth drove in the go-ahead run, and Paul Skenes concluded his season with a quality start as the Pittsburgh Pirates wrapped up their home schedule with a 2-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Thursday afternoon.
Horwitz's fly ball to center was deep enough to allow Ronny Simon to score. Mason Montgomery recorded his 17th save after pitching a scoreless ninth and helping Pittsburgh (81-78) secure a .500 or better finish for the first time since 2018.
The Cardinals (77-82) are guaranteed to finish with back-to-back losing seasons for the first time since 1994-95.
St. Louis reliever Ryne Stanek (2-3) walked Simon with one out. A wild pitch and a throwing error by catcher Ivan Herrera as Simon was advancing to second allowed him to reach third, setting up Horwitz's RBI.
Skenes tossed 6 1/3 innings, struck out eight, walked two and allowed one run on three hits. His final strikeout of Leo Bernal was his 200th for the season and came on his 96th pitch. Skenes became the first Pirates pitcher to record 200-plus strikeouts in back-to-back seasons since Bob Veale (three straight from 1964-66).
Skenes, the National League's Cy Young Award winner last season, struggled at times but finished his 2026 campaign with a 10-11 record and a 3.82 ERA in 32 starts. He allowed one earned run or fewer in 14 of those starts.
Alec Burleson belted a solo home run -- his 24th of the season -- off Skenes with two outs in the first inning.
Pittsburgh answered in the bottom of the first as Oneil Cruz led off with a double, stole third and scored on an RBI single by Brandon Lowe. Cruz and Konnor Griffin each finished with two hits.
The Pirates' bullpen kept the Cardinals scoreless the rest of the way with Luke Weaver (4-1) striking out Jordan Walker to get Pittsburgh out of a jam in the top of the eighth inning. St. Louis had runners on first and second on one-out singles by JJ Wetherholt and Herrera.
Wetherholt led the Cardinals at the plate with two hits, including a double.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue
items.summary: The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue

Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands

The Trump administration has deported thousands of people under a series of agreements with nearly two dozen countries, including South Sudan, Equatorial Guinea and Panama | Image: Bloomberg

AP Washington 2 min read Last Updated : Sep 25 2026 | 8:12 AM IST

Listen to This Article

President Donald Trump's administration asked the Supreme Court on Thursday to again clear the way for continued quick deportations of immigrants to third countries where they have no ties.
The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands.
The justices previously allowed the deportation flights to temporarily continue when the case came before them last year. Since then, an appeals court has upheld a Boston-based judge's final ruling that migrants must have a meaningful chance to argue a third-country deportation would put them in danger of persecution or torture.
 

The ruling didn't prohibit those deportations outright but it lengthens the process. The government argues it has already led to the cancellation of a flight carrying 70 people with criminal convictions to three different countries.
"The government has been able to remove thousands of aliens to third countries in recent months, and thousands more are eligible for such removal," Solicitor General D John Sauer wrote.
Also Read

Trump welcomes Xi for US visit, hails their 'truly great friendship'

Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to Washington looking for a trade win

Trump's Republican administration has said that it sends people to third countries when it is unable to quickly return them to their homelands. Those third-country governments provide assurances that people won't be persecuted or tortured, attorneys said.

The lower courts' legal requirements would mean cascading delays and could force the reworking of agreements with foreign countries, attorneys wrote.
The Trump administration has deported thousands of people under a series of agreements with nearly two dozen countries, including South Sudan, Equatorial Guinea and Panama.
This month, lawyers for two men deported to Equatorial Guinea said they were beaten and held at gunpoint in a hotel-turned-detention center by police who covered their heads with bags.
The case comes amid a sweeping immigration crackdown by the Trump administration, which has pledged to deport millions of people who are living in the United States illegally.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Amanda Cooper　Sophie Kiderlin

[ロンドン　２４日　ロイター] - 米３０年債利回りが２...
items.body:
米30年債利回りが5.45%超え、20年超ぶり高水準　インフレ懸念で
4:36 配信

米国財務省入口。２月撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Amanda Cooper　Sophie Kiderlin

[ロンドン　２４日　ロイター] - 米３０年債利回りが２４日、一時５．４５％をわずかに上回る水準まで上昇し、２００４年以来、２０年超ぶりの高水準を付けた。堅調な経済成長や高水準の債務、インフレ懸念を一段と強めるエネルギー価格の上昇を背景に、投資家が国債保有に対しより高い利回りを求める中、売りが拡大している。 

指標となる１０年債利回りは５．１５８％となっている。 

米国の３０年固定住宅ローン金利は戦争前と比べ１％ポイント上昇し、足元では７％と過去約２年間で最も高い水準にある。住宅ローン金利は米国債利回りに連動する。 

イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格の高騰や、政府支出を巡る懸念が強まる中、債券市場は数カ月にわたって圧力にさらされており、利回りは数十年ぶりの高水準に達している。

大和キャピタル・マーケッツの経済調査責任者、クリス・シクルナ氏は「金利が上昇するほど全体の見通しが悪化するのは明らかだ。米国の住宅ローン金利はより高くなり、連邦政府の債務利払い負担も一層大きくなる」と述べた。
