Space radiation can disrupt or degrade electronics, including by causing data errors known as bit flips.
Google said it tested its TPUs while running AI workloads in a facility at the University of California, Davis, but that orbital testing was needed to understand how the hardware performs in the real environment.
The company will also evaluate its design to cool the power-intensive chips in the vacuum of space, where conventional airflow cooling is impossible, by combining heat pipes with radiators.
But experts have said that the concept remains years from being commercially viable given high launch costs, engineering constraints and satellite production bottlenecks.
The first Suncatcher mission is designed to gather in-orbit data and identify potential failure points, rather than demonstrate an operational orbital data center, Google said.
It aims to launch two satellites in 2027 to test the high-bandwidth laser links needed to connect future computing clusters.

HONG KONG: A senior Morgan Stanley banker covering financial sponsors in Asia accidentally leaked their deal pipeline in an email sent to clients, according to six people with knowledge of the matter.
The banker attached the financial sponsors group's deal pipeline by mistake in a weekly update email he sent to clients, the people said.
"Morgan Stanley takes client confidentiality extremely seriously. We promptly took steps to address this inadvertent sharing of information and we continue to engage with relevant parties," a spokesperson for the Wall Street bank said in an emailed response to Reuters on Thursday (Sep 24).
The banker later retracted the email and apologised for the mishap, urging recipients to delete copies of the attachment and refrain from circulating the document, according to a screenshot of the email seen by Reuters.

The list, dated Sep 21, contained about 60 live IPO, M&A and block trade deals across Greater China, South Korea, Southeast Asia, India and the EMEA region.
It also included over 50 deals that were categorised as "pitching", and nearly 30 deals categorised as "on hold". All of those deals concern Asian companies.
The vast majority of the companies on the list are portfolios of major global and regional private equity and venture capital firms.
Bloomberg first reported on the incident late on Wednesday.
The list did not contain details of any of the deals, and a lot of them have already been reported, according to some people who received the email.

Oracle triggers 'force majeure' on data center project over power delays, source says

FAST

Sept 24 : Oracle issued a "force majeure" notice to a Blue Owl unit, the developer of a large New Mexico data center, citing potential delays in securing power for the project, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday.
Shares of Oracle were down 3.3 per cent. The source said that securing power for the site is Oracle's responsibility under the contract.
Oracle cannot terminate the lease under any circumstances, the source said, adding that alternative asset manager Blue Owl has about $3 billion in equity in the project, with Oracle responsible for paying the debt costs.
Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their control, a move that can raise concerns among lenders and investors.

Rather than exiting as the main tenant, Oracle is attempting to delay payments should the data center dubbed Project Jupiter get derailed and fail to come online in 2028 as planned, according to a report by Bloomberg News, which first reported the development.
Oracle did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. "Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule," the company said earlier in the day.
Blue Owl, which owns the data-center developer Stack Infrastructure, said the notice does not change the financial commitments to this multi-year project.
During the development stage, Blue Owl earns a 9 per cent yield on its equity, the source said, adding that upon completion of the project, the levered yield is expected to be around 11 per cent.
By invoking force majeure, Oracle extends the period during which it pays Blue Owl the lower development-stage rent. Blue Owl will still receive the higher rent for the originally planned duration, but its start will be delayed, according to the source.
The 1,400-acre Project Jupiter campus, which secured $18 billion in loans from a consortium of banks, according to media reports, is part of Oracle's broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity.
The data center campus has reportedly faced multiple infrastructure setbacks, including delays to a planned natural-gas pipeline and legal challenges over water and air-quality permits.
The project is a part of Stargate, an initiative to build AI infrastructure in the US under a $500 billion investment commitment involving OpenAI, SoftBank Group and partners including Oracle.
The massive AI infrastructure build-out has faced mounting challenges, as developers race to secure power and other resources while managing the enormous costs of deploying computing capacity for partners such as OpenAI.
Growing opposition from the public has made data centers a political flashpoint, with communities around data center projects raising concerns over their impact on local supply of energy, water and other natural resources.
Brokerage William Blair said while this news intensifies worries about regulatory and power-related delays affecting AI deployments, it expects minimal short-term impact on Oracle.
"Practically, fiscal 2027 should not be affected, since Jupiter contributes no revenue this year."

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米新規失業保険申請、19.7万件に減少－歴史的な低水準にとどまる
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 先週の米新規失業保険申請件数は前週比で減少し、7月以来の低水準となった。労働市場が全般に安定を保つ中、レイオフが引き続き少ないことを示唆した。

失業保険申請件数は1969年以降で見ても、屈指の低水準となった。継続受給者数は2023年以来の低水準付近で推移した。

企業は人員削減に慎重な姿勢を維持している。一方、採用にはばらつきがあり、転職を希望する人や労働市場から離れている人にとって、雇用機会は限られている。

より変動の少ない新規申請件数の4週移動平均は20万2250件に減少し、6週間ぶりの低水準となった。

季節調整前ベースでは、新規申請件数は増加した。特にカリフォルニア、ハワイ、ニューヨーク各州での増加が目立った。

ブルームバーグ・エコノミクス（BE）のイライザ・ウィンガー氏はリポートで、「9月半ばの新規失業保険申請件数は極めて低い水準を維持しており、労働市場が安定していることを示している。人員を削減している一部の業種では、効率化が主な目的とみられる。一方、金利上昇が人員削減につながっている兆候は、金利の影響を最も受けやすい業種でもまだ見られない」と指摘した。

items.title: ミレニアム出身メギア氏のファンド、年初来9.4%損失－金利市場が混乱
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： マクロトレーダーが変動の激しい市場に直面する中、ディエゴ・メギア氏率いるタウラ・キャピタル・マネジメントは今月、4.3%の損失を出している。

運用成績に詳しい関係者によると、同ヘッジファンドの9月18日までの年初来運用成績はこれで9.4%のマイナスとなった。3月以降の回復が一部帳消しになったという。運用成績が非公開だとして、関係者は匿名を条件に語った。

タウラが今月、どのような取引で損失を出したかは明らかではない。ただ、9月の金利市場は大きく混乱した。米金融政策当局が2023年以来となる利上げを実施した後、2年債利回りが数日のうちに急上昇。ブレント原油が1バレル＝100ドルを上回ると、今月前半には世界的に金利見通しが急速に見直され、各国のイールドカーブがフラット化した。

タウラは今年初め、米国とイスラエルがイランへの攻撃を開始した際に損失を出したヘッジファンドの一つだった。エネルギーショックで中央銀行による利下げ観測が崩れ、マクロの見通しが一変した。その後、今月に入るまでは回復基調をたどっていた。

米ミレニアム・マネジメントでかつて資産運用を手掛けていたメギア氏は2024年にタウラを設立。業界史上最大級のヘッジファンド立ち上げだった。

原題：Hedge Fund Taula Down 9.4% in Volatile Year for Macro Traders

items.title: Rio Tinto to expand metals trading beyond own output
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: Mining giant targets third-party deals and derivatives as CEO Simon Trott seeks more value from its global asset base.
items.body:
Rio Tinto to expand metals trading beyond own output

Cecilia Jamasmie | September 24, 2026 | 4:46 am
Markets   Suppliers & Equipment   Top Companies   Asia   Australia   Europe   Aluminum   Copper   Iron Ore   Lithium  

Rio Tinto produces alumina as a core intermediate step in its vertically integrated aluminum business. ( Image courtesy of Rio Tinto. )

Rio Tinto (ASX, LON: RIO) plans to expand its metals trading business into third-party material and derivatives as chief executive Simon Trott seeks to squeeze more value from the world’s second-largest miner.

The initiative, Bloomberg reported , would mark a shift for Rio Tinto, which has historically focused on marketing its own production and operates a much smaller trading business than Glencore (LON: GLEN).

Glencore’s extensive trading network was one attraction during unsuccessful takeover talks between the companies over the past two years.

Rio Tinto does not intend to replicate standalone commodity trading houses, but is considering a significant expansion of its existing commercial business under chief commercial officer Bold Baatar, according to Bloomberg .

The push could give Rio greater flexibility to profit from regional supply imbalances and spare capacity across its global operations while broadening a commercial business that remains modest compared with major commodity traders.

Trading opportunities

Rio Tinto is considering more third-party trading in markets where its existing assets could provide an advantage. That includes alumina, where the company has surpluses in some regions and shortages in others.

In North America, its Kennecott operations have spare copper smelting capacity, creating opportunities to handle additional material. Rio Tinto could also trade copper cathode and related products such as sulphuric acid.

The commercial team currently has about 20 traders and could add several more as the company expands the operation.

The strategy fits with Trott’s broader overhaul of Rio Tinto since he became CEO last year . He has laid out plans to simplify the company, sell assets, cut costs and improve returns.

Rio Tinto is also in talks with Dutch multinational Vitol Group over a potential freight and logistics joint venture, another move that could reshape how the miner handles its global supply chain.

items.title: NY連銀総裁、インフレ抑制「まだやるべきこと多い」－AI需要もリスク
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は、エネルギー価格の高騰やAI投資に伴う需要を踏まえると、インフレ抑制に向けてなお多くの取り組みが必要だとの認識を示した。

ウィリアムズ氏は24日、ロンドンでのイベントで、米経済について「大きなショックにもかかわらず目覚ましい底堅さ」を示しており、労働市場も「堅調」だと述べた。一方、今も続く米国とイランの戦争や「AIによるかなり強い需要」に伴うインフレリスクが残っていると指摘した。

ウィリアムズ氏は「それがわれわれの仕事だ。まだやるべきことは多い」と述べ、「インフレ率は5年間にわたり目標を上回っている」と語った。

米国の8月のインフレ率は3.4%と目標を上回る水準にとどまり、食品とエネルギーを除くコアインフレ率は前月比の伸びが予想以上に加速した。

ウィリアムズ氏は、AIがけん引する飛躍的な生産性向上の可能性について楽観的な見方を示す一方、AI技術を少数の大企業が支配すれば、その恩恵が均等に行き渡らない可能性があると警戒感を示した。

「AI投資により、今後数年間で生産性の伸びが加速すると予想している」と同氏は述べ、生産性の伸びは金融危機前に見られた水準に達する可能性がある一方、現時点でAIが寄与する度合いは小さいとも付け加えた。

items.title: Pakistan: Lahore Court rejects request to suspend detention orders against Imran Khan's sisters
items.summary: The Lahore High Court refused to immediately suspend the detention of Imran Khan's sisters, Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi, amid a 13-day public gathering ban in Punjab ahead of a PTI protest. Meanwhile, ...
items.body:
Pakistan: Lahore Court rejects request to suspend detention orders against Imran Khan's sisters The Lahore High Court refused to immediately suspend the detention of Imran Khan's sisters, Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi, amid a 13-day public gathering ban in Punjab ahead of a PTI protest. Meanwhile, Khan’s son, Kasim Khan, condemned the arrests as criminal behaviour and urged international intervention.
ANI | Updated: 24-09-2026 22:41 IST | Created: 24-09-2026 22:41 IST

Noreen Niazi (Left), Aleema Khanum (Centre) and Uzma Khanum, sisters of jailed former Prime Minister of Pakistan and founder of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party Imran Khan (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The Lahore High Court declined a plea on Thursday to immediately halt the detention orders passed against former Pakistani premier Imran Khan’s sisters, Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi, as reported by the leading Pakistani daily Dawn. During Thursday's proceedings, legal counsel representing Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi argued before the bench that both women are "non-political" and faced incarceration without any legal rationale.
The advocates emphasised that Uzma Khan had already secured an acquittal in a previous case registered against her, prompting them to urge the court to immediately suspend the ongoing detention directives, according to Dawn. In response, the presiding judge stated that the judiciary would await an official report from the concerned authorities before issuing a ruling on the suspension application, while also issuing formal notices to the respondents for their replies.
The petition lists the Lahore Deputy Commissioner, the Capital City Police Officer, the Home Department Secretary, and the superintendent of Kot Lakhpat jail as respondents, as noted by Dawn. Legal action was initiated following police detentions of Imran Khan’s three sisters, Aleema Khan, Noreen Niazi, and Uzma Khan, executed under a 30-day detention directive issued by the Lahore Deputy Commissioner pursuant to Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance.
These detention measures were enacted ahead of a scheduled September 27 demonstration organised by the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf to lobby for the liberation of the party's founder, who has remained incarcerated since August 2023 following judicial convictions that the PTI maintains are politically driven. Since his removal from power via a 2022 no-confidence motion, Imran Khan has confronted multiple legal challenges, including charges concerning state gifts and an unlawful marriage dispute.
In anticipation of the planned PTI demonstrations, the Punjab administration instituted a 13-day prohibition on public assemblies across the entire province, implementing closures for roadways and commercial establishments surrounding Attock and Rawalpindi while stationing paramilitary Rangers across four districts, as detailed by Pakistan’s The Express Tribune newspaper. Under the directives outlined in the Punjab government's notification, public gatherings, processions, and assemblies involving five or more individuals are strictly banned across public domains, thoroughfares, and open spaces throughout the province for a duration of 13 days, as reported by The Express Tribune.
The publication further noted that the official advisory prohibits the possession and display of weaponry alongside any acts intended to provoke or incite citizens towards unauthorised assemblies in Punjab. Exemptions from the restriction cover wedding ceremonies, funeral prayers, burials, and congregations held inside mosques and designated places of worship.
The official notification indicated that law enforcement and intelligence units had uncovered intelligence pointing to a severe security threat involving militant organisations preparing assaults targeting public gatherings. Earlier on Monday, Kasim Khan, the son of Imran Khan, issued a strong condemnation regarding the detention of his paternal aunts, Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi, characterising the actions as "criminal behaviour" while appealing for international intervention.
In a statement published on the social media platform X, Kasim Khan expressed deep outrage, stating, “This is a disgrace. Now my Aunts Dr. Uzma and Noreen, along with my cousins Shershah and Shahrez, have now been abducted as well. They have broken into my aunties' and cousins' houses and forced them into vehicles with no explanation. No reasons for arrest have been stated.” He further added, “No news has been released as to where they have been taken. This is criminal behaviour. Inexcusable. The Pakistani people are petrified of their own leaders. No upstanding nation should tolerate this criminal establishment. Intervention is now imperative. The world MUST take action.” (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: カタール、ホルムズ海峡経由のLNG輸送を増加－通航に緊張緩和の兆し
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホルムズ海峡を通航する液化天然ガス（LNG）タンカーを、カタールは過去２カ月余りで最多の水準に増やした。同海峡航行の緊張が和らぎつつあることが示唆される。

ブルームバーグがまとめた船舶追跡データによると、過去1週間にペルシャ湾内から湾外に向けてホルムズ海峡を通航した積載済みのタンカーが少なくとも2隻、反対方向に進んで同湾内に入ったタンカーも少なくとも2隻あった。積載済みタンカーの1隻は、インドの西岸に向かっている。

ホルムズ海峡通航の際、この4隻から位置情報を示す信号は検出されなかった。ただ、この海域では電波妨害や混信が頻繁に発生しており、船舶の正確な位置の把握は難しくなっている。

カタールはLNGタンカー1隻が攻撃を受けた7月初めに、同海峡経由の輸出をほぼ停止した。今回の動きは、それ以降で同国のLNGタンカーの活動が最も持続的に増加していることを示す。米国とイスラエルが仕掛けた対イラン戦争の前は、世界のLNG供給量の約2割がホルムズ海峡を通過していたが、船舶への攻撃が相次ぎ、海峡の通航は危険を伴うようになった。

航行量は、1日当たり約3隻のLNG輸送が行われていた戦争前の水準をなお大幅に下回っているものの、少しでも増加すれば、ガスの世界的な供給ひっ迫の緩和につながる可能性がある。冬を前に需要が高まる中、欧州とアジアのガス価格は過去数週間で2022年以来の高値に急騰した。

原題：Qatar Boosts LNG Traffic Through Hormuz as Global Shortage Bites（抜粋）

items.author: CNA
items.summary: A Chinese CEO delegation was said to be in the works just a week before the Washington summit, but multiple reports now indicate Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the US without one.

Who’s coming to dinner? US business bigwigs set for Trump-Xi state banquet, China line-up unclear

A Chinese CEO delegation was said to be in the works just a week before the Washington summit, but multiple reports now indicate Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the US without one.

WASHINGTON: A who’s who of American technology and business leaders is expected at the White House on Thursday (Sep 24) for United States President Donald Trump’s state dinner for Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping – but who will represent corporate China remains far less clear.
Xi is in the US for a three-day state visit, reciprocating Trump’s trip to Beijing four months ago. He touched down at Joint Base Andrews in Washington on Wednesday night, receiving a rare personal airport welcome from the US president .
The Chinese leader will hold talks with Trump on Thursday before being treated to a state dinner at the White House. The trip wraps up on Friday morning with tea and a visit to the National Archives.
Xi is accompanied by his wife Peng Liyuan, as well as a delegation of senior officials including his de facto chief of staff Cai Qi and foreign minister Wang Yi, state news agency Xinhua reported.

However, it remains unclear whether any of China’s corporate heavyweights are part of the visit, despite weeks of speculation.
Reuters reported on Sep 18 that Washington and Beijing were finalising the line-up of Chinese business leaders.
Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD, smartphone maker Xiaomi, battery giants CATL and Gotion, as well as consumer electronics manufacturer Hisense and state-owned Bank of China were among the companies under consideration, Reuters said, citing sources.
But on Wednesday, Reuters reported that Xi would visit Washington without a CEO delegation, citing people familiar with the matter. AFP separately reported, citing sources, that no Chinese CEOs were accompanying Xi on the trip.
Meanwhile, an unnamed source told US news outlet CNBC that they were not aware of any Chinese companies that have been invited to join Xi on his trip.

Related:

From Beijing to Washington: US-China ties face a test as Trump, Xi meet again

Trump’s high-level welcome for Xi puts personal diplomacy in focus, analysts say

Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said he had “no information to share” when asked at a regular press briefing on Wednesday if Beijing was able to confirm whether Xi will be accompanied by a delegation of Chinese executives during his visit to Washington.
The White House has yet to release a full guest list, leaving open the possibility that Chinese executives could still attend Thursday’s state dinner separately.
However, their apparent absence stands in contrast with Trump’s visit to Beijing in May, when the US president travelled with more than a dozen American business and tech leaders, including Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, Tesla boss Elon Musk and Apple’s then-CEO Tim Cook.
There is considerably more clarity over the American corporate presence at Thursday’s state banquet.
Huang, Musk and Cook - now Apple’s executive chairman - are reportedly on the roster. Other prominent names set to attend include Amazon’s Jeff Bezos, Alphabet’s Sundar Pichai and OpenAI’s Sam Altman.
Dell CEO Michael Dell, Meta's Mark Zuckerberg and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella will also be at the dinner, US business magazine Forbes reported.

(From left) Amazon's Jeff Bezos, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and Tesla’s Elon Musk are expected to attend the state dinner at the White House on Sep 24, 2026. (Photos: Fabrice Coffrini, Stacy Revere and Benjamin Fanjoy/AFP via Getty Images)

The heavy presence of tech moguls at Thursday’s dinner comes as artificial intelligence and semiconductors have emerged as key areas of competition between the US and China.
Preliminary talks on Sunday between US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng included discussion of creating a communication channel for AI concerns .
The Trump-Xi summit in Washington takes place with US-China ties on steadier ground, but the underlying strategic rivalry is largely unchanged, say analysts.
Expectations of any breakthroughs are low. Analysts say the main aim of the pageantry is to maintain a fragile calm between the superpower rivals.

Source: Agencies/lk(ws)

items.title: Global bond selloff rolls on, US 30-year yield at highest since 2004
items.author: Amanda Cooper, Sophie Kiderlin, Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.creator: Amanda Cooper, Sophie Kiderlin, Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.summary: US long-dated Treasury yields rose to their highest in more than 20 years on Thursday, extending a global selloff that has accelerated on worries that high energy costs, resilient economic growth and increased government spending will keep inflation elevated.
items.body:
US long-dated Treasury yields rose to their highest in more than 20 years on Thursday, extending a global selloff that has accelerated on worries that high energy costs, resilient economic growth and increased government spending will keep inflation elevated.
Bond markets worldwide have been under pressure for months, sending yields to multi-decade highs as the Iran war raised energy prices and as investors fret about government spending. Rising yields mean bond prices are falling.
Investor concern has risen of late as the selloff in the US, the world's deepest and most influential government bond market, has picked up pace. The yield on 30-year Treasury bonds climbed to 5.48%, highest since 2004, on Thursday, while the benchmark US 10-year yield reached 5.20%.
So far, investors have absorbed the rise in yields given the resilience of underlying economic growth, booming corporate profits and an avalanche of spending, led by the AI boom. The tech-heavy Nasdaq closed at a record high on Tuesday.
But this month's breach of 5% on the 10-year Treasury yield, a level reached only fleetingly in recent decades, has investors [USN:L8N45E1BK TEXT:"eyeing 6%"] as the next potential pain threshold, which could rattle [USN:L1N45F0QC TEXT:"financial markets"] and Corporate America.
At these levels, borrowing costs may start to squeeze consumers. US 30-year mortgage rates are now a percentage point higher than before the war and, at 7%, around their highest in [USN:L1N45F0EE TEXT:"two years"].
The 10-year yield has risen 0.70 percentage point since the Federal Reserve policy meeting in June and 1.25 percentage points since early March.
"The vast majority of the move higher in yields since March has been driven by rising Fed expectations, with the remainder driven by a combination of rising growth expectations and higher oil prices," said Gennadiy Goldberg, head of US rates strategy at TD Securities, in a research note.
Recent [USN:L6N45F0Y8 TEXT:"business activity data"] pointing to strong US growth and rising inflation pressures has raised the chances the Federal Reserve will hike rates further.
While shorter-dated Treasury yields track expectations for interest rates, the 30-year yield reflects investors' willingness to finance government borrowing in the years ahead.
"You're seeing a repricing of several things -- US economic growth has remained resilient, and that's a more positive reason why you would find yourself in a higher risk-free rate environment," said Zachary Griffiths, head of investment grade and macro strategy at CreditSights in Charlotte, North Carolina.
WORLD YIELDS ALSO ON THE RISE The world's biggest economies are grappling with higher interest payments as spending demands surge. Germany's finance agency said on Thursday it expects [USN:L8N45G0HG TEXT:"federal borrowing to hit a record"] €525.5 billion ($598 billion) in 2026 and to rise further next year, driven largely by rising refinancing needs and growing requirements for special funds.
The yield on Germany's benchmark 10-year Bund briefly rose above 3.6% this month, its highest level in 17 years.
Japan's 10-year bond yield on Thursday hit its [USN:L1N45G04E TEXT:"highest since 1996"].
With nominal US growth running at around 8% in the second quarter and showing no signs of slowing materially, investors have remained sanguine.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has taken extraordinary measures to try to contain rising borrowing costs, including intervening to buy the yen to avoid officials in Tokyo selling Treasuries to do so, or expanding buybacks of 20- and 30-year debt, but to little avail, as yields have continued to climb.
The US already boasts some of the highest yields among the Group of Seven richest nations.
New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said on Thursday the US economy was displaying "remarkable resilience".
"Treasuries are competing with the rest of the market to be purchased and so you know, the question is, how much higher could it go?" Hank Calenti, global markets strategist at SMBC EMEA, said.

items.title: 米30年債利回りが上昇、2004年以来の高水準－世界的債券売り続く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国債で最も償還期間の長い30年物の利回りが24日、20年超ぶりの高水準に上昇した。インフレや財政を巡る懸念を背景に続いている世界的な債券売りが、新たな節目に達した。

米国市場では原油価格が再び大幅上昇し、米国債市場が荒い値動きとなるなか、5－30年債利回りがそろって数年ぶりの高水準を更新した。30年債利回りは一時5.5%目前まで上昇し、2004年以来の高水準を付けた。10年債利回りも10bp上昇して5.21%と、07年以来の高水準となった。

シット・インベストメント・アソシエーツの債券ファンドマネジャー、ブライス・ドティ氏は「爆発が起きた後のようだ」と述べた。「市場参加者はがれきの中から手掛かりを探している。これは過剰反応なのか、それとも利回りがさらに上昇する局面の始まりなのか、見極めようとしている」と指摘した。

過去6カ月間の原油価格や幅広いインフレ指標の上昇を受け、米連邦準備理事会（FRB）は先週、2023年以来初めて利上げに踏み切った。今後1年間に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測も強まっている。スワップ市場は現在、今後1年間に0.25ポイントの利上げ3回を完全に織り込み、4回目の利上げに備えたヘッジもかなり進んでいる。

米国が2月下旬にイランを攻撃して中東からの原油供給に衝撃が生じて以降、原油価格が米国債利回りを左右する主な要因となっている。24日には、イランが戦争の拡大を警告したことを受け、原油価格が一時5%上昇した。

米国とイランの戦争が始まって以降、米2年債利回りは150bp超、30年債利回りは80bp超上昇している。

借り入れコストの上昇は、11月の中間選挙を控える議会共和党にとって逆風だ。高止まりする住宅ローン金利や生活費を巡る不満が強まっているためだ。トランプ氏は米国の金利を「1%、あるいはそれ未満」にするよう求め、今月利上げを決定した米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）を「敵対的」だと批判した。

items.title: 米30年債利回りが上昇、2004年以来の高水準－世界的債券売り続く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国債で最も償還期間の長い30年物の利回りが24日、2004年以来の高水準を付けた。インフレや財政を巡る懸念を背景に続いている世界的な債券売りが、新たな節目に達した。

30年債利回りは一時4ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇し5.44%。欧州国債の利回りも上昇し、長期連休明けの日本でも、同国10年債利回りが30年ぶりの高水準を更新した。

ブルームバーグ・グローバル国債トータルリターン指数を構成する債券の平均利回りはいまや4%に迫り、2007年以来の高水準。イランでの戦争が引き起こしているインフレ圧力、堅調な米国経済、各国政府やテクノロジー企業による大量の債券発行に市場が対応する中、低利回り時代の終えんをあらためて印象付けた。

マウント・ルーマス・マネジメントのデーブ・アスペル最高投資責任者（CIO）は「債券でこのような動きは珍しい」と指摘。「米国は利上げに踏み切ったが、インフレが目標値にないことは明らかだ。経済はまずまずで、政府支出も巨額だ」と語った。

借り入れコストの上昇は、11月の中間選挙を控えるトランプ大統領に圧力をかけている。高止まりする住宅ローン金利や生活費を巡る不満が強まっているためだ。トランプ氏は米国の金利を「1%、あるいはそれ未満」にするよう求め、今月利上げを決定した米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）を「敵対的」だと批判した。

米国とイランの戦争が始まって以降、米2年債利回りは150ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）、30年債利回りは80bp超上昇している。

利回りの上昇が続いていることで、長期の借り入れコストを引き下げようとする米財務省の取り組みは損なわれている。債券売りが激しくなる中、ベッセント財務長官は8月半ば、圧力を和らげるため政府の国債買い戻しプログラムを拡充したが、市場への持続的な効果はほとんど見られない。

今週実施された米5年債入札は、2018年から開始されたデータのうち、ある指標に基づくと2番目に低調な結果だった。落札利回りは2006年以来の高水準となり、約40兆ドル（約6350兆円）に上る公的債務の利払い費用増加は米政府を一段と苦しい状況に追い込む。

items.title: 原油は急伸、タイトな需給が外交の楽観上回る－ブレント一時108ドル
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニューヨーク原油相場は大幅に上昇した。ホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けた外交面での進展の兆しが注目された一方で、複数の主要指標は需給の逼迫を示した。

ブレント原油先物は一時5%急伸し、バレル当たり108ドル台に乗せる場面も見られたが、上げ幅を縮小した。米国とイランの交渉担当者は、ホルムズ海峡の通航再開と米国によるイラン港湾に対する経済封鎖の解除に向け、段階的な合意を模索している。

これを受けて、紛争の外交的解決への期待が高まったものの、懐疑的な見方は残る。これまでも合意が間近に迫ったように見えながら、協議が決裂した経緯がある。このため多くのトレーダーは、市場への原油供給が大幅に増えるのを確認するまで、ポジションを変更することに消極的だ。

レイモンド・ジェームズのアナリスト、パベル・モルチャノフ氏は合意が近いとの報道について「こうした動きはこれまでに何度もあった」と指摘し、「この目で確かめるまでは信じない。具体的な成果を確認する必要がある」と述べた。

実際の需給を示す指標は極めて逼迫した状況を映していた。原油トレーダーはこの日、米国最大の石油貯蔵拠点で即時供給を確保するため、過去最高のプレミアムを支払った。一方、ブレント原油に対するウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）のディスカウントは5月以来の幅に拡大した。国外の買い手が供給不足を見込んでいることが背景にある。

朝方には、イラン軍幹部による発言が原油相場を大きく押し上げた。半国営ファルス通信によると、最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師の軍事顧問ヤフヤ・ラヒーム・サファヴィ氏は、米国またはイスラエルからの攻撃を再び受けた場合、イランは戦争をインド洋まで拡大する可能性があると述べた。

原油相場は今年に入り70%余り上昇している。米国とイランの戦争や、ロシアとウクライナの紛争による影響で供給が減少し、インフラも損傷しているためだ。それでもペルシャ湾岸の産油国は、位置情報の発信器を切ったタンカーで原油を少しずつ運び出しており、混乱の影響を和らげている。

items.title: ブレント原油一時106.5ドル、日中高値－イラン情勢への楽観論後退
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ブレント原油先物が24日、一時3.3%上昇し、日中高値となる1バレル＝106.50ドルを付けた。エネルギー輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡の通航正常化に向けた主要な問題を巡り、米国とイランの隔たりがなお大きい中、トレーダーは中東情勢の緊張度合いを見極めようとしている。

ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）原油先物も、一時2.7%高の1バレル＝94.63ドルとなった。

イランの半国営ファルス通信によると、最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師の軍事顧問ヤフヤ・ラヒーム・サファヴィ氏が24日、米国またはイスラエルからの攻撃を再び受けた場合、イランは戦争をインド洋まで拡大する可能性があると述べた。

この発言により、今週の国連総会に合わせて行われているイランと米国の当局者による協議に対する楽観論がさらに後退した。トランプ米大統領は協議について「非常に良かった」と評したが、イラン側は、外交面で進展があったとの見方に否定的だ。

スタンダードチャータードのエネルギー調査責任者、エミリー・アシュフォード氏は「市場にはショックを吸収する余力がほとんど残っていない。新たな物理的な供給混乱や事態のエスカレーションの可能性を示す信頼できるニュースが出れば、価格に不釣り合いなほど大きな影響を及ぼす」と述べた。

イランのペゼシュキアン大統領も、米国との戦争終結に向けた協議を再開する用意はあるが、脅しには応じないと発言した。また、制裁と米国による港湾封鎖が続く限り、イラン政府はホルムズ海峡の航行の自由を認めないとしている。

エネルギー価格が幅広く上昇したことで、世界で物価が押し上げられ、消費者への負担が増すとともに、中央銀行のインフレ対応は難しさを増している。

米国では輸送や建設、農業に使われるディーゼル燃料の小売価格が過去最高に急騰した。一部の議員は輸出制限を求め、トランプ米大統領も今週、顧問らに禁輸措置を支持するよう促した。

items.title: 欧州経済は予想以上に堅調、追加利上げにも耐え得る－ECBコッハー氏
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州経済は予想以上に底堅く、追加の金融引き締めが必要になった場合でも、さらなる金利上昇に耐えられる。欧州中央銀行（ECB）政策委員会メンバーのコッハー・オーストリア中銀総裁がこうした見方を示した。

コッハー氏はオーストリア紙クリアに対し、「幸い、夏以降の欧州経済には、やや勢いが増していることを示す兆候が強まっている」と発言。23日に発表された9月の総合購買担当者景気指数（PMI、速報値）の改善や製造業の回復を挙げた。

一方で「経済情勢は依然として不安定だ」とも指摘。「必要な金利調整は行う一方、不必要な変更は避ける」と述べた。

「これまでも述べてきたように、利上げは常に総需要を抑えるため、言うまでもなく好ましいものではない」と説明。「当然ながら、追加利上げなしに2%のインフレ目標を達成できるのが望ましい」と語った。

ECBは既に2回利上げしており、追加利上げも広く予想されている。市場は今回の引き締め局面で、さらに3回の利上げを織り込んでいる。

政策委メンバーの中では通常、タカ派寄りとされるコッハー氏だが、今後の政策について明言を避けた。

「不確実性が非常に高く、中東情勢による物価上昇圧力もあるため、会合ごとに状況を改めて評価する」と述べた。

原題：Europe Economy More Robust Than Anticipated, ECB’s Kocher Says（抜粋）

items.title: トランプ氏、なぜ報道3社の取材を制限？メディア規制どこまで可能か
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領が報道機関3社について「作り話とうそ」を報じているとしてホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止したことで、大統領がメディアの取材活動をどこまで制限できるのかに注目が集まっている。

ワシントン連邦地裁は23日、CNNとMS
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領が報道機関3社について「作り話とうそ」を報じているとしてホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止したことで、大統領がメディアの取材活動をどこまで制限できるのかに注目が集まっている。

ワシントン連邦地裁は23日、CNNとMS NOW、ポリティコが起こした訴訟の審理中、立ち入り禁止措置を解除するよう求めた申し立てについて双方の主張を聞く審理を開いた。トランプ氏が任命したケリー判事はその後、トランプ政権に対し、ホワイトハウスへの立ち入り禁止措置を一時的に解除するよう命じた。

報道3社はトランプ氏やホワイトハウス高官らを提訴し、記者証の無効化は適正手続きと報道の自由を保障する合衆国憲法に違反すると訴え、他の報道機関も3社を支持している。

対立の激化は、自身を不公平に扱ってきたとトランプ氏が主張する記者らへの制約を強める最近の動きの一つだ。政権は国防総省におけるメディアの長年の取材アクセスも制限し、一部記者に対し20カ国・地域（G20）首脳会議の取材を認めていない。

トランプ氏はニューヨーク・タイムズ（NYT）とウォールストリート・ジャーナル（WSJ）、英BBCを名誉毀損で提訴しているが、報道各社はこうした主張には根拠がないとしている。

トランプ氏は18日、自身のSNS「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、長年にわたる「フェイクニュース」を理由に3社のホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止すると表明した。翌日、各社の記者がホワイトハウス敷地内に入ろうとしたところ、立ち入りを拒否され、記者証は無効化または没収された。

これを受け、3社はトランプ氏とワイルズ大統領首席補佐官、チョン広報部長、シークレットサービスのカラン長官をワシントンの連邦地裁に提訴した。

3社は、米政府が憲法修正第1条で保護された言論を理由に報道機関へ違法な報復を行ったとし、さらに、事前通知や反論の機会を与えずに取材アクセスを取り消したことで、適正手続きを受ける権利を保障する修正第5条にも違反したと申し立てた。

items.title: モルガン・スタンレー、案件リスト誤送信で火消し急ぐ－当局も精査
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米モルガン・スタンレーは、取引案件リストの流出による影響の封じ込めを急いでいる。一部の競合銀行のバンカーが今回の事態をどう利用できるか検討する一方、少なくとも二つの規制当局が潜在的な影響の精査に乗り出した。

モルガン・スタンレーの有力バンカーの1人が、同行が手掛けたり動向を追ったりしていた100件超の取引案件リストを含む電子メールを一部の顧客に誤って送信。今回の情報流出は今週、アジアの投資銀行業界を揺るがしている。

事情に詳しい複数の関係者によると、モルガン・スタンレーは一部のプライベートエクイティー（PE）投資会社と緊急に会合を開き、謝罪するとともに、影響の軽減に取り組むと経営幹部らに説明した。非公開情報を理由に関係者は匿名を条件に語った。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースが確認したリストの写しと事情に詳しい関係者によると、リストには中国、韓国、インドにまたがる新規株式公開（IPO）の候補案件が含まれていた。リストはアジア地域が中心だが、欧州や中東、アフリカにも及んでおり、こうした企業を支援するPE投資会社や年金基金のほか、棚上げされた案件に関する情報も載っていた。

競合他社の間で文書が出回ると、ライバル各社は喜びと驚きをもって受け止めた。競合する金融機関の複数のバンカーは、このリストを利用して案件獲得を狙い、見込み顧客に売り込む考えを示した。一方、案件の大半は既に知られており、ほとんど驚きはなかったとの声もあった。

トレーダーや投資家も、リストに記載されたブロックトレード（大口取引）の可能性を注視していた。

事情に詳しい関係者によれば、投資銀行部門でアジア太平洋地域のフィナンシャル・スポンサー部門責任者を務めるモハメド・アトマニ氏が今週、取引案件の一覧を一部の顧客に電子メールで送信。その後、メールの取り消しを試みた。

アトマニ氏は、主にPE業界の概況や最近の取引に関する一般的な最新情報を盛り込んだ顧客向けの資料を送るつもりだったが、誤って社内向けの案件リストを送信した。

items.title: 米中首脳、貿易やAI巡り協議へ－台湾が取り上げられるか注視
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国の習近平国家主席がワシントンに到着した。訪米は約3年ぶりとなる。24日のトランプ米大統領との注目の首脳会談は、世界1、2位の経済大国を率いる2人が個人的な関係を深め、貿易やAI、イラン戦争、台湾の未来など対立を抱える問題で共通点を探る機会となる。

米国は、トランプ氏が大統領復帰後に始めた貿易戦争を巡り、米中両国は休戦措置を2カ月延長することで合意したと発表した。2025年10月に合意し、今年11月10日に期限を迎える予定だった休戦措置では、双方が相手国からの輸入品に課していた関税を引き下げ、中国産レアアース（希土類）などの製品輸出に対して計画されていた一部の輸出規制を停止した。

米中は貿易障壁をさらに引き下げる方法についても協議しており、首脳会談で追加合意に至る可能性がある。提案の一つは、エネルギーや農産物を含む一部の米国産品について、中国の関税を大幅に引き下げるものだ。

これは、貿易委員会の枠組みを通じ、双方がそれぞれ300億ドル（約4兆7500億円）相当の製品に対する輸入障壁を緩和する従来の取り組みに基づいている。中国からの一部品目には最恵国税率が適用される。

ただ、関税を巡る緊張緩和が実現する保証は全くない。中国政府は以前から米国の輸入関税に不満を表明している。

一方、米政府は他国の貿易慣行に対する調査を開始しており、米連邦最高裁が今年2月に無効とした「相互関税」に代わり、中国に新たな措置を課す選択肢を確保する可能性がある。実施する場合、新たな関税率は7.5%となり得る。米国は首脳会談が終わるまで正式発表を見送る見通しだ。

日本と韓国は、トランプ氏の貿易面での要求に応じるため、米国への大規模投資や米国産品の購入拡大を確約している。トランプ政権は中国にも同様の対応を求めている。

中国は2028年まで年間2500万トンの米国産大豆を購入するとの確約について着実に履行を進め、今年分は最近、目標の半分を超えた。一方、米国産農産物に少なくとも追加で170億ドルを支出する別の確約は、達成がより難しい状況だ。

items.title: China helped arm Iran before Trump rolled out the red carpet for Xi: Report
items.summary: Despite President Trump hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington to discuss trade, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals China has supplied Iran with dual-use military components, ...
items.body:
China helped arm Iran before Trump rolled out the red carpet for Xi: Report  Despite President Trump hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington to discuss trade, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals China has supplied Iran with dual-use military components, drone parts, and satellite data during the ongoing war, straining internal US administration relations.
ANI | Updated: 24-09-2026 19:13 IST | Created: 24-09-2026 19:13 IST

US President Donald Trump welcomes Chinese President Xi Jinping at Joint Base Andrews, US (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump hosted a grand welcome for Chinese President Xi Jinping, yet beneath the surface fanfare, an investigation published by The Wall Street Journal has revealed how Beijing has maintained military-industrial support for Tehran throughout the ongoing war against the United States. While Beijing heavily publicised its diplomatic outreach, highlighting dozens of foreign ministry calls and personal proposals from Xi aimed at halting hostilities when a temporary truce was brokered this summer, customs documentation evaluated by the Journal indicates that a Chinese cargo aircraft touched down in Tehran on the exact day the ceasefire was signed. The manifest reportedly contained electronic hardware destined for Iran’s Ministry of Defence, with analysts noting certain components suited for drone architecture and missile navigation systems.
The arrival was far from an isolated occurrence. Trade tracking reviewed by the Journal uncovered approximately 1,300 shipments involving dual-use hardware dispatched from China to Iranian defence entities leading up to the end of June. Just two days following the truce-day delivery, more than a dozen supplementary consignments arrived carrying parts valued at upwards of USD 6 million applicable to unmanned aerial vehicles. With Xi currently visiting Washington for bilateral discussions covering commerce, artificial intelligence, and Taiwan, Beijing's entanglement with Tehran has surfaced as an awkward complication overshadowed by the official summit agenda.
Data compiled from Iranian customs logs, American officials, and individuals close to the transactions outline a steadily expanding aerial logistics bridge between the two nations. Records spanning January 2025 through June 2026 demonstrate thousands of consignments routed to Iranian military agencies and commercial entities, encompassing global positioning tracking gear, electric motors, and aircraft powerplant elements, frequently invoking Article 119 of Iranian customs statutes, which grants tariff exemptions for defence procurement. This transactional flow accelerated after the US Navy clamped down on Iranian maritime commerce. According to FlightRadar24 data cited by the Journal, blacklisted Iranian carrier Mahan Air ramped up its flight frequencies linking Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou to Tehran, surging from four weekly rotations in early March to approximately 27 per week by late April.
By the opening week of September, Mahan Air had executed 39 flights along these routes, roughly double pre-war volumes, with monitoring indicating many operated primarily as cargo carriers rather than passenger services. Trade researchers tracking regional flows informed the Journal that numerous Chinese suppliers involved are lesser-known commercial entities interfacing directly with Iranian buyers. Kate Koren, deputy director of the economics programme at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, told the Journal that specific traded components align with those utilised in Iranian Shahed drones, noting that a forthcoming CSIS assessment identified Chinese firms openly marketing sensitive electronics throughout the year.
The evaluation further indicated that Chinese enterprises supplied chemical inputs such as sodium perchlorate, a necessary precursor for solid ballistic missile propellants. Consequently, Washington has penalised multiple Chinese and Hong Kong-based entities over alleged procurement networks attempting to acquire shoulder-fired missile systems for Iran via intermediaries like Belarus. The bilateral dynamic operates as a symbiotic partnership. China has consolidated its position as the principal consumer of Iranian petroleum, supplying Tehran with vital fiscal inflows despite sweeping American sanctions.
Financial networks and front companies based in China have consistently aided Iran in bypassing restrictions and channelling capital through Beijing's banking architecture. Following the expansion of the Trump administration's 2018 maximum pressure campaign, both nations formalised their alignment through a 25-year strategic cooperation pact in 2021. US Senate Foreign Relations Committee statements drawing on Treasury metrics indicate that China currently absorbs roughly 90 per cent of Iranian crude exports.
Although Washington has levied hundreds of penalties against participating entities since the war broke out, the executive branch has exercised caution to avoid a direct diplomatic collision with Beijing, mindful of past tariff standoffs that demonstrated China's retaliatory leverage. Insiders familiar with internal White House deliberations disclosed to the Journal that maintaining stable rapport with Xi remained a paramount priority for Trump prior to the summit, leading certain high-ranking officials to downplay Beijing's material support for Tehran.
This posture generated internal friction across Washington departments. US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth openly blamed China for sustaining the Iranian war effort, a perspective dismissed by Trump, who stated, “I trust them.” According to US officials cited by the Journal, Tehran utilised satellite intelligence procured from Chinese commercial entities immediately preceding and following a July 17 strike that resulted in the deaths of three American service members.
The administration had previously penalised three Chinese satellite imagery providers in May over intelligence sharing that facilitated targeting against US positions. The developments prompted intensified domestic pressure for a firmer stance, culminating in late August when Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled "Operation Economic Outcast" to dismantle financial networks propping up Tehran.
While the initiative yielded sanctions against a China-owned petroleum tanker and associated facilitators, the administration stopped short of sweeping penalties targeting major Chinese financial institutions. Meanwhile, maritime tracking via Kpler showed roughly four million barrels of Iranian crude reaching Chinese terminals in the immediate wake of the operation's launch, alongside the continued operation of Mahan Air cargo routes. (ANI)

items.title: 米地裁、CNNなど報道3社のホワイトハウス立ち入り禁止を一時解除
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦判事は、トランプ政権に対し、CNN、MS
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦判事は、トランプ政権に対し、CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの記者に対するホワイトハウスへの立ち入り禁止措置を一時的に解除するよう命じた。

今回の判断は、報道各社にとって訴訟の序盤で有利な展開となった。CNNなどは訴訟で、トランプ大統領と政権高官が米憲法修正第1条で保障された権利を「直接攻撃」し、政権に関する報道への報復として違法に取材を制限したと主張している。

トランプ氏が指名したティモシー・J・ケリー連邦地裁判事が一時的な差し止め命令を出した。命令は2週間効力を維持する。ケリー判事によると、この間に仮差し止め命令を求める申し立てについて迅速に審理を進める。

ケリー判事は、報道機関側が訴訟の本案で勝訴する可能性が高いことを示す「高いハードル」を満たしたと判断。適正手続きの欠如や憲法上の自由の侵害、公共の利益を理由に挙げた。

また、政府側が主張する国家安全保障上の利益について「裏付けがほとんど示されていない」と指摘。トランプ氏自身も禁止措置を発表した際、各報道機関に「真実性が欠け、否定的だとされる点」に焦点を当てていたとした。

ケリー判事は「報道の自由の重要性を踏まえれば、原告と国民には、従前の状態を維持することに永続的な利益がある」とした。

トランプ氏は18日、CNNとMS NOW、ポリティコをホワイトハウスから締め出す方針を表明。SNSへの投稿で、政権に不利な報道を行っているとして、取材禁止措置を「即時適用」するとし、「他のフェイクニュース・メディアも後に続く」と述べていた。

ただ、報道各社によると、この決定について正式な通知を受けたのは、4日後に送付された書面だった。

裁判所に提出された書面では、CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコについて、「国家安全保障やその他の問題を巡り、検証可能な虚偽を流布し、機密情報を公表した」ことを理由に立ち入り禁止としたと説明していた。

items.title: 【MLIV】日本国債の下げ加速、利回り水準自体の再評価促すシグナルに
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 午後に入り日本国債利回りが一段と上昇した。注目すべきは上昇幅より、金利上昇にもかかわらず押し目買いが相場を支えず、売りが年限をまたいで広がったことだ。米金利高への追随だけなら利回り上昇と共に国内需要が下支えしやすいが、その反応は鈍い。これは、債券の利回り水準自体に再評価圧力がかかっていることを示唆している。

欧米勢が本格的に動き出す前の東京時間午後2時半までに5年、10年、20年債利回りはいずれも前営業日比10bp上昇。利回り曲線（イールドカーブ）の広い範囲で同程度の金利上昇が進んだことは、特定年限の需給による局所的な売りでは説明しにくい。米金利高がきっかけで、国内投資家が従来の利回り水準で債券を吸収する力が弱まっているのだろう。

次の試金石は米金利が反落した時だ。それでも日本の金利が下がらなければ、米国債安への追随という説明は通りにくくなる。海外発で始まった金利上昇が日本独自の水準訂正に変わったことを示すシグナルになるはずだ。

items.title: ドジャースオーナーの保険会社疑惑、監督当局にも責任－アポロCEO
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米投資会社アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントのマーク・ローワン最高経営責任者（CEO）は23日、米大リーグ・ドジャースの筆頭オーナー、マーク・ウォルター会長傘下の保険会社について、貸付先の実態が関連会社であるにもかかわらず、非関連会社と記載することを許したデラウェア州保険局の対応を非難した。

ローワン氏は、バンク・オブ・アメリカ（BofA）セキュリティーズの会議で、デラウェア州保険局を名指しし、200億ドル（約3兆1600億円）余りの貸付先が、実際には関連会社だったにもかかわらず、非関連会社としてバランスシートに記載することを容認したと強く批判した。

ウォルター氏の金融帝国の要となる保険会社デラウェア・ライフ・インシュアランスとクリア・スプリング・ライフ・アンド・アニュイティーは、財務不正疑惑で米検察の捜査対象となっており、ビジネス帝国の他の部門への貸し付けが、捜査の焦点だ。

アポロは保険部門のアテネ・ホールディングを傘下に置く。ローワン氏はアポロのトップとして、親会社の全体戦略にとって重要なアテネの買収と爆発的な成長を主導してきた。これは保険会社の長期資本を投資に活用したい資産運用会社にとってモデルとなる一方、関連会社間の取引や利益相反の実態を分かりにくくする恐れがある。

「誰もが名前を挙げられる三つの著名スポーツチームに関係する関連会社間の取引に気付かなかったとすれば、規制・監督当局は一体何をやっているのか。米国の規制システムが目を覚ますべき瞬間だった」とローワン氏は語った。

ウォルター氏の保険会社は、関連会社への貸し付けの詳細な全容を明らかにしていない。

同氏が昨年買収した米プロバスケットボールNBAのロサンゼルス・レイカーズは、トランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏の弟、ジョシュア・クシュナー氏らに売却されることが決まった。サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグの名門、チェルシーの持ち分売却でも先に合意が成立した。

items.title: At UN, Netanyahu defends Israel as delegates walk out
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski, John Irish
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski, John Irish
items.summary: The divisions over Israel's conduct were on display as Netanyahu began speaking, with dozens of delegates walking out in protest. He called them "moral cowards," while supporters in the gallery chanted in Hebrew: "The people of Israel live."
items.body:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu mounted a forceful defense of Israel's actions in the region at the UN on Thursday, seeking to counter growing international isolation ahead of elections he could lose, as dozens of delegates streamed out.
The walkout underscored the competing pressures facing Netanyahu, who is battling mounting criticism abroad over the Gaza war while campaigning for reelection at home ahead of an October 27 vote.
The divisions over Israel's conduct were on display as Netanyahu began speaking, with dozens of delegates walking out in protest. He called them "moral cowards," while supporters in the gallery chanted in Hebrew: "The people of Israel live."
Netanyahu used his address to berate New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani for calling him a war criminal, Western European leaders for what he called succumbing to "antisemitic mobs," and to accuse both Qatar and Turkey of spreading lies about Israel.
"You tried to stop me from coming here. You tried. You tried to silence me. Well, you can't silence me. You can't silence the truth," Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader, said of Mamdani.
Mamdani campaigned for office on a promise to have Netanyahu arrested for alleged war crimes should he visit the largest US city but later said he [USN:L6N43O100 TEXT:"determined"] he lacked the legal authority to do so. This week, Mamdani described Netanyahu as "the architect of a horrific genocide against Palestinians."
Making his first visit to New York since Mamdani took office in January, Netanyahu said: "Here's a simple truth: Israel didn't commit genocide. Israel prevented genocide."
He accused Mamdani of supporting Hamas militants, something Mamdani has denied.
"To all those spreading these lies about my country and about our brave soldiers, whether they sit in this hall or in the office of the antisemitic mayor of New York, I say this: Shame on you!" Netanyahu said.
In a statement, Mamdani said: "As he has done time and again, Prime Minister Netanyahu used his speech to repeat baseless lies meant to sanitize his genocide of Palestinians. Yet no lie can change the fact that he remains the subject of an International Criminal Court arrest warrant alleging war crimes and crimes against humanity.”
Qatar also rejected the accusation that it was seeking to turn public opinion against Israel, with its foreign ministry spokesperson saying on X that Netanyahu's repeated attacks on Doha sought to divert attention from responsibility for policies on the ground.
Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan's communications director dismissed Netanyahu's accusations against against Turkey and Erdogan as baseless. "Netanyahu’s insolent and despicable remarks targeting our President cannot obscure his massacres, the humanitarian catastrophe unfolding in Gaza, or the legal proceedings before international law," Burhanettin Duran said in a post on X.
NETANYAHU'S POLITICAL FUTURE ON THE LINE With general elections less than five weeks away, Netanyahu spoke for about 40 minutes in what amounted to a campaign-style speech, broadcast live in evening prime time on all four of the main Israeli television channels.
Ahead of his speech, Netanyahu's government paid to place 500 pro-Israel and anti-Iran billboards and dozens of trucks carrying messages in support of Israel across Manhattan, Netanyahu's office said in a statement.
With opinion polls showing Netanyahu's bloc trailing rivals ahead of the election, he used the speech to showcase what he described as Israel's fight on seven fronts, including the war with Iran that began with joint US-Israeli strikes in late February.
As in past UN appearances, Netanyahu used props, holding up a pager linked to an attack that killed and wounded Iran-backed Hezbollah members in Lebanon and a [USN:L1N42V088 TEXT:"Starlink satellite"] internet receiver he said he would leave for the Iranian delegation.
"So when they inevitably defect, they too will be able to freely tell their story on social media," he said, adding that it was only a matter of time before the Iranian authorities would be toppled by the people.
STREET PROTESTS IN NEW YORK Several hundred protesters gathered near the United Nations, with dozens blocking traffic and chanting, "Stop arming Israel, let Gaza live" and "Stop arming Israel, let Iran live." Police detained them.
Netanyahu was making a short visit to the US for his UN address and, unusually, without a planned meeting with US President Donald Trump, whom he praised during his speech.
"We will continue to defend our state. We will continue to win because we have no other choice. In this battle against the barbarians, we've had no greater partner than President Trump. I thank him. I thank him for his bold leadership," he said.
DEEPENING ISOLATION Israel has faced deepening diplomatic isolation since launching its war in Gaza in response to the Hamas-led attacks on Israel nearly three years ago.
Netanyahu is unable to travel to many countries because of an International Criminal Court arrest warrants issued against him and his then-defense minister as well as the then-military commander of Hamas in 2024.
Earlier this month, once-steadfast allies Britain, France and Canada announced sanctions targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, which drew a muted response from Washington.
"The leaders of these countries have chosen to succumb to the antisemitic mobs. They've chosen weakness. They've chosen appeasement," Netanyahu said.
He played down worsening violence in the occupied West Bank by Israeli settlers, describing it as "a handful of young juvenile delinquents, about 150 in number, who throw stones, who chop down olive trees."
"Occasionally ... they lit some fires. I can't stand that. I won't stand for vigilantism. We're a country of law."

items.title: Trump welcomes China's Xi with fanfare, but no breakthroughs emerge
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, David Brunnstrom
items.summary: The lavish summit was heavy on symbolism but light on substance, with no sign of breakthroughs on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday for a lavish summit that was heavy on symbolism but light on substance, with no sign of breakthroughs on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.
The two leaders and their wives attended a state dinner, a black-tie affair of sesame-crusted sea bass and a guest list heavy with tech CEOs. Outside the gate, a group of loud protesters shouted slogans like "China out of Hong Kong" that were clearly audible to the leaders as they posed for pictures on the red-carpeted White House steps.
In his dinner toast, Trump said he and Xi "both understand we represent different systems but the ties between our people endure and we’ve never gotten along better."
Trump then invited dinner guests to tour the site of the new ballroom he is building nearby, hours after showing Xi a helipad he had had built in the White House complex. Construction projects are a frequent digression for a president who has put [USN:L6N41H110 TEXT:"a lot of focus"] on remaking Washington's physical infrastructure.
Xi said he and Trump had in-depth discussions and reached "common understanding on many issues" that provided "new strategic guidance for China-US relations." He did not elaborate.
"China and the United States must act as responsible major countries," he said, calling for "a new approach for major countries to get along with each other."
The meeting was striking for where it took place – in Washington, even as scores of world leaders were in New York for the [USN:L1N45G0L1 TEXT:"United Nations General Assembly"].
It took place at a time of rising public concern about the swift growth of AI, and as Trump struggles to resolve a war his administration and Israel began with Iran, which has sharply driven up energy prices and weighed heavily on his public approval as November midterm elections approach.
TAIWAN TALKS During a bilateral discussion in the afternoon, Xi urged the US to oppose "Taiwan independence," according to a readout from the official Chinese news agency – addressing one of the thorniest issues between the two countries. The White House has not yet provided its own summary of the talks.
Xi had been expected to press Trump this week to halt [USN:L1N45F134 TEXT:"arms sales"] to Taiwan. Following his visit to China in May, Trump said he was holding in abeyance an arms package to Taiwan worth some $14 billion and called it a "very good negotiating chip."
That move left some US allies in Asia and even some of Trump's fellow Republicans concerned that he may be tempted to soften Washington's support for Taipei in exchange for economic wins. China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory and has not ruled out using force to gain control over the island.
The summit between the two leaders came shortly after Trump forcefully defended his use of military power in a speech at the UN earlier this week, suggesting he could "annihilate" Iran. He took a strikingly different tone with Xi on Thursday, reflecting a power balance that has shifted toward the Chinese leader after a trade war that ended with a US climbdown on tariffs.
In remarks after Xi's arrival on Thursday, Trump emphasized his "truly great friendship" with Xi, rather than focusing on policy differences, and said the two powers had made strides on trade since his [USN:L1N41R11U TEXT:"trip to China"] in May.
Somewhat more pointely, Xi said the two countries' interests were deeply intertwined and that competition between them should be a "healthy one." US companies were welcome in China, he said, adding that he hopes "Chinese companies are treated fairly here in the United States."
Xi also said both militaries should maintain regular dialogue to improve crisis prevention.
PERSONAL VS. NATIONAL Edgard Kagan, a former senior White House official for East Asia, said the contrasting rhetoric demonstrates the different strategy of each leader.
"The president is casting it very much as about his personal relationship with Xi," said Kagan, now with the Center for Strategic and International Studies. "What I found interesting was Xi is being much more cautious and suggesting that it's less about the personal relationship than the national relationship."
The summit, Xi's first visit to Washington in more than a decade, is the second meeting this year between the leaders of the world's two biggest economies.
For Trump, who relishes ceremony and prizes his ties with powerful leaders, the visit is as much a matter of national prestige as an opportunity for high-stakes diplomacy.
But Trump and Xi's remarks were not carried live by any US television networks, which refused to provide footage in protest of the [USN:FWN45G0KZ TEXT:"White House's ban"] of CNN, MS Now and Politico.
During his comments on Thursday, Xi said both countries must "ensure that the development of AI is always under human control."
Analysts say intense competition between the two powers in AI is likely to limit the scope for anything beyond symbolic agreements.
There has been little sign Beijing is willing to exert pressure on Iran to yield to US demands. During Thursday's meeting, Xi expressed support for the US and Iran to return to a ceasefire and eventually negotiate a peace deal, Xinhua reported.
The guest list for Thursday's state dinner includeD CEOs like Apple's Tim Cook, Amazon's Jeff Bezos, Alphabet's Sundar Pichai, OpenAI's Sam Altman, Tesla's Elon Musk and Nvidia's Jensen Huang. Despite such an array, people familiar with US plans say Trump is likely to maintain firm export controls on US tech Xi wants loosened.
items.raw_description: The lavish summit was heavy on symbolism but light on substance, with no sign of breakthroughs on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.

SK Hynix Is Eyeing Intel’s (INTC) Ohio Site. Why Micron (MU) Should Pay Attention

Habib Ur Rehman

Learn more

SK Hynix is exploring something it has never done before: manufacturing memory chips in the United States.
Reuters reported on September 16 that the Korean memory giant is discussing several possibilities with Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC ), including leasing part of Intel's long-delayed Ohio complex or forming a venture involving Intel and large cloud customers. SK Hynix said no specific plan has been finalized.
For Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ), the talks matter because one of its strongest strategic advantages is being the major U.S.-based memory producer while AI has made DRAM and HBM increasingly scarce.

SK Hynix May Move Into Intel’s $100 Billion Ohio Fab. Micron Has a Reason to Watch SK Hynix Could Give Intel Another Path for Its Delayed Ohio Site Intel has committed enormous capital to Ohio, with the broader project potentially reaching around $100 billion over time. Delays have pushed planned production into the next decade. A tenant or joint-venture partner could therefore help Intel share the financial burden of developing the Ohio site rather than relying entirely on its own foundry demand to justify the buildout.

That is the bull case. The bear case is that exploratory talks are a long way from revenue. Bringing advanced Korean memory production to the U.S. could face cost problems, technology-transfer restrictions and objections from Seoul. Intel still needs its core manufacturing roadmap to work.
Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) sits on the other side of the equation. AI demand has pushed memory pricing and availability into a strong cycle, and Micron is already pursuing a large U.S. manufacturing expansion. More domestic manufacturing incentives and customer interest in secure supply support that plan.
A successful SK Hynix move could eventually erode part of Micron's U.S.-supply differentiation. U.S. cloud companies would gain another potential domestic supplier, while additional long-term memory capacity could eventually loosen the market that currently supports exceptional pricing.
Hedge funds loaded up on both chipmakers Insider Monkey tracked 138 hedge funds holding Intel in Q2, up sharply from 112 in Q1. AQR Capital Management held roughly 10.7 million shares after trimming its stake about 7%. Micron's count rose to 184 funds from 154, one of the stronger quarter-over-quarter increases among large semiconductor names. Coatue Management expanded its MU stake dramatically during the quarter.

Intel had about 152.2 million shares sold short as of August 31, roughly 3% of public float and 1.7 days to cover.
The talks do not rescue Intel's foundry strategy or weaken Micron overnight. They do show what AI scarcity is doing to the supply chain. Memory manufacturing is becoming strategic enough that SK Hynix is considering putting advanced capacity on American soil, and Intel's delayed Ohio project suddenly gives it a potentially valuable asset to negotiate with.

Story Continues
While we acknowledge the potential of INTC and MU as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. items.title: Western athletes try their hand at Kyrgyzstan’s Nomad Games
items.author: Felix Light
items.creator: Felix Light
items.summary: Clutching a bow and arrow and riding helmet in a remote gorge in northern Kyrgyzstan, London-based executive coach Becca Sweetman is a long way from home.
items.body:
Clutching a bow and arrow and riding helmet in a remote gorge in northern Kyrgyzstan, London-based executive coach Becca Sweetman is a long way from home.
"About eight years ago a friend asked if I wanted to have a go at horseback archery and I just got hooked on this amazing sport," she said.
"So, I've been competing for the last eight years for the Great Britain team."
Sweetman is one of many Western athletes to make the trek out to Central Asia for the Nomad Games, a biennial tournament of traditional nomad sports, mostly originating from Central Asia. Aside from horse archery, they include various styles of wrestling, falconry, and traditional board games.
Since the inaugural edition in 2014, the Nomad Games have gone from strength to strength.
This year they returned home to Kyrgyzstan, the mountainous Central Asian country of seven million where they were first held, and where traditional sports retain a strong popular following. More than 3,000 athletes from more than 100 countries took part, organisers said.
An opening ceremony in the Kyrgyz capital, Bishkek, [USN:L8N44S1C3 TEXT:"was attended by leaders"] including Russian President Vladimir Putin, Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan, and India's Narendra Modi, in town for a summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation.
Sam Pollard, a London-based consultant, came to Kyrgyzstan as part of the British tug of war team. He said he'd become interested in the Nomad Games after seeing videos of Kok Boru, a nomadic sport similar to polo, but which is played with a sheep carcass in place of a ball.
"That looks awesome," he told himself. The timing of the games aligned perfectly with when he wanted to visit Central Asia, plus he and his friends "had a bit of background in tug of war," he said.
Although many athletes have come from countries without a history of nomadism, others come from countries like Mongolia and the Central Asian republics, where nomadic sports retain a major following.
"These games have the nomadic spirit," said Mumina Daminova, a horseback archer from Uzbekistan, who competed in flowing white traditional robes.
"It's like Olympic games but for ethnosport," she said.

items.summary: Les valeurs à suivre à Paris et en Europe
items.body:
Les valeurs à suivre à Paris et en Europe
Les valeurs à suivre vendredi à la Bourse de Paris et en Europe :
BCE: Schnabel quittera ses fonctions pour rejoindre le FMI, coup d'envoi d'un remaniement plus large
24 septembre (Reuters) - Isabel Schnabel, membre du directoire de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), quittera ses fonctions le 3 janvier 2027 pour rejoindre le Fonds monétaire international (FMI), a annoncé jeudi l'institut de Francfort dans un communiqué.
BCE: Isabel Schnabel va annoncer son départ anticipé pour rejoindre le FMI
FRANCFORT, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Isabel Schnabel, membre du directoire de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), quittera prématurément ses fonctions pour occuper un poste de haut niveau au Fonds monétaire international (FMI) et une annonce officielle pourrait intervenir dans le courant de la journée, ont déclaré à Reuters deux sources proches du dossier.
Airbus signale un défaut, sans danger, dans la structure de fuselage d'A321neo
24 septembre (Reuters) - Airbus a déclaré jeudi avoir identifié un défaut de qualité susceptible de réduire la résistance à la corrosion à l'intérieur de l'avant de la structure du fuselage d'un certain nombre d'avions A321neo.
USA: Baisse des inscriptions au chômage à 197.000
24 septembre (Reuters) - Les inscriptions au chômage ont baissé aux États-Unis, s'établissant à 197.000 lors de la semaine au 19 septembre, a annoncé jeudi le département du Travail.
L'Europe dans le rouge, tensions sur le pétrole et les taux
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Les principales Bourses européennes reculent jeudi en matinée avec une nouvelle flambée des cours pétroliers et une remontée des rendements obligataires dans un contexte géopolitique toujours incertain, tandis que des indicateurs économiques montrent une accélération des pressions inflationnistes.
Allemagne: L'agence de gestion de la dette prévoit un nouveau record d'emprunts en 2027
BERLIN, 24 septembre (Reuters) - L'Agence fédérale des finances allemande a déclaré jeudi qu'elle s'attendait à ce que les emprunts fédéraux atteignent un niveau record de 525,5 milliards d'euros en 2026 et continuent d'augmenter l'année suivante, principalement en raison de la hausse des besoins de refinancement et de l'augmentation des besoins liés aux fonds spéciaux.
USA: Il est raisonnable d'envisager une nouvelle hausse des taux cette année, dit Williams (Fed)
LONDRES, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Le président de la Réserve fédérale de New York, John Williams, a déclaré jeudi qu'il était raisonnable de penser que la banque centrale américaine devrait relever à nouveau ses taux d'intérêt cette année afin de réduire les risques inflationnistes.
Mercedes veut réduire ses coûts salariaux de €800 mlns en Allemagne-WiWo
Mercedes-Benz MBGn.DE prévoit de réduire ses coûts salariaux en Allemagne de 800 millions d'euros, selon des informations de l'hebdomadaire économique WirtschaftsWoche jeudi, citant trois sources proches du dossier.
Les Peugeot voient des signes positifs dans les résultats de Stellantis au S1
Le directeur général de Peugeot Invest, la holding d'investissement de la famille Peugeot, a déclaré jeudi que la performance de l'action Stellantis était clairement décevante mais que les résultats du groupe au premier semestre avaient montré des signes positifs.

items.summary: Réunion entre l'Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan après les attaques houthies
items.body:
Réunion entre l'Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan après les attaques houthies
RYAD/LE CAIRE, 25 septembre (Reuters) - L'Arabie saoudite, la Turquie et le Pakistan vont tenir une réunion urgente de haut niveau dans le cadre de leur pacte de défense afin de discuter des moyens de soutenir Ryad visé par des attaques lancées par les rebelles houthis du Yémen.
Trump offre à Xi un accueil d'exception à la Maison blanche, peu d'avancées attendues
WASHINGTON, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Donald Trump a réservé jeudi à Xi Jinping un accueil d'exception à la Maison blanche, dans le cadre d'une visite d'Etat de trois jours du président chinois, lors de laquelle aucune avancée majeure n'est attendue alors que priorité est donnée à la stabilité des liens, malgré une profonde rivalité sous-jacente.
Les Etats-Unis et la Chine doivent explorer de nouvelles voies de coopération entre grandes puissances, dit Xi
PÉKIN, 25 septembre (Reuters) - Le président chinois Xi Jinping a déclaré vendredi que la Chine et les Etats-Unis devaient explorer une nouvelle approche permettant aux grandes puissances de s'entendre.
Trump accueille Xi à la Maison blanche pour un dîner d'Etat
WASHINGTON, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Donald Trump et Xi Jinping, accompagnés de leurs épouses, ont pris part jeudi soir à un dîner d'Etat à la Maison blanche dans le cadre d'une visite d'Etat de trois jours du président chinois aux Etats-Unis.
Netanyahu défend à l'Onu les actions d'Israël, critique les délégués quittant l'Assemblée
NATIONS UNIES, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu a défendu avec véhémence jeudi aux Nations unies les actions régionales d'Israël, cherchant à contrer l'isolement accru de l'Etat hébreu sur la scène internationale à l'approche des élections législatives israéliennes d'octobre, qu'il pourrait perdre.
Il appartient aux Etats-Unis de décider s'ils veulent mettre fin à la guerre en Iran, dit Pezeshkian
WASHINGTON, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Le président iranien Massoud Pezeshkian a déclaré qu'il appartenait aux Etats-Unis de décider quand la guerre contre l'Iran prendrait fin.
ANALYSE: À l'heure du face-à-face Trump-Xi, une diplomatie mondiale en deux scènes
NATIONS UNIES, NEW YORK, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Alors que les dirigeants du monde entier se réunissent au siège des Nations unies (Onu) à New York cette semaine pour l'Assemblée générale annuelle de l'organisation, les deux principaux acteurs de la politique mondiale - les présidents chinois et américain - se retrouvent jeudi à la Maison blanche pour une visite qui s'annonce fastueuse.
L'Arabie saoudite dit avoir intercepté six missiles tirés par les Houthis
24 septembre (Reuters) - La coalition militaire menée par l'Arabie saoudite au Yémen a dit jeudi avoir intercepté six missiles balistiques tirés par les Houthis pro-iraniens.
Brève incursion d'un hélicoptère russe en Pologne, dit l'armée polonaise
Un hélicoptère militaire russe de type Mi-8 a effectué une brève incursion dans l'espace aérien de la Pologne à partir de l'enclave russe de Kaliningrad, a déclaré mercredi l'armée polonaise.
A l'Onu, Trump menace d'"annihiler" l'Iran, évoque un accord après les 'midterms'
Le président américain Donald Trump a utilisé mardi son discours devant l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies pour revendiquer que la guerre menée contre l'Iran a empêché Téhéran de se doter de l'arme nucléaire et pour menacer à nouveau d'"annihiler la République islamique" si aucun accord n'est trouvé.

items.summary: La CIA n'a pas informé Paris d'une éventuelle attaque russe en France, dit Macron
items.body:
La CIA n'a pas informé Paris d'une éventuelle attaque russe en France, dit Macron
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Les services américains de renseignement n'ont pas informé leurs homologues français d'une éventuelle attaque à venir de la Russie en France, a déclaré jeudi soir Emmanuel Macron, tout en rappelant la menace représentée par les "actes hostiles" de Moscou dans le cadre de la guerre en Ukraine.
La France va envoyer des moyens militaires en Arabie pour protéger un site pétrolier clé, selon Macron
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Emmanuel Macron a déclaré jeudi soir que la France allait envoyer des moyens militaires en Arabie saoudite, dont des soldats et des systèmes de défense, pour protéger le site de Yanbou, crucial pour les exportations d'hydrocarbures, dans un contexte de regain des hostilités entre Ryad et les Houthis.
Macron se dit à la manoeuvre pour lutter contre la crise de l'énergie
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Emmanuel Macron a tenté jeudi soir de répondre à la crise de l'énergie, "due à des conditions géopolitiques", en expliquant son action à l'international et les choix du gouvernement face à des hausses de prix "terribles pour beaucoup de familles".
France: Macron "regrette" de ne pas avoir assez réformé le modèle social
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Emmanuel Macron a déclaré jeudi soir lors d'une interview sur TF1 et France 2 qu'il regrettait de ne pas avoir assez réformé le modèle social français.
Macron décrit devant l'Onu la diplomatie pour Gaza comme un "spectacle de honte"
Emmanuel Macron a rejeté mardi l'idée selon laquelle la guerre dans la bande de Gaza avait pris fin, comme revendiqué par le président américain Donald Trump, déclarant qu'aucune voie humanitaire n'avait été rouverte dans l'enclave palestinienne depuis l'annonce à l'automne dernier d'une "paix prétendue".
L'Azerbaïdjan gracie un prisonnier français, Paris se dit soulagé
Le président azerbaïdjanais Ilham Aliev a accordé mercredi sa grâce au Français Martin Ryan, emprisonné pour espionnage en Azerbaïdjan, au lendemain de la levée des sanctions européennes contre l'homme d'affaires Alicher Ousmanov.
A l'Onu, Trump menace d'"annihiler" l'Iran, évoque un accord après les 'midterms'
Le président américain Donald Trump a utilisé mardi son discours devant l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies pour revendiquer que la guerre menée contre l'Iran a empêché Téhéran de se doter de l'arme nucléaire et pour menacer à nouveau d'"annihiler la République islamique" si aucun accord n'est trouvé.
Netanyahu, attendu à l'Onu, accuse le maire de New York de soutenir le Hamas
Le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu a déclaré mardi qu'il profiterait de son discours aux Nations unies cette semaine pour défendre les opérations militaires d'Israël contre les Palestiniens, tout en accusant le maire de New York Zohran Mamdani de soutenir le Hamas.
DeepSeek participera à la présentation IA devant le Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu selon des sources
DeepSeek, la start-up chinoise d'intelligence artificielle (IA), figure parmi les entreprises qui présenteront mercredi un exposé sur les risques liés à l'IA devant le Conseil de sécurité des Nations unies, ont dit deux sources proches du dossier.
L'aide "aux gros rouleurs" reconduite et élargie
Le gouvernement français a annoncé mardi un élargissement de l'aide aux automobilistes les plus dépendants de leur véhicule, dans le cadre d'un nouveau train de mesures destiné à amortir l'impact de la flambée des prix des carburants provoquée par les perturbations de l'approvisionnement mondial en pétrole.

items.summary: Football: Zidane ressent une "immense émotion" avant son premier match à la tête des Bleus
items.body:
Football: Zidane ressent une "immense émotion" avant son premier match à la tête des Bleus
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - Zinédine Zidane a reconnu jeudi ressentir "une immense émotion" à l'idée de diriger son premier match en tant que sélectionneur de l'équipe de France de football, vendredi en Turquie, lors de la première journée de la Ligue des nations.
Football: Infantino bien parti pour se maintenir, la Fifa face à une nouvelle guerre de pouvoir
PARIS, 24 septembre (Reuters) - La bataille pour pousser le président de la Fifa Gianni Infantino vers la sortie est peut-être quasiment perdue, à peine quelques semaines après que ses opposants ont cru pouvoir le détrôner, mais la guerre sur l'étendue des pouvoirs dont il disposera s'il reste en place ne fait sans doute que commencer.
Football: Le sélectionneur allemand Klopp salué pour son choix de constituer deux groupes de 22 joueurs
La décision du sélectionneur allemand Jürgen Klopp de constituer deux groupes distincts, totalisant 44 joueurs, pour ses quatre premiers matches à la tête de la sélection a suscité des éloges alors qu'il entame son chantier pour remettre l'Allemagne sur le devant de la scène.
Football-Le président du PSG visé par une enquête pour conflit d'intérêts
Le président du Paris Saint-Germain, Nasser Al-Khelaifi, fait l'objet d'une enquête préliminaire en France pour un conflit d'intérêts présumé lié aux droits de diffusion de la Ligue 1, a indiqué à Reuters le parquet de Paris, des allégations que ce dernier et la chaîne beIN dont il est le président réfutent.
Football-Jacquet et Lepaul parmi les cinq nouveaux Bleus sélectionnés par Zidane
Le nouveau sélectionneur de l'équipe de France de football, Zinedine Zidane, a dévoilé vendredi sa première liste de joueurs en vue des prochains matches de la Ligue des Nations, dans laquelle figurent cinq nouveaux venus, dont le défenseur central de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet et l'attaquant rennais Esteban Lepaul.
Football-Mbappé quitte Nike et pour rejoindre la marque On
L'attaquant de l'équipe de France Kylian Mbappé quitte Nike pour devenir ambassadeur de la marque de sport On, a annoncé vendredi l'entreprise suisse, qui fait son entrée sur le marché du football.
Automobile: Le rallye d'Arabie saoudite supprimé du championnat du monde WRC en raison du conflit au Moyen-Orient
La Fédération internationale de l'automobile (FIA) a annoncé jeudi l'annulation du rallye d'Arabie saoudite en tant que dernière manche du championnat du monde des rallyes WRC en raison des tensions au Moyen-Orient.
Football: Messi fera ses adieux à l'équipe d'Argentine lors d'un amical à Buenos Aires en octobre
Lionel Messi, qui a annoncé sa retraite internationale le mois dernier, a été appelé pour disputer un match amical avec l'équipe d'Argentine le mois prochain dans la capitale Buenos Aires, une rencontre qui permettra à l'icône d'effectuer ses adieux à l'"Albiceleste" et au public argentin.
Football: Un examen du projet abandonné d'Infantino sera présenté au conseil de la Fifa
La Fifa a indiqué jeudi qu'un examen de son projet avorté de céder une partie des droits commerciaux de la Coupe du monde sera présenté au conseil de l'instance après des critiques sur l'absence de réponses concernant l'abandon de ce dossier.
Football: Le Real Madrid défend la liberté d’expression de ses joueurs après la polémique sur Ceuta
Le Real Madrid a défendu le droit de ses joueurs à exprimer des opinions divergentes après que les attaquants Kylian Mbappé et Vinicius Jr. ont masqué mardi un message de solidarité en faveur de la population de Ceuta avant le match de Liga contre Elche.

Platinum Futures.PL1! **Platinum Futures** continues to present a constructive technical outlook, with the broader market structure favoring the upside. No specific entry level has been identified in this setup; instead, the focus is on the lower timeframe, where early signs of renewed buyer participation are beginning to appear. If this momentum develops into a confirmed bullish structure, the current phase could provide an opportunity to participate in the continuation of the broader trend.

**Key technical observations:**

• The lower timeframe is already showing signs of increasing buyer participation and improving demand.
• The development of **Higher Highs (HH)** and **Higher Lows (HL)** would provide stronger confirmation of bullish market structure.
• A constructive shift in the moving averages would further support the transition toward sustained upside momentum.
• The absence of a predefined entry level makes confirmation of buyer control particularly important before considering participation in the next potential rally.

Technical analysis provides a useful framework for identifying momentum and market structure, while the broader outlook for platinum should also be considered through supply-demand dynamics, industrial demand, investment flows, and macroeconomic conditions. Combining these factors with valuation and risk assessment can provide a more complete investment perspective.

Precious metals can experience substantial volatility even within established bullish trends. Maintaining patience, waiting for objective confirmation from market structure, and applying disciplined risk management can help investors participate in a developing move without reacting prematurely to short-term fluctuations.
